* Flexible PTO

If you need an accommodation during any part of the interview process, due to a disability, please let us know.

title: Design Director
description:
Design Directors lead the creative heart of a project, from early ideas to final delivery. You’ll set the vision, guide designers and writers through execution, and bring clarity and perspective to every stage of the work. You’re someone who can turn strategy into concepts, concepts into systems, and systems into beautiful, functional design, while helping the team and our clients see where an idea can go. You have a sharp eye for craft, communicate clearly and generously, and stay curious about new tools and where design is headed.
  
  
At Rudy, everyone designs, directors included. Staying hands-on is how we stay sharp, stay current and keep our work honest. Design Directors are leaders, collaborators and co-authors who move easily between making the work and guiding it. You’ll lead brands built from scratch, refreshes of established ones, and work that brings clarity to complex challenges across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints. You’re confident making creative calls and know how to bring out the best in the people around you.
  
  
We’re looking for unique talent: people who take creative risks, have a real appetite for experimentation, and are excited to push what’s possible, with past work that shows it. You’re curious, culturally tuned-in, and drawn to work that has both conceptual depth and visual ambition.
  
  
**This Role Will Have You**

* Lead design and creative direction across brand identity, systems, campaigns, digital, print and everything in between
* Design hands-on alongside the team, from early explorations to final craft
* Guide designers, writers and interns from exploration through execution, with clear direction and feedback
* Shape strategy into creative: turn research and messy inputs into compelling concepts and clear directions
* Partner with studio leadership, strategists, technologists and collaborators to bring ideas to life
* Shape and share the work with clients, building trust and bringing them along on the thinking
* Champion experimentation, AI-enhanced workflows and non-linear exploration, and push the work into new territory
* Hold a high bar for detail, quality and conceptual integrity across every project
* Mentor the team and help foster a studio culture of critique, generosity and play

**You Might Be a Great Fit If**

* You have 8+ years of experience in branding, digital design or adjacent creative fields, including leading projects
* You still love to make things, and you have a hard time imagining not designing
* You have mastery of the fundamentals – layout, type, hierarchy, storytelling – and more importantly, can teach them
* You take smart risks and are energized by ideas that haven’t been tried yet
* You love the big swing and the tiny detail, and know which one a project needs
* You have range: you can lead identity, digital and campaign work without losing clarity
* You give feedback that makes work and people better, and welcome it in return
* You value craft, but you’re not precious – you iterate, explore and evolve until the work sings

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience directing motion, 3D or illustration
* Fluency in Figma, AI workflows, prototyping tools and modern digital design practices
* Interest in culture, ideas, technology and the future of what creative studios can be

**Compensation And Benefits**

* Salary: $110 - $130k, plus quarterly profit sharing and performance bonuses
* 401(k) retirement plan
* 3 weeks paid vacation, plus paid sick days
* Two-week studio closure at the end of the year, plus culture-forward holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance, with premiums covered for individuals
* Complimentary access to wellness and mental health services
* Life insurance
* Annual company retreat
* 2 weeks a year to work from any time zone
* 6 Learning Days a year
* One design event, festival or conference a year, on us
* Pre-tax commuter benefits and FSA

This is a hybrid role based in our Chinatown, NYC studio. We have a strong preference for NYC-based candidates, but are open to remote for the right person, working East Coast hours.
  
  
Email us your portfolio, resume and a note on why you’d like to join us – and include ‘Design Director’ as the subject line: jobs@ru-dy.com

title: Senior Art Director - Brand Designer [Argentina]
location: Ciudad Evita, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a hybrid creative agency + advisory organization working alongside B2B marketing and revenue teams to drive growth.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US, Buenos Aires and Italy. We care about bold, specific work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
****The role****
We're looking for a Senior Art Director / Brand Designer to join our creative team.
  
  
You'll be part of Story, our brand and creative practice. It's where we help B2B companies find the story only they have the right to tell, then make it easier to sell and harder to ignore. That covers brand development, solution storytelling, and creative campaigns, all built from the market signals we uncover for our clients.
  
  
You'd sit somewhere between a classic Art Director and a brand designer. You'll get a strategic or conceptual brief, find the idea in it, build a visual world around that idea, and then see it all the way through to the finished piece. Think key visuals, campaign identities, and brand systems that still look great on every touchpoint.
  
  
You'll have a lot of autonomy here. We trust you to make good creative calls without someone looking over your shoulder. When feedback comes in, we want you to get what's really behind it, not just tick off the comments.
  
  
You'll also help us figure out how AI fits into the way we create. We're excited about new tools and use them to explore more and move faster. But the idea, the taste, and the final call? Those stay with people.
  
  
If you've got a strong portfolio across both branding and campaigns, we'd love to talk.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
****Find the idea.****

* Take strategy and messaging and turn them into visual concepts bold enough to stand out. Buyers ignore generic, and so do we.
* Explore a few different creative directions, share them, and know which one is worth fighting for.
* Bring real Art Direction thinking to every brief, not just great execution.

****Build brands that scale.****

* Design full brand identities and visual systems that help clients own a position competitors can't claim, not just a logo here and a one-off piece there.
* Lead brand refreshes that move things forward without losing what people already recognize.
* Make sure every system has the depth and flexibility to work wherever it ends up.

****Bring campaigns to life.****

* Create campaign concepts, key visuals, and campaign identities from a blank page, including ABM programs and thought leadership that give accounts already in motion a reason to engage.
* Take one big idea and carry it across websites, decks, social, paid media, events, and whatever comes next.
* Sweat the details: typography, layout, composition, color, and hierarchy.

****Create with AI, lead with judgment.****

* Use AI to go wider when you're exploring, test ideas quickly, and speed up production.
* Keep the concept in the driver's seat. The tools should serve the idea, not decide it.
* Edit hard and refine by hand until it feels like the brand and meets our bar.
* Share what's working with the team, because the tools keep changing and we learn faster together.

**Who You Are**

* You're a Senior Art Director or Brand Designer with 7+ years under your belt, ideally from a strong agency or studio.
* You think in concepts first. You can tell us the idea behind a project before you show us a single frame.
* You've created original key visuals and campaign identities, not just adapted someone else's.
* You love building systems, and you've designed complete brand systems with real depth.
* You're a little obsessed with craft: typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
* You're independent and decisive. You can go from brief to direction without needing your hand held.
* You're great with feedback. You use it to make the work better instead of applying every comment literally.
* You're curious about new tech, AI included, and you have the eye to tell what's actually good.
* You're fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
* You're comfortable working in English with a remote, multicultural team.

****Nice to have****

* You've used AI image, video, or design tools in your own creative work.
* You've worked at an agency or consultancy across different industries.
* You've done integrated or multi-channel campaigns.
* You've designed for websites and digital.
* You have a feel for motion and animation.
* You're a confident presenter who can stand behind the work.

**What We'd Love To See In Your Portfolio**
We care more about how you think than how many projects you've done. So show us:
  
  

* The idea behind each project.
* How a key visual grew into a full campaign system.
* The directions you explored, not just the one that won.
* Brand systems with depth, and how they play out across formats.
* Consistent, high craft.
* Where you used AI, what you kept, and what you threw out. We love seeing process work.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A chat with our Talent team.
* A portfolio review, where you walk us through two or three projects from idea to execution.
* A practical case, where you show us how you'd tackle a real-world creative challenge.
* A conversation with some of our senior team.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape how our brands and campaigns look, and how we create them.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US, Buenos Aires, and Italy.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Firdays, time off between holiday, and more.

****Ready to take the seat?****
No safe stories. If you want to own both the idea and the craft, we'd really like to hear from you.

title: Creative Director
description:

JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.
  
  
We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.

* A conversation with our Talent team.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.

* Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.

If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech French Fluent 🇫🇷
location: Ajman, Ajman Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
**Job Description**
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**
Then you’ll love this.
  
  
We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).
  
  
Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.
  
  
**This isn’t another content job.**
Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.
  
  
**What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖**
Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.
  
  
**Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To**

* Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
* Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
* Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
* Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.
  
  
Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.
  
  
People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.
  
  
**We Do That By Merging**

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.
  
  
Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.
  
  
In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

title: Creative Director
description:

More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a **Creative Director** to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**The creative standard**

* Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
* Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
* By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

**A brand system that morphs**

* Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
* Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

**The team**

* Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
* Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

**Predictable, well-run delivery**

* Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
* Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
* Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

**How You'll Work**
-------------------

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

* The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a **preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.**

title: Director, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino
description:
**About Us**

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players' associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

**Primary Focus:**

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
* Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
* Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
* Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
* Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
* Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
* Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
* Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
* Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
* Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
* Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
* Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
* Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
* Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

**How This Role Connects Across the Team:**

* Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
* Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
* Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
* Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
* Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
* Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that's optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
* Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
* Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
* Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.

* Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

title: Creative Director (Organic Social)
description:
Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.

We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.

Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.

**The role**

You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.

Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.

You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.

Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.

We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.

**Requirements**

* **Proven organic social growth |** A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
* **Strategic content leadership |** Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
* **Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting |** Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
* **Content waterfall implementation |** Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
* **Management of both video editors and copywriters |** Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
* **Practical AI experience |** Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
* **Excellent written and spoken English |** The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.

**Preferred experience**

We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.

* **Significant audience growth |** Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
* **Coaching industry experience |** Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
* **YouTube or other long-form audience growth |** A record of building an audience through long-form content.
* **Commercial results |** A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.

**Working arrangement**

* This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
* Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST

**Applications**

* ***Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed.***
* Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within ***one to two weeks*** of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.

*Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!*

title: Associate Creative Director, Performance
description:
**About Sequencing**  
Sequencing is the world’s largest direct-to-consumer whole genome sequencing platform, helping define the future of AI-powered personalized health.

We’re a Series A venture-backed, fully remote company turning clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into meaningful, personalized insights. Through AI and a growing ecosystem of genomic applications, we’re building the trusted home for every genome.

In 2026, GenomeWeb named Sequencing a Best Places to Work winner, highlighting our fully remote culture of autonomy, transparency, and growth. As our COO, Shara Birn, put it: “We hire talented people, give them meaningful responsibility, and trust them to make decisions.”

**About the Role**

Sequencing.com turns clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into a lifelong source of personalized health insights, from everyday wellness questions to serious health decisions. We're rebuilding how that story looks, sounds, and performs, and we need an Associate Creative Director to lead it.

You'll define the new brand and make it earn its keep in paid channels. You'll work side by side with our product designers and agencies so the brand shows up in the product as clearly as it does in an ad. You report to marketing leadership and partner with growth, lifecycle, product marketing, and product design. This is a hands-on seat for someone who wants to ship, not just direct.

**What You'll Own**

* **The rebrand, end to end.** Lead our visual identity, voice, and creative language from concept through rollout across web, product, paid, and lifecycle.
* **Performance creative that works.** Concept, make, and iterate high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, and emerging AI-native channels. You live in the metrics and know why a creative won.
* **Partnership with product designers.** Work shoulder to shoulder with product design so the brand and the experience feel like one thing, from first ad to in-app moments to subscription flows.
* **Stories people trust.** Turn complex genomic data into clear, emotional, scientifically responsible stories that help people understand their genome and act on it.
* **Creative systems that scale.** Build templates, modular assets, and guidelines across acquisition, engagement, retention, and subscription so the team ships faster without losing quality.
* **Fast learning loops.** Run rapid experiments, read the results with growth, and turn what you learn into the next round.
* **A high, consistent bar.** Guide internal teammates, freelancers, and agencies, and stay close to the craft yourself: art direction, writing, design, motion, prototyping, and production.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in creative roles, with 2+ years leading creative or owning a brand at a startup or growth-stage company.
* Proven experience leading or driving a rebrand, ideally at an earlier-stage company where you built the identity and the system, not just applied one.
* A portfolio of performance creative with real results on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or CTV in consumer subscription, DTC, wellness, or tech. You can show the numbers behind the work.
* Hands-on craft in design, video, motion, and creative strategy.
* A track record of working closely with product designers to bring a brand into the product experience.
* Solid digital marketing instincts: funnels, testing, attribution basics, and how creative drives acquisition and retention.
* You use AI tools every day for image, video, motion, copy, and ideation, and can show how they've made your work faster and better.
* Staying power. We value people who commit and grow in a role, so a history of multi-year tenures stands out.
* High ownership and autonomy in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. Experience leading teams, freelancers, and agencies is expected.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in wellness, healthtech, biotech, or another category where trust and science matter.
* Familiarity with design tools your product designers use (Figma) and comfort prototyping in them.
* Experience with lifecycle and subscription creative, such as email, onboarding, and win-back.

**Why Sequencing?**

For decades, the human genome has been one of the richest health information in the world, but most people have never been able to truly understand or use it. We’re changing that.

We're transforming billions of genetic variants and decades of scientific research into technology people can interact with naturally and trust. This isn't another health app. It's a new category that brings together bioinformatics, genetics, and consumer health.

**Your work won’t just help build Sequencing. It will help redefine how people understand themselves through their DNA for decades to come.**

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Paid volunteer time off
* Fully remote work, with equipment provided and internet and cell reimbursements
* Parental bonding leave
* Private, confidential clinical-grade whole genome sequencing for you and your immediate family

*Join us in helping build the interface between humanity and its DNA!*

AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.

* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

title: Lead Deployment Strategist - EMEA
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing Deployment Strategist team that helps n8n's enterprise customers turn automation opportunities into measurable business impact. You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

### **Build & Lead the Deployment Strategist Team**

* Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.
* Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.
* Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.

### **Own & Scale the Deployment Methodology**

* Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.
* Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.
* Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.

### **Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes**

* Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.
* Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.
* Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.

### **Scale Delivery Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Partner Delivery Manager and Partnerships teams to ensure external delivery partners follow the same engagement methodology and quality standards.
* Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.
* Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

### **Must-haves**

* **Enterprise Customer Experience:** You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.
* **People Leadership:** You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
* **0-to-1 Builder Experience:** You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.
* **Executive Stakeholder Management:** You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.
* **Technical Fluency:** You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.
* **Operational Excellence:** You know how to define success metrics, build scalable methodologies, and turn customer engagement learnings into actionable playbooks.
* **Customer Outcome Mindset:** You're focused on driving measurable customer adoption and long-term value, rather than simply delivering projects or completing engagements.

### **Nice-to-haves**

* **Automation Platforms:** You're familiar with n8n or other workflow automation, integration, or low-code platforms.
* **Change Management:** You have experience helping enterprise organizations drive adoption, navigate organizational change, and embed new technologies into their ways of working.
* **Partner Ecosystems:** You've worked with systems integrators, consulting firms, or external delivery partners to deliver customer implementations or technical engagements.

**Why join us?**

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a brand-new function at the heart of how we scale enterprise customer adoption. You won't just manage a team — you'll shape how we engage customers, demonstrate the value of automation, and turn high-impact use cases into production workflows that drive lasting business outcomes.

You'll work closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering, with significant visibility and influence over our enterprise growth strategy. As one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, we offer the opportunity to build from the ground up, experiment with new approaches, and create a scalable deployment model that helps customers become independent, successful builders.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, where your impact will be visible from day one.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Director of Field and Events Marketing
description:
**About Us**  
  
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  
  
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.  
  
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**About the Role**
------------------

Perk is changing how companies manage travel and spend, and how we show up in front of our buyers, in person and inside their accounts, is one of the biggest drivers of how we win. We are looking for a Director of Field and Events Marketing to bring ABM, field marketing and every event we run together into one global team, and to build it into the engine that puts the right people from the right accounts in the room with our sales teams.

This is a global leadership role with real scale. You will lead the full events portfolio alongside our field marketing teams in every region, and you will work hand in hand with sales leaders on where pipeline is needed and how we go and get it. You will set the standard for how a fast-growing company runs events, and be measured on the pipeline you create and the retention and expansion you help drive. There is a lot to build in this role, and you will have the mandate and the budget to build it.

The right candidate is a strategic operator with deep ABM expertise, who loves the commercial side of events, gets energy from working shoulder to shoulder with Sales, and wants to build an events centre of excellence people in the industry talk about. It is an exciting time to join, with real momentum behind the business, in an AI-first company that expects its leaders to rethink how work gets done.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Build and scale ABM**

* Scale our account-based approach across regions, segments and the full sales cycle, from creating pipeline in target accounts to accelerating deals and growing existing customers, with a clear standard for how target accounts are chosen and engaged, agreed with Sales and Revenue Operations.
* Extend ABM beyond the field team, working with Product Marketing, Growth, Content and Brand so that campaigns across marketing are built around the same priority accounts.
* Define the milestones that show an account is moving through a long sales cycle, run regular account reviews, and shift resource towards the accounts and programmes that are making progress.

### **Build an events centre of excellence**

* Build and lead a centre of excellence that brings every type of event we run into one team, from demand generation events and trade shows to conferences, customer events and F1 hospitality, with a single planning calendar, shared standards, and the playbooks, templates and vendor approach that let every region deliver to the same quality.
* Set the events strategy in line with our business goals, go-to-market plans and integrated campaigns, and own the portfolio, deciding which events and sponsorships we invest in, scale or stop based on what each one delivers for pipeline and for our customers.
* Manage a global budget for events and field marketing, allocating it across regions, formats and programmes and moving investment towards what performs.

### **Partner with Sales**

Partnering with Sales is a critical part of this role. You will work with sales leadership in every region to decide where pipeline is needed and which programmes will deliver it.

* Build one alignment model for the global team, with field leads working inside each region's sales leadership, joining pipeline reviews and planning, so that priorities are shared and investment follows where pipeline is needed most.
* Create one front door for every event and field request from Sales, with clear intake, triage and funding rules.
* Equip sales teams and executives to get the most from every programme with target lists, outreach templates and follow-up plays, and own the pipeline plan for our biggest events, including invitations, meetings and executive sessions.

### **Drive pipeline and customer growth**

* Own the pipeline targets for ABM, field and events, partnering with Revenue Operations on attribution and reporting pipeline created and influenced, and cost per opportunity by programme and region.
* Make sure every programme you run contributes to growing our net revenue retention, using events and ABM to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive expansion alongside winning new business.
* Establish experimentation and testing frameworks across event types, turning what you learn into repeatable programmes and investment decisions.

### **Team and ways of working**

* Lead, coach and grow a global team of field marketing managers and events marketing managers, hiring where needed and building a culture of ownership, creativity and continuous learning.
* Be AI fluent and AI first in your approach, using automation for account research, event operations, follow-up and reporting so the team delivers more than its headcount would suggest.
* Work closely with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Content and PR so that events and field programmes support our major launches and company moments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 10+ years in B2B marketing, with deep ABM and field marketing expertise and experience running events at scale.
* A proven track record of sourcing pipeline through account-targeted programmes, with the numbers to show it, ideally in a company with a meaningful enterprise or mid-market sales motion.
* Experience running a multi-format events portfolio, including conferences, trade shows, hospitality and customer events, and managing sponsorships and vendors.
* Strong credibility with sales leaders, built through partnering with them on pipeline reviews and regional planning.
* Experience using events and ABM to drive expansion and retention as well as new business.
* Experience building and leading teams, including managers and regional leads, across time zones.
* Experience managing and forecasting large budgets, and partnering with finance and RevOps to measure and report ROI.

### **Skills and traits**

* Strategic thinker who can turn vision into a global plan, with a roll your sleeves up approach to execution.
* Operational rigour, building target lists, funding rules and reporting before booking venues.
* A strong point of view and the confidence to make hard calls.
* Executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication.
* One team mindset, collaborating with global teams while working closely with regional sales and marketing.
* A growth mindset, and willingness to travel as programmes require.

**AI at Perk**  
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

description:
##### ***-******Las Palmas De Gran Canaria******-***

**Alien Technology Transfer** empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport.

We’re looking for a versatile **Process Automation Engineer** to join Alien Technology Transfer at **our office in Las Palmas**. Working closely with and reporting directly to our CEO, you will play a central role in a company-wide review of how each of our departments operates. Your job is to understand how work actually gets done, identify where time, quality and effort are being lost, and then design, build and maintain the tools that fix it. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that combines process analysis with full-stack engineering. You will spend time with department heads and their teams to map workflows and pinpoint inefficiencies. You will turn your findings into standardised processes and reliable software that is easily adopted. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer, nor for someone who only writes code to a specification. We need a strong generalist who can diagnose a business problem, decide what should be standardised, automated or eliminated, and then deliver a working solution end-to-end.

To join our team, you must possess a genuine interest in technology and business, be fluent in English, and take a highly analytical, articulate, and well-organised approach to your work. We are seeking a self-motivated team player with a strong startup attitude and the stamina to thrive within an ambitious, goal-driven environment. The ideal candidate is eager to take on high levels of responsibility, possesses sharp problem-solving skills, and is proactive about staying up to date on the latest tools — AI or otherwise — to ensure top performance. You are energised by wearing multiple hats—effectively managing priorities and diverse deliverables autonomously without needing a detailed playbook. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in this dynamic role, we would be excited to hear from you.

* **Contract Type:** Permanent.
* **Hybrid Work Modality:** Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Process Diagnosis & Standardisation

* Work with each department to map current workflows and understand how work is actually done.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, error-prone manual steps and activities that add little value, and quantify their impact where possible.
* Define standardised processes, templates and quality checks that reduce variability and prevent quality issues before they reach clients.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CEO and department heads, and prioritise improvements by impact and effort.

Tool Development & Platform Engineering

* Design, build and maintain internal tools and applications that enhance the performance of each department, from data layer through to API and user interface.
* Integrate tools with the systems our teams already use, such as Google Workspace, Odoo, and other AI-powered tools, so that solutions fit naturally into existing workflows usable by department personnel.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and keep internal tools documented and easy to hand over.

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
* Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

* Support teams in adopting new tools and processes through clear documentation, training and hands-on support.
* Define and track metrics that show whether each change is improving department performance, and iterate based on results and user feedback.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for standardisation and automation as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
* Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM or other AI/ML-based solutions.
* Proven ability to analyse business processes and translate them into practical software or automation solutions.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear UI/UX requirements (user flows, screens, states, edge cases) and to evaluate and refine interfaces until they are intuitive for non-technical users.
* Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with non-technical colleagues, understand their needs, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem from diagnosis through to a deployed, maintained solution.
* Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience building AI tools that work with documents, such as searching, summarising, extracting or checking text (e.g. RAG, vector databases, NLP).
* Experience with Google Workspace APIs and workflow-automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make).
* Knowledge of process-improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or business process mapping.
* Experience in consultancy or professional-services environments, particularly in document-heavy work such as proposal or report writing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Relocation & Bureaucracy Support: Dedicated guidance and administrative assistance for obtaining your Spanish NIE, social security, and local residency registration in Las Palmas.
* Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model (4 days onsite / 1 day WFH) + 20 extra remote working days per year to use at your convenience.

* Company Culture: Regular team-building events, social activities, and a vibrant work environment in a co-working space just 50 meters from the beach in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.

title: Director of Product Management – AI & Platform Capabilities
description:
**Nombre de vacante**

Director of Product Management – AI & Platform Capabilities

  

**Descripción**

About the role
  
  
Help shape how AI transforms the work of small businesses, accountants and bookkeepers.
  
  
As Director of Product Management, Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity, you will own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of shared capabilities that connect trusted data, systems and agents to enable world-class AI-driven experiences across Sage and its ecosystem.
  
  
We want you to help us see where these technologies can make the biggest difference: saving customers time, helping them grow their businesses, improving their day-to-day work and making their lives easier. You will set a clear direction, make informed investment choices and turn that direction into capabilities and experiences that deliver measurable value.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated group of Product Managers and Product Owners, partnering with Product Management leaders, Engineers, Architects and UX Designers to deliver reusable platform capabilities. You will balance ambition with practical delivery, customer trust and the cost of operating AI at scale.
  
  
This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week in our Barcelona office.

  

**Responsabilidades principales**

Key accountabilities
  
  
Set the strategy and direction
  
- Own and evolve the product vision, strategy and roadmap for Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity, aligned with Sage’s wider product and business priorities.
  
- Identify where Sage should invest, experiment, scale or stop. Make clear choices about the customer problems to solve and the capabilities needed to solve them.
  
- Bring an informed perspective on emerging AI technologies, market developments and ecosystem opportunities. Distinguish promising experiments from capabilities ready for dependable use at scale.
  
  
Connect opportunity with customer value
  
- Build a deep understanding of critical Accounting, Payroll and HR journeys, including how accountants and bookkeepers support small businesses.
  
- Work with product teams, research and design to identify opportunities to remove repetitive work, improve decisions and help customers complete tasks with confidence.
  
- Balance time savings, quality and ease of use with delivery effort and ongoing cost. Choose the appropriate approach for each problem, whether AI, machine learning or established automation.
  
  
Build intelligence that scales
  
- Define the direction for Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity capabilities, enabling teams to build consistent AI experiences using shared capabilities rather than duplicating effort across products.
  
- Partner with Architecture and Engineering on the capabilities needed for agents and workflows, customer context, data access, integration, evaluation and monitoring.
  
- Make adoption practical through clear onboarding, documentation, integration patterns and a strong developer experience. Understand product team needs and use their feedback to improve the Factory.
  
- Work with partner and developer teams to enable appropriate external use of capabilities through secure APIs and tools, including MCP, where this supports the strategy.
  
  
Own delivery and the economics of AI
  
- Translate strategy into a prioritised roadmap with clear customer outcomes, milestones, dependencies and accountable owners. Align shared capability delivery with product launches.
  
- Lead decisions on priorities and trade-offs with Product, Architecture and Engineering. Resolve blockers, manage dependencies and communicate mitigation plans when delivery is at risk.
  
- Own the product investment case and track operating costs alongside benefits. Assess model and infrastructure choices with technical teams, including build, buy and reuse decisions.
  
- Set measurable success criteria before delivery and evaluate results after launch. Track customer adoption, task completion, time saved, quality, reliability and cost per successful task; use the evidence to improve or stop investments.
  
  
Deliver experiences customers can trust
  
- Embed responsible AI, privacy, security and appropriate controls into product decisions, working with Sage’s specialist teams and established governance.
  
- Ensure AI actions respect existing customer permissions and access rights. Define where customers need visibility, confirmation or control over automation and agent actions.
  
- Agree quality and evaluation expectations with technical teams, including accuracy, failure handling and monitoring, before capabilities are released and scaled.
  
- Lead people and influence across Sage
  
- Lead, coach and develop a dedicated group of product managers and product owners, setting clear expectations for product judgement, delivery and outcomes.
  
- Build strong relationships across Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, UX and commercial teams. Securing agreement on priorities, adoption, commitments and ownership.
  
- Communicate the strategy, evidence and decisions clearly to senior leaders, teams and partners. Encourage challenge and feedback, and build alignment through change.
  
  
What you will bring
  
  
Essential experience and capabilities
  
- Senior product leadership: Experience owning strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a complex platform or technical product portfolio at Director level or equivalent.
  
- Production AI delivery: A track record of launching and scaling AI capabilities, including generative AI or agentic experiences, with measurable improvements in quality, adoption and cost.
  
- Platform product management: Experience building shared capabilities that multiple teams or partners adopt to deliver valuable customer experiences.
  
- Technical fluency: Confidence working with engineers and architects on AI systems, APIs, integrations, data access and cloud platforms to assess feasibility and make informed trade-offs.
  
- People leadership: Experience developing product managers or product owners, strengthening their judgement and accountability for outcomes.
  
- Customer and commercial judgement: The ability to connect platform investment to customer needs, build credible business cases and prioritise competing opportunities.
  
- Leadership across boundaries: A record of resolving complex trade-offs and securing commitment across teams and senior stakeholders.
  
- Practical AI fluency: Hands-on use of AI tools for discovery, prototyping and analysis, with sound judgement about their outputs and limitations.
  
  
Additional experience that would be valuable
  
- Building agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, AI evaluation or observability capabilities, or developer platforms for AI.
  
- Working with MCP, secure tool access, agent interoperability or external developer and partner ecosystems.
  
- Delivering products where sensitive data, financial accuracy, permissions and auditability are central to customer trust.
  
- Experience in accounting, fintech, payroll, HR or software for small businesses and professional practices.
  
- Scaling shared capabilities across products, markets or complex technology estates.
  
  
What success looks like
  
- Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity has a clear strategy and an agreed roadmap, with investment connected to priority customer and business outcomes.
  
- Product teams and partners can adopt shared capabilities more quickly and confidently, with increasing reuse and less duplicated effort.
  
- AI experiences deliver measurable improvements in the work customers do, including successful task completion, time saved and confidence in the result.
  
- Connectivity enables valuable workflows across Sage and its ecosystem, with clear access controls and a dependable developer experience.
  
- Quality, reliability and operating costs are understood and actively managed as adoption grows.
  
- The product managers and product owners have clear ownership, grow their capability and deliver effectively with their engineering, architecture, design and product partners.
  
  
At Sage, we offer you an environment where you can grow professionally without compromising your personal well-being. Our benefits package is designed to provide stability, flexibility, and balance:
  
- Medical and dental insurance: Fully funded medical and dental insurance.
  
- Flexible benefits: Exchange part of your salary and make tax savings on meal and transport vouchers, childcare, and training.
  
- Well-being: Free access to the Calm app (for up to 5 users), 24/7 counselling, and emotional support from our Healthy Mind Coaches. We also offer self-care and parenting resources through the Cleo app.
  
- Flexible working: flexibility of working one hour in, one hour out, shortened workdays on Fridays and during the summer, and the opportunity to work from over 40 countries for up to 10 weeks per year through our Work Away program.
  
- Annual leave: 23 working days of vacation, 5 paid days per year for volunteering.

- Learning and development: Free premium subscription to external learning platforms
  
  
Health and Safety Responsibilities

This role requires high attention to clients needs, self education and self organization. This role will form part of our global team, and will work closely with Operations, Trading Team, Sales, and Management.

* Accurately identify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) and Directors of Corporate clients, and gather all relevant details in line with internal policies

* Conduct screening and due diligence checks (e.g. Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media), and resolve any potential matches or flags
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and internal standards, as well as external industry best practices

* Perform risk assessments for all customers and follow the company's approval and escalation protocols

title: Group Product Manager (Core)
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike's Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.

In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike's product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.

### **Your Impact:**

* Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike's Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
* Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
* Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
* Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
* Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
* Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
* Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
* Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
* People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
* Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.

### **Standout Qualities:**

* Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
* Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
* Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
* Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.

### **Our Work Style:**

* Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
* Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike's most important product areas.
* People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
* AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
* High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike's product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

### **What's Next?**

* Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives
* Home task
* Final interview with the CPO

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

#### **Our culture and Values**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.
