title: KAM Senior
description:
Somos una de las marcas de mayor crecimiento en España en el cuidado del hogar.

Buscamos un/a **Key Account Manager (KAM) Senior** para liderar nuestra expansión en el canal moderno en España. Una oportunidad para construir, con mucha autonomía, el siguiente capítulo de una marca que está cambiando las reglas de la categoría.

Fabricamos en España, tenemos presencia en varios países europeos y ya trabajamos con cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados. Ahora toca ir a por más: nuevos lineales, más referencias y más cuota de lineal en las cuentas actuales.

**Por qué este puesto es especial**
-----------------------------------

* **Impacto real y visible:** tu trabajo se traduce directamente en crecimiento de la marca, desde el primer trimestre.
* **Marca con producto diferencial:** vendes un producto innovador, con una historia potente y diferente a todo lo que hay en el lineal.
* **Autonomía y confianza:** equipo pequeño, decisiones rápidas y acceso directo a la dirección. Nada de burocracia.
* **Visión completa:** trabajarás codo con codo con el Director Comercial en la estrategia de trade marketing, y con datos de mercado para argumentar cada negociación.
* **Crecimiento:** una marca en expansión europea que necesita a alguien que crezca con ella.

**Tus responsabilidades**
-------------------------

* Gestionar y desarrollar la cartera de cuentas clave del canal moderno (supermercados, hipermercados y cadenas regionales), con revisiones comerciales periódicas para supervisar el rendimiento y la ejecución.
* Negociar y cerrar acuerdos comerciales y contratos, y hacer seguimiento de la facturación.
* Abrir nuevas cuentas y conseguir la entrada en nuevos lineales, así como ampliar referencias y cuota de lineal en las cuentas existentes.
* Preparar presentaciones para compradores apoyadas en datos de mercado para demostrar potencial de ventas y distribución.
* Analizar de forma continua la posición competitiva y del cliente, y definir junto al Director Comercial la estrategia y acciones de trade marketing a corto y largo plazo.
* Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de los distintos canales de distribución.
* Coordinarte con finanzas, operaciones y administración para asegurar un servicio excelente al cliente.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

**Requisitos**

* Mínimo **4 años de experiencia como KAM** (o rol equivalente) en **productos de droguería / limpieza del hogar en canal moderno**.
* Conocimiento del sector y relación con compradores de cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados en España.
* Experiencia demostrable en negociación comercial y cierre de acuerdos con retail.
* Capacidad analítica para trabajar con datos de ventas y construir argumentos comerciales.
* Residencia en **Barcelona o Madrid**.

**Competencias**

* Dominio de técnicas de venta y negociación.
* Gran capacidad para gestionar el tiempo y priorizar; automotivación.
* Capaz de asumir responsabilidad y resolver retos de forma creativa.

**Cómo trabajamos**
-------------------

Somos un equipo joven, ambicioso y con ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Tenemos base en Barcelona y trabajamos con un modelo remote-first: buscamos a la persona en **Barcelona o Madrid**, con encuentros presenciales con el equipo que acordaremos juntos.

Aquí cada persona es una pieza clave en su función. Si quieres jugar en la liga grande de una marca que está creciendo rápido, ¡queremos conocerte!

title: Product Director (Midcore Direction)
description:
**Who are we?**
---------------

**Tripledot** **Studios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

**This role is based within our studio, Belka Games**
-----------------------------------------------------

Belka Games is a game development company ranked by Sensor Tower among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe. Our games have reached more than 110 million players worldwide

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a **Product Director** to lead and strengthen our **Midcore Direction**. The key goal at the current stage is a successful global launch of our game Train of Hope and its further scaling.

As part of the Belka Games leadership team, you will contribute to the company’s broader product strategy and long-term development.

The role includes responsibility for the product strategy and business performance of Train of Hope, including its revenue, profitability, long-term product value, and investment efficiency. You will also build a strong product team and look for new growth opportunities for the game, from the best solutions on the market to IP collaborations and partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Part 1 - Product ownership and global launch**

* Define and implement the product strategy and long-term vision for Train of Hope: target audience, positioning, core gameplay pillars, and a 1-3 year development horizon
* Own the preparation and execution of the global launch: target KPIs and readiness criteria, go/no-go decisions, the launch plan together with Marketing and Development, and post-launch scaling
* Drive the business performance of the direction, including revenue growth, profitability, long-term product value, and investment efficiency
* Drive improvements in long-term retention, engagement, payer conversion, ARPPU, monetization, LTV, and other key product and business metrics
* Drive an AI-first approach to content production: introduce AI tools to automate and optimize the creation of locations, characters, art, text, and localization, reducing production time and cost without compromising quality
* Grow higher-margin monetization and distribution channels, including direct-to-consumer sales
* Balance short-term priorities with long-term product investments and allocate team resources accordingly
* Make decisions on the launch, scaling, iteration, or termination of in-game features and product initiatives
* Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of product updates together with the Development Director and Producers, and reduce product and technical risks of server-side and social features
* Build transparent cross-functional decision-making processes and align Product, Game Design, Narrative, Art, Development, Analytics, Marketing, and Finance around shared goals and priorities
* Partner with the CMO on player acquisition and re-engagement economics and UA scaling decisions for the global launch, taking into account the longer payback of midcore audiences
* Partner with the Belka Games leadership team on the company’s product strategy and long-term development
* Hire and develop strong product leaders and key specialists with midcore expertise (meta and combat design, competitive economy, narrative), and build an autonomous and scalable team

### **Part 2 - Market research and new growth opportunities**

* Continuously research the midcore market, audience, and competitors: successful mechanics, LiveOps and monetization practices, genre and setting trends, and changes in user acquisition costs
* Identify successful solutions on the market and adapt them for Train of Hope, managing a pipeline of in-game hypotheses and experiments
* Source and evaluate IP collaborations for Train of Hope: selecting IPs and partners, building the business case, integrating collaborations into content and LiveOps, and measuring their impact on acquisition, retention, and revenue
* Evaluate other growth opportunities for the game: new markets and localizations, new platforms, partnerships and cross-promotion, new game modes and content formats
* Apply a data-informed and hypothesis-driven approach to prioritizing and validating new opportunities
* Define success criteria in advance and evaluate initiatives against relevant midcore product, market, and business benchmarks
* Develop business cases for major initiatives and partnerships, including the opportunity, expected impact, required resources, timelines, and key risks
* Systematize learnings from experiments, collaborations, and post-release analysis of content and features, scale effective practices, and eliminate ineffective approaches

**Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
--------------------------------------------

* Senior product leadership experience in the games industry as a Product Director, Head of Product, Executive Producer, or in a comparable role
* Strong experience with live mobile F2P midcore games (e.g. RPG, strategy, 4X, battlers), including soft launch, global launch, and subsequent scaling
* Proven experience defining and implementing product strategy
* Experience owning product business performance and allocating investment and resources
* Strong analytical and business skills, including experience building business cases and making data-informed product and investment decisions
* Deep understanding of midcore meta, progression, hero and collection systems, game economies, social and competitive features (guilds/alliances, PvP), LiveOps, and F2P monetization, with proven experience improving long-term retention, monetization, revenue, profitability, and product health
* Experience building autonomous cross-functional teams and hiring and developing senior Product Managers, Game Producers, or other product leaders
* Excellent leadership, communication, cross-functional management, and stakeholder alignment skills
* Ability to make clear decisions in uncertain conditions and take ownership of their business consequences
* Fluent in English and Russian

**Would Be a Plus**

* Experience with narrative-driven or content-heavy games and managing a regular content production pipeline
* Experience with IP collaborations, partnerships, or licensed projects
* Hands-on experience introducing AI tools into game content production

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* A successful global launch of Train of Hope that meets target product and business metrics
* Sustainable growth of key metrics after launch
* A predictable content and LiveOps cadence with production costs that pay off
* An established process for finding and implementing new growth opportunities for the game, including IP collaborations
* A strong, autonomous product team with midcore expertise
* Increased maturity and effectiveness of the product function across the company

**Working at Tripledot**
------------------------

* **Hybrid Working:** We work in the office 4 days a week
* **25 days paid holiday** in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
* **20 days remote working:** Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year
* **Regular company events and rewards:** Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit
* **Private Medical Cover:** Have peace of mind with private medical cover, ensuring your health is in good hands
* **Life & Critical Illness Cover:** Protect your future with our life and critical illness cover
* **Family Forming Support:** Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]
* **Employee Assistance Program:** Access confidential support anytime through our Employee Assistance Program
* **Sport Compensation:** Stay fit and active with our sport compensation benefit
* **Meal and Transport Vouchers:** Save on meals and transport with our convenient vouchers
* **English & Spanish Classes:** Enhance your English and Spanish skills with our provided language classes
* **Continuous Professional Development:** Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development

title: Senior Manager, Antibot Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

At NIQ Digital shelf, scraping isn’t just about collecting data, it’s about **outsmarting the obstacles** that stand in the way of visibility. Every day, we process **tens of billions of data points** from thousands of sources, both web and mobile, and transform them into actionable insights for the world’s top retailers and brands.

You'll join a team of **60+ scrapers**, engineers, analysts, and data lovers from across the globe. As part of our scraping and R&D team, you’ll have space to **experiment, push boundaries**, and bring bold ideas to life. You’ll collaborate closely with **Customer Success**, **Operations**, and **Data** to ensure we extract high-quality, actionable data — fast and at scale.

 **Job Description**

**The Role**

The Senior Manager, Antibot Engineering takes leadership responsibility for a defined part of the Antibot Engineering organization. Based in Spain and reporting to the Director of Antibot Engineering, this leader manages a distributed team located in Western Europe and Algeria. The geographic footprint describes where the team is located, not a regional mandate: the role contributes to the global Antibot Engineering mission and priorities.

This is a senior people-leadership role with three core accountabilities: building and developing a strong engineering team; prioritizing retailer work in line with business requirements; and driving an R&D roadmap that improves the effectiveness, durability, and scalability of Antibot capabilities. The leader works across Web Data Acquisition, Product, Engineering, Operations, and business stakeholders to turn demand into clear engineering choices and measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Do**

**Lead part of the global Antibot Engineering organization**

* Own the people, delivery, and technical outcomes of an assigned part of the global Antibot Engineering organization.
* Translate the Director of Antibot Engineering’s strategy into clear team objectives, priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
* Balance retailer unblocking and long-term R&D projects.
* Provide clear visibility into retailer priorities, R&D progress, capacity, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs.

**Drive retailer prioritization and engineering execution**

* Establish a transparent prioritization process that converts business requirements, customer impact, operational risk, and technical dependencies into an executable retailer backlog.
* Partner with business, product, delivery, and operations stakeholders to clarify demand, challenge assumptions, resolve priority conflicts, and communicate trade-offs.
* Ensure prioritized retailer unblocking work is planned, staffed, tracked, and delivered with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Balance urgent retailer needs with platform development, solution durability, technical debt, and longer-term engineering capacity.

**Lead, develop, and retain the team**

* Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers across the distributed team in Western Europe and Algeria.
* Set clear expectations, strengthen accountability, and create an inclusive environment that supports learning, collaboration, and retention.
* Own team workforce and capability planning, including hiring, onboarding, succession, and development of critical Antibot expertise.
* Create effective operating rhythms for planning, reviews, risk management, and communication.

**Drive the Antibot R&D roadmap**

* Own and drive an R&D roadmap for the assigned Antibot scope, aligned with the technical direction set by the Director of Antibot Engineering.
* Identify research and engineering opportunities that improve capability, automation, scalability, maintainability, and resilience.
* Turn experiments and technical learning into clear investment recommendations, reusable solutions, and production adoption plans.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, web data acquisition, applied R&D, or a related technology field.
* 3+ years of people-management experience, including leadership of experienced engineers, technical leads, managers, or multiple teams.
* Demonstrated accountability for engineering delivery and production services in a complex, high-change environment.
* Experience with distributed systems, cloud platforms, automation, observability, incident management, and engineering quality practices.
* Strong organizational leadership, prioritization, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to lead across countries and cultures and to influence teams outside the direct reporting line.
* Professional fluency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with web scraping, reverse engineering, or large-scale data collection.
* Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams in Europe and/or North Africa.
* Knowledge of antibot solutions, CDN or WAF.
* Experience driving operating-model change, automation, platform adoption, or engineering transformation.

**Success Measures**

* A capable, engaged, and accountable engineering team with clear goals, development plans, and succession coverage.
* Retailer priorities that are traceable to business requirements and delivered with transparent trade-offs and predictable execution.
* An R&D roadmap that produces reusable improvements in Antibot capability, automation, durability, and scale.
* Clear ownership, metrics, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
* Effective adoption of global platforms and reduction of avoidable regional duplication.

title: Consultor/a de Integraciones Laborales
description:
DESCRIPCIóN

Desde ISPROX, buscamos un/a **Consultor/a de Integraciones Laborales** para unirse a un consolidado grupo de servicios profesionales.

Formarás parte del Core Team de integraciones de un importante grupo de servicios profesionales consolidado con más de 60 años de trayectoria que, respaldado por un fondo americano, se encuentra en un momento clave de expansión. Con un plan de crecimiento de unas 10-15 adquisiciones de despachos al año, tu misión será gestionar la transición, homogeneización y migración operativa del área laboral de las compañías adquiridas hacia la estructura central del grupo.

No es un rol de gestión de nóminas del día a día; es un puesto estratégico-operativo de consultoría interna enfocado en proyectos de absorción y despliegue tecnológico.

**Tus principales retos y funciones:**

* Mapeo y Migración de Datos: Coordinar y ejecutar el traspaso masivo de históricos, fichas de trabajadores, conceptos salariales y variables desde los sistemas de los despachos adquiridos hacia el entorno centralizado del grupo.
* Estandarización Tecnológica: Asegurar la correcta implantación y configuración del ecosistema A3 en las nuevas delegaciones, optimizando los flujos de trabajo e integrando herramientas de control horario o portales del empleado.
* Auditoría Laboral (Due Diligence Operativa): Analizar el estado de las plantillas absorbidas, convenios colectivos de origen, pactos de empresa y contingencias para asegurar el cumplimiento del Art. 44 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores (Subrogación).
* Soporte Operativo Crítico: Dar apoyo directo en la confección y validación de nóminas, seguros sociales (Sistema RED) y declaraciones durante los meses críticos de transición para garantizar impacto cero en los trabajadores.
* Gestión de Proyectos (PMO): Asegurar el cumplimiento de los deadlines de cada integración, reportando hitos y riesgos al Director de Integraciones.

**¿Qué pueden ofrecerte?**

* Incorporación a un grupo empresarial con más de 60 años en activo, en un momento clave de crecimiento, expansión y automatización.
* Contrato indefinido a jornada completa de 9h a 18h y viernes hasta las 15h con 1 día de teletrabajo a la semana.
* Retribución de aprox. 40.000€ bruto anual, según perfil

REQUISITOS

**¿Qué buscamos en ti?**

* Experiencia: Mínimo 3-5 años en departamentos de Laboral Outsourcing, BPO Laboral en Big4/Tier 2 o asesorías de gran volumen, gestionando migraciones o integraciones de carteras.
* Dominio experto del ecosistema A3 (A3innuva / A3asesor). Valorable conocimiento en otras plataformas del mercado.
* Conocimientos técnicos: Sólida base en legislación laboral (subrogaciones, homogeneización de condiciones, cálculo de nóminas y finiquitos) y gestión de plataformas públicas (Sistema RED, Contrat@, Delta).
* Metodología: Familiaridad con gestión de proyectos y herramientas de seguimiento. Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas de cruce de datos masivos). Muy valorable conocimientos de PMP y Agile.
* Soft Skills: Orientación a hitos y resultados, alta capacidad de adaptación al cambio, interlocución fluida y resiliencia.

title: Digital Operations Team Lead - Music Rights & Royalties
description:
What you will be doing

As an Operations Team Lead, you will play a central role in guiding and empowering the Digital Operations team to deliver on its objectives. Reporting to the Head of Digital Operations and acting as their deputy, you will lead the team’s day-to-day work and oversee execution across core DSP processing and reporting pipelines, ensuring high-quality data exchange, timely royalty allocations, and strict compliance with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Your contributions will directly shape how the team runs and how we deliver DSP Processing and Reporting for our clients , making you an integral part of our team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Execute the workflows and priorities set with the Head of Digital Operations, collaborating with Business Line, Engineering, and the wider Operations team, including operational support and communication with all of our DSP Processing and Reporting clients.
* Act as deputy to the Head of Digital Operations, covering for them when needed and making operational decisions on behalf of the team. Serve as the primary escalation point for the Operations Specialist team, triaging complex queries related to catalog ingest, matching exceptions, and output generation.
* Manage agreed business priorities, task allocations, and daily operational workflows for the Digital Operations Specialist team.
* Coordinate end-to-end DSP processing cycles across major platforms (including YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, and SoundCloud).
* Oversee the organization and maintenance of strict delivery schedules.
* Mentor and train team members, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and continuous learning environment.
* Manage pre-distribution calculations, conflict resolution lifecycles, and claiming output generation

### **Collaboration and Team Dynamics**

You will work closely with the Head of Digital Operations to plan priorities, track team performance, and continuously improve how we operate. You will also collaborate with Business Line, Engineering, Product, and Partnership teams to optimize system reliability and operational scale. These collaborations are pivotal for achieving our organizational goals and ensuring effective communication and alignment across different areas of the company.

 **Requirements**

All about you

* Preferably 5+ years of experience in Music Industry Operations.
* Experience in managing a team or related roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Demonstrate understanding of music copyrights principles, practices, and relevant regulations.
* Deep familiarity with music metadata standards, Common Works Registration (CWR), DDEX Digital Sales Reports (DSRs), etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational requirements clearly across diverse global teams.
* Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze large volumes of usage data, diagnose root causes of operational discrepancies, and design efficient process solutions.
* Proficiency working with complex data platforms (YouTube CMS/Content ID), Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets, SQL querying, and SFTP data exchange protocol.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Demonstrate adaptability and openness to feedback and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and high-stakes client deadlines.
* Fluency in English. Proficiency in Spanish and Catalan is highly appreciated, but not mandatory.
* The role is located in Barcelona. Local candidates are preferred, but remote work arrangements may be considered.

### **Expectations of the role**

Within 30 Days:

During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarizing yourself with essential aspects of the role and supporting foundational tasks.

* Familiarize yourself thoroughly with BMAT’s core operating platforms and DSP processing lifecycle standards.
* Align with the Head of Digital Operations on team priorities, ways of working, and responsibilities.
* Establish working relationships with direct reports and key cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships.
* Assume day-to-day oversight of operational queues and SLA tracking for core processing clients

Within 60 Days:

By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team and strategic initiatives.

* Autonomously manage daily task distribution, priority queues, and technical escalations for the Digital Operations team.
* Lead high-priority client distribution cycles, ensuring 100% on-time delivery of claim files, pre-distribution reports, and DIF files.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement automated matching QA rules and streamline conflict resolution tracking.
* Facilitate the transition of routine client invoicing workflows from Partnerships to Operations in collaboration with Finance.

Within 90 Days:

At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to autonomously manage tasks, contribute to strategic planning, and take on leadership roles as appropriate.

* Autonomously manage team operations, performance evaluations, continuous training, and skill development.
* Drive measurable improvements in operational throughput, team capacity, and SLA compliance across all Tier 1 and Tier 2 DSP accounts.
* Represent Digital Operations in cross-departmental readiness reviews and platform feature validations.

  
**Benefits**  

### **You Can Enjoy**

* Flexible working hours and location
* Flat hierarchy
* You can make the role your own and run your own development
* Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
* Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
* We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
* Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/  

  

### **Who the FAQ are BMAT**

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

*Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.*

title: Demand Partnership Manager
description:

Our mission is to design comprehensive advertising solutions based on creativity and technology to ensure brand value within the advertising ecosystem and relevance for agencies, media, and users; offering advertisers the right audience in a safe and brand privacy-respecting environment.

We want to be the trusted partner of brands, amplifying their stories across media through enriching advertising experiences that challenge convention and raise industry standards.

This is a full remote role that could be located anywhere.

As a Demand Partnerships Manager at EXTE, you will play a key role in expanding our global demand ecosystem and unlocking new revenue opportunities. **About the School - The British School of Barcelona (City):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2,350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in several locations across the Barcelona area, including Castelldefels and Sitges, as well as our campuses in the heart of Barcelona: BSB Esperança, offering Early Years and Year 1, and BSB City (Luca), offering Primary, Secondary and Pre-University education.
  
  
In September 2026, we opened a new campus north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area, initially welcoming EYFS and Primary-aged students.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of-the-art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Learning Support Assistant** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 86 schools in 21 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking a **temporary, part-time Learning Support Assistant** to join our team at BSB City campus from **8th January 2027**.
  
  
The ideal candidate will support the education and social development of pupils under the direction of the Headteacher, Director of Student Support, Learning Support Lead and class teachers.
  
  
As a Learning Assistant at BSB, you will form part of the Learning Support Team. You will be required to demonstrate an informed and efficient approach to teaching and learning by adopting relevant strategies to support the work of the teachers and increase achievement of all pupils, including those with special educational needs and disabilities.
  
  
The appointed Learning Assistant will need a proven excellent track-record of:
  

* Demonstrating an understanding of how young children best learn.
* Communicating effectively and sensitively with pupils to adapt to their needs and support their learning.
* Contributing to effective assessment and planning by supporting the monitoring, recording and reporting of pupil performance and progress as appropriate to the level of the role.
* Knowing each individual child and supporting teachers to adapt teaching and learning to meet the specific needs of each pupil.
* Maintaining an interactive and inspiring learning environment.
* Ensuring well-being is at the heart of our provision.
* Having good interpersonal skills and able to work well as part of a team.
* Being committed to on-going professional development.

A commitment to the wider life of the school, and our enrichment programme, is an expectation of the job.

We require:
  

* English: advanced.
* Qualification in support teaching and/or working with children with special educational needs.
* Minimum 2 years of experience providing support in teaching (desirable).

  
**Benefits at Cognita:**
  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.

* An opportunity to learn new skills.

title: Director of CRM & Patient Lifecycle Operations
description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

##### **The Mission**

At Impress, we don't just provide orthodontics; we run a world-class operations and CRM engine. As the **Director of CRM & Lifecycle Operations**, you will own the entire patient journey—from the moment a lead is acquired to their final treatment result and beyond.

Your goal is to build a seamless, "always-on" communication ecosystem that maximizes funnel efficiency. You will leverage our existing **AI Voice and Text Agents**, scaling them to the next level to ensure that every patient interaction is personalized, timely, and high-converting.

##### **Location**

This position is **based on-site at our headquarters in Barcelona (Spain)**. You’ll be working closely with our international marketing team in a dynamic, collaborative office environment.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

***End-to-End Journey Orchestration***

Design and optimize the full patient lifecycle across all touchpoints (Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and Voice). You will be responsible for the transition between every key stage:

* **Acquisition & Lead Nurturing**: Turning interest into booked appointments.
* **Show-up Optimization**: Using behavioral triggers to ensure clinic attendance.
* **Patient Experience**: Managing the "in-treatment" journey to ensure clinical compliance and satisfaction.
* **Upselling & Advocacy**: Driving post-treatment value through retainers, whitening, and referrals.

***Next-Gen AI & Automation Leadership***

Impress is already at the forefront of AI. You will take ownership of our **AI Text and Voice Agents**, moving them beyond basic automation to sophisticated, human-like interactions. You will lead the strategy for how AI handles lead qualification, appointment rescheduling, and FAQ handling to 10x our operational capacity.

***Cross-Functional Command***

You are the glue between departments. You will work in the trenches with:

* **Marketing:** To align top-of-funnel messaging with lifecycle nurturing.
* **Booking Conversion Team:** To optimize the "Lead-to-Clinic" bridge.
* **Sales & Clinic Teams:** To ensure digital communications perfectly sync with human follow-ups and in-person experiences.
* **Omnichannel Funnel Efficiency:** Relentlessly audit and improve our multi-channel reach. You will decide when a patient needs an automated WhatsApp nudge, a personalized email, or a call from our AI Voice agent, ensuring we reduce Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) while maximizing Life Time Value (LTV).

##### **Who You Are**

* **The Architect:** You have 7+ years of experience building complex lifecycles in high-growth D2C, Health-Tech, or FinTech environments.
* **AI-Forward:** You aren't afraid of the future. You have experience (or a deep strategic interest) in deploying Conversational AI (LLMs, Voice Synthesis) to automate customer interactions.
* **Master of Orchestration:** You understand that a WhatsApp message must complement—not duplicate—a phone call. You thrive on managing "Online-to-Offline" (O2O) journeys.
* **Data-Driven Leader:** You speak the language of conversion rates, cohort analysis, and attribution. You use data to tell the story of where the funnel is leaking and how to fix it.

title: Account Manager
description:
Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.

### **The Role**

Are you a highly driven sales "hunter" who thrives on the thrill of the chase? Do you love opening closed doors, building pipeline from scratch, and winning net-new logos?

As an **Account Manager** with the EMEA GTM Team, you will be a driving force behind Everseen's market expansion. You won't just wait for leads; you will map out the enterprise retail territory, aggressively prospect decision-makers, and win new partners using our state-of-the-art Vision AI platform. If you have a passion for disruptive technology and a hunger to win, this is your next destination.

**At Everseen, you won't just be selling a product; you'll be a trusted partner to the world's leading retailers, helping them solve challenges with cutting-edge Vision AI.**

### **What You'll Do**

* **Hunt Net-New Logos:** Build, execute, and own outbound sales campaigns to break into major target grocery and retail accounts across the EMEA region.
* **Self-Source Pipeline:** Drive multi-channel prospecting (cold outreach, networking, social selling, industry events) to build and maintain a healthy, high-velocity sales pipeline from scratch.

* **Collaborative Landing & Expansion:** Seamlessly partner with Everseen’s Product, Engineering, and Operations (Customer Delivery) teams to guarantee successful Proof of Concepts (POCs) that lock in new long-term contracts.
* **Maintain Sales Hygiene:** Take ownership of accurate pipeline forecasting and CRM data discipline (Salesforce/HubSpot) to ensure clear reporting directly to senior leadership.

### **Collaborating With**

Senior sales team, product, engineering, operations (customer delivery) teams

### **Profile and Skills**

* **Experience:** 4-7 years of proven success in a **high-growth enterprise SaaS sales hunter or new-business acquisition role**—specifically targeting large retail, grocery, or complex operational environments in EMEA.
* **Sourcing Prowess:** A demonstrated history of **self-sourcing pipeline** and consistently meeting or exceeding net-new revenue targets.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree required. Sales methodology training (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger Sales, SPIN) is highly desirable.

* **Hunter Mentality:**

  + *Strategic Prospecting:* Skilled at mapping complex retail corporate hierarchies, identifying key champions, and engaging C-level decision-makers.
* **Value-Based Selling:** Exceptionally strong business acumen and data literacy. You don't just sell features; you build deep business cases around asset protection, shrink reduction, and operational efficiency to demonstrate immediate ROI.
* **Competencies:**
  + *Ownership & Drive:* Relentless drive for results, owning the new business outcome from the first touch to the signed contract.
  + *Problem Solving:* Ability to navigate long sales cycles and pivot strategy when facing roadblocks.
  + *Collaboration:* Brings cross-functional internal resources together effectively to orchestrate a winning deal.

**About****Everseen**

Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience.

Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily.

Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world - including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths - we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain.

We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.

  

Our Culture

Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions.

We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact.

  

Our Values

We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses.

We ARE CUSTOMER-FIRST. They guide our decisions.

We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit.

We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality.

We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact.

**Our Commitment**
------------------

title: AI Native Right Hand of the CEO - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.

If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming **the AI-native right hand of our CEO** is for you.

**This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job.**

Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10.

At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO.

**But wait a minute.**

**Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…**

* **Freedom:** working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver
* **Ambition:** building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week
* **Impact:** changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale

Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX**
-----------------------------------

In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it.

**Our company has to be able to:**

* **Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting.
* **Turn every decision into execution.** A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it.
* **Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents.
* **Ship.** Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live.
* **Measure with real KPIs.** Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity.
* **Learn and loop on its own.** Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week.

**This is already real.** Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice.

**But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY?**
------------------------------------------

**We believe self-help is broken.** Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

They deserve more than content and more than motivation.

They deserve **a system that knows them**, one that adapts, challenges and grows with them.

That’s why we merge:

* **Human Intelligence** (coaches, peers and mentors)
* **Structured Intelligence** (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* **Technological Intelligence** (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

into one seamless ecosystem: **Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI.**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included.

**Here’s the bet:** A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

And that’s where you come in.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

**Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company.**

Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches.

The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1 - Be the CEO’s operating system**

* **The old way:** a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand.
* **At Paradox:** you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call.
* You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination.

### **2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents**

Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic projects you could own:

* **Growth:** run experiments with agents that generate, ship and measure them
* **Partnerships & sponsorships:** find and close partners aligned with our brand, for our YouTube channel and events
* **International:** build the machine that turns our French content into English, and open new countries
* **Launches:** take a new offer or product from idea to live
* **People:** find and assess the rare people who join a team of fewer than 10

* **The old way:** each new initiative needs a team, a roadmap and three months.
* **At Paradox:** one person with the right agents launches an offer, a channel or a country without disrupting the core. That’s what our Pirate Squad means now.

### **3 - Build AI-native operations**

* **The old way:** an ops manager processes invoices, chases contracts, onboards people and answers the same support questions every week.
* **At Paradox:** finance, legal, HR, admin and customer support each get their agents, their context, their KPIs and their loop. You write the skills, plug them into our tools and write the evals that define "good": a reconciliation that matches to the cent, a contract that respects our playbook, an answer a member is happy with.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. An agent moves up a level only when its track record earns it.
* **Example:** in your first month, you build the agent that reconciles payments, refunds and failed charges every night. In month one it only reports. By month three it fixes the simple cases alone, and you only see the exceptions.

### **4 - Strategy and business intelligence that check themselves**

* **The old way:** someone builds dashboards in a BI tool, exports them to a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody fully trusts the numbers.
* **At Paradox:** agents watch revenue, cash, acquisition, retention, churn and competitors continuously, find where our sources disagree, and explain what changed and why.
* **Strategy:** screen markets and competition, build growth models, explore business models, partnerships and acquisitions. Then challenge, formalize and ensure good execution of the strategy.
* At Paradox things move fast, and our CEO is always reading business books and meeting great entrepreneurs. You’ll turn the best strategies and tactics into systems and agents the whole company uses.

### **5 - Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* **The old way:** lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* **At Paradox:** every decision, result and lesson goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before acting. The company never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: the share of work done without a human, the time from decision to execution, the agents that moved up an autonomy level this month, and revenue per person. You push those numbers up.
* You help the team become AI-native too: you spot the work still done by hand, and you build the agent or show a teammate how to build it.
* And always: our members trust us with their lives. No fake claims, no fake scarcity, data handled with care. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. People do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. The company’s output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?**
------------------------------

### **Experience**

* **Top tier Business or Engineering School** (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, EM Lyon, EDHEC, ESCP, Stanford, …) or other high-level academic training (Les Mines, X, Sciences Po Paris, etc.)
* **A wide-scope role behind you:** founder, chief of staff, founder’s associate, strategy, consulting or operations in a fast-growing startup
* **You’ve built with AI and agents yourself:** Claude Code, agent SDKs, MCP, automations, APIs, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

### **Traits**

* **Driven with strong work ethic:** this position requires a strong commitment and perseverance
* **Entrepreneurship spirit:** able to own a project from scratch, with few resources and little guidance, doing a lot yourself
* **Builder, not coordinator:** you’d rather build the agent than chase a person twice
* **Taste:** you know the difference between an output that works and one that is great, and you hold agents to the second
* **Growth over ego:** you are at ease with regular feedback, obsessed with learning and growing, able to put your ego aside
* **Analytical and system thinker:** you quickly identify and formulate problems, and solve complex ones with data
* **Excels in communication:** both written and verbal

### **Language**

French: native or bilingual. English: fluent, you can hold a detailed conversation with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

* We are inspired by a culture of performance and ambition. Everything is fast-paced and there is a lot of change. You won’t always be told what to do or how to do it.
* We tell each other things, even if they are uncomfortable. We value growth over ego. At Paradox, expressing disagreement to a manager and knowing how to debate is valued! We encourage critical and strategic thinking.
* If you use AI for first drafts but your way of working looks the same as two years ago: wrong role.
* If you want to manage a lot of people: we aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each managing a dozen agents.
* If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If all this makes sense with you, then we’ll love working with you (and you with us, you’ll be pampered!)

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly AI-native companies from inside the CEO’s office, and write the playbook others will copy. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

A work with **Impact**, **Freedom** and **Ambition**

**Growth & Ambition**

* Being **surrounded by A-players who strive to perform**, whilst being in a good mood
* No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your growth
* ️Learning to build with AI faster than almost anywhere else

**Impact & Meaning**

* **Playing a crucial role in the development of a company** whose content and products are used by millions of people
* **Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference** is something! We receive messages every day from members who quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships and changed their lives.

**But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…**

**Freedom & Well Being**

* **A company culture based on autonomy & accountability**
* **Flexible working hours** (but very hard working)
* **A remote culture from day one** with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* **Standing desks** paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* **Work on Mac**
* **350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself** (for your gym, a dance class or whatever makes you feel great)
* **150€ of books or education**: at Paradox, we are learner lovers
* **Access to Athena**, our AI coach, supporting you on anything personal or professional

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

Any copy-pasted and non-personalized application goes directly to the trash can.

To complete the recruitment process, **each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this: do not apply**

### **Hiring process**

* **A 6 to 8 minute application survey**, with a short video and a link to something you built with AI
* **A 30-minute video call** with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions
* **A live build session:** you solve a real Paradox problem with AI in front of us. We look at how you prompt, push back on the output and iterate, more than at a polished result.
* **A 1h culture-fit video call**, to assess alignment with our values and mindset
* **A 1h final video call with David, CEO**, on the company’s next milestones and how you’d build them
* **Reference calls** with your previous managers
* **Welcome aboard!**

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

title: Head of search
description:
##### **Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment**

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

##### **What are we looking for now?**

We are looking for a Head of Search to own organic growth across our markets and make our casino and sportsbook the first choice of both search engines and AI assistants.

This is a senior role with a clear commercial focus, coming with a proven background in SEO and AI Search (GEO). Working in a small, focused team, you will set the strategy, win priority on the product roadmap and be measured on revenue performance, not just rankings. You will do it in a competitive, affiliate-heavy and tightly regulated search vertical.

##### **What you will be accountable for:**

* Incremental non-brand organic revenue in all our markets: growth in first-time depositors (FTDs) and net gaming revenue (NGR) from non-brand organic search.
* Organic share of total traffic and acquisition, protected and grown in a search landscape reshaped by AI Overviews and AI assistants, and less dependent on paid media and affiliates.
* Value per organic visitor: FTD conversion rate and NGR per organic session, bringing players who register, deposit and stay, not only sessions.

##### **What you will do:**

Strategy and leadership

* Define and deliver the SEO and AI search strategy, roadmap, forecast and budget for our markets.
* Lead, coach and grow the SEO team, and manage agencies and freelancers on outcomes.
* Collaborate with Acquisition, Retention, Casino and Sportsbook Product, and Marketing.
* Write business cases and requirements, and work with Product and Technology to deliver them in the roadmap.
* Run SEO experiments, measure incrementality and report results and forecasts to top management.

Technical SEO

* Own technical SEO direction for a very large, fast-changing sites: thousands of game pages, provider and category lobbies, live event and odds pages, promotions and help content.
* Set the direction for site architecture, category and filter pages, internal linking, crawl budget, indexation, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals and international setup (hreflang, market and language variants, geo-restriction handling).
* Manage the SEO side of short-lived content: live and upcoming events, expiring promotions, removed games and market-specific restrictions.

AI search (GEO/AEO)

* Build our GEO/AEO practice: measure and grow the visibility and citations of our brand, games and sports content in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants.
* Set the policy for AI crawlers and make game data (provider, RTP, volatility, features), odds, promotions and terms clean, structured and accessible to LLMs and agents.
* Make sure AI-surfaced information about us is accurate and compliant, including bonus terms and responsible gambling messaging.

Content and automation

* Scale content with AI: game reviews, category and provider pages, sports previews and guides, metadata and internal links, with editorial and compliance quality control and measurable impact.
* Automate the team's own work with AI tools and agents, so specialists spend their time on decisions.

Conversion and off-site

* Improve landing-page quality and conversion of organic traffic into registrations and first deposits, with Product, UX, UI and Analytics.
* Lead off-site strategy: digital PR, safe and compliant link acquisition, brand mentions and reputation in search results, including review sites and affiliate listings.
* Work with Legal and Compliance so all SEO and content activity meets licence conditions, advertising rules and responsible gambling standards in each market.

**What we expect:**

* 5+ years of SEO experience, including 2+ years leading an SEO team.
* A track record on a large igaming, betting, ecommerce or marketplace site with proven, measured non-brand organic revenue growth. Direct igaming experience, operator or affiliate side, is a strong advantage.
* Strong technical SEO: you understand how search engines crawl, render and index complex, JavaScript-heavy architectures, and you can challenge both developers and technical specialists.
* International SEO experience across several countries and languages.
* Hands-on GEO/AEO experience: you have measured and improved visibility in AI search, and can show how.
* Solid knowledge of how LLM-based search retrieves, grounds and cites content, of AI crawlers, and of structured data and data feeds (Schema.org and similar).
* Experience building AI-assisted content and SEO workflows at scale with quality control.
* A clear understanding of the compliance limits on gambling marketing: regulator advertising rules, responsible gambling, and search engine policies for gambling content and links.
* Commercial and analytical mindset: forecasting, budgeting, ROI, GA4, Search Console, BI tools; SQL or BigQuery is an advantage.
* Experience running SEO tests and working in sprints with Product and Technology.
* Ability to present clearly to top management and to turn strategy into tasks for the team.
* Experience in Nordic or other small-language search markets.

##### **What We offer:**

* Hybrid working model (office 3 days/ week)
* Innovative international company that uses cutting-edge tech equipment
* Collaborative teams and agile multicultural environment
* Competitive salary with flexible working hours
* 23 paid vacation days + public holidays
* Private health insurance for you and your family
* Free Online English/Spanish lessons
* Corporate events throughout the year
* Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

##### **In-office perks such as:**

* Daily breakfast and freshly cooked lunch 3 days a week
* 50% discount on personal training sessions and physiotherapy sessions
* Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
* Gym, massage room and much more

At Valsea, we want diversity and inclusion in an environment where unique perspectives and new talents thrive. Join us in creating a workplace where everyone can shine and contribute to our collective success. Protecting your privacy and data security is a longstanding top priority for Valsea. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://valsea.teamtailor.com/data-privacy) to learn more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

We’re a diverse team with great people from across the world. This position is only available as a hybrid position in Marbella (Spain). *Please note that we are unable to sponsor work visas outside the EU.*

title: Membership Manager
description:
**Membership Manager**
======================

**The vibe…**

At Soho House, culture is everything, and we believe that our Houses are only as good as the people who work within them. Whether it's a private members' club, hotel, restaurant, spa or gym, each of our sites has its own style and atmosphere. We aim to make sure that all our guests and members have a great time, and we firmly believe it's our people who make that happen.

**The Role…**

At Soho House, the Membership Manager is responsible for growing and shaping the local membership community by attracting new members, driving membership growth through strategic outreach and developing meaningful relationships that strengthen the House's culture and overall member experience.

The role is highly focused on proactively identifying, engaging and attracting potential members, building a strong pipeline of candidates and converting opportunities into long-term memberships. A key responsibility is developing and maintaining a strong network of contacts, identifying potential members through professional networks, industry relationships, partnerships, events and wider business development opportunities.

The Membership Manager will take ownership of the recruitment process, from initial outreach and relationship building through to conversion, onboarding and engagement.

The role also focuses on maximising existing membership opportunities through strategic retention initiatives and developing relationships with current members to encourage continued engagement.

The Membership Manager will report into the Head of Membership and Communications for the House or region, ensuring membership targets are achieved and that the overall experience within the House is consistently high quality, friendly and memorable.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Drive new member acquisition by proactively identifying, targeting and attracting potential members who align with the Soho House culture, with a strong focus on strategic outreach, relationship building and converting opportunities into new memberships.
* Build and manage a strong Outreach strategy, developing relationships with potential members, following up on opportunities, hosting introductory meetings and guiding applications through to successful membership.
* Develop strategic partnerships and business opportunities with influential individuals, brands, businesses and organisations connected to the city's creative industries, expanding Soho House's network, visibility and reach.
* Actively network within the local creative community, identifying opportunities to introduce Soho House to new audiences, generate referrals and build a strong community.
* Represent Soho House externally, acting as an ambassador for the brand and proactively positioning the House within relevant social, cultural and professional networks.
* Identify new channels for member recruitment, leveraging professional networks, existing members, partnerships, events and local industry connections to generate quality leads and drive membership growth.
* Manage and oversee membership applications, ensuring timely follow-up, regular evaluation and progression through the recruitment process, maintaining accurate records and pipeline activity through Salesforce.
* Work closely with the Head of Membership and Communications to deliver membership acquisition targets, monitor outreach performance, identify growth opportunities and develop strategies to improve conversion, retention and renewals.
* Support Membership Committees alongside the Head of Membership and Communications, contributing to membership strategy, recruitment and community development.
* Host coffees, lunches, dinners and networking opportunities with potential and existing members to build relationships, generate interest and develop opportunities into long-term memberships.
* Collaborate with the Events and Comms teams to develop experiences and initiatives that attract members, showcase the Soho House proposition and strengthen engagement with the local community.
* Maintain strong relationships with members, understanding their needs, encouraging engagement and ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term retention and loyalty. Build strong relationships with existing members and encourage them to introduce new members to the House.
* Build relationships with key internal stakeholders across Events, Marketing, Food & Beverage and Operations to identify opportunities for collaboration and ensure a consistent member experience.
* Welcome and connect visiting members and high-profile guests, using these interactions to strengthen the wider Soho House network and foster meaningful relationships.

**Key Skills**

* 3–5 years of experience in Outreach, Business Development, Membership, Community Building or Customer Relationship Management.
* Strong relationship-building mindset, with proven ability to attract new members, develop strategic partnerships, build networks and deliver growth through effective outreach.
* Well-connected within the local creative community, with the ability to leverage existing networks and establish new relationships to generate membership opportunities and drive recruitment.
* Data-driven and results-oriented, with strong analytical skills and the ability to manage outreach performance, track conversion rates, identify opportunities and support membership growth and retention strategies.
* Culturally aware and creatively driven, with a genuine understanding of the local creative industries, emerging trends and influential communities.
* Exceptional communication, networking and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage and influence potential members, partners and key stakeholders.
* Proactive, entrepreneurial and strategically minded, with the ability to identify new opportunities, take initiative and turn ideas into tangible results.
* Highly organised, with strong research, planning and prioritisation skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and opportunities simultaneously.
* Collaborative and confident in working with different teams, providing direction and taking ownership to ensure objectives are achieved.
* Adaptable, energetic and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure in a demanding, fast-paced environment.
* A critical thinker with strong problem-solving skills, sound judgement and the ability to make effective decisions.
* Flexible and willing to work outside standard office hours, when required to support networking opportunities, events and member engagement.

**Benefits…**

By being part of our Soho House family, we will offer a huge number of Learning & Development opportunities as well as other benefits such as:

* Competitive salary
* All Houses Membership
* Cookhouse & House Tonic – trips, training and workshops to celebrate our passion for food and drink.
* Team Events: From fitness sessions to art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events.
* An extensive range of externally and internally run courses to all employees.
* Family Meals during your shifts.
* Sport Classes.
* Staff Screenings.

title: Head of Retention & Customer Experience
description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
