title: Retail Marketing Manager
description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. Nuestra misión nos invita a conectar con nuestro consumidor de una manera significativa, a través de la creación de contenido, de historias inspiradoras y de productos icónicos de alta calidad, responsables con el medioambiente.

No solo somos una marca, ¡SOMOS UN ESTILO DE VIDA! y queremos influir positivamente en el mundo.

¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

**El puesto**

Buscamos un perfil de Retail Marketing Manager con experiencia en moda o retail que haga de la tienda física el corazón de cada campaña. Reportarás directamente al Head of Marketing y serás quien conecte marca, tienda y negocio en España y Portugal.

Si te gusta pisar tienda, entender al cliente y ver cómo una campaña se convierte en entradas y ventas, este puesto es para ti.

Tu contribución en blue banana brand será excepcional si desarrollas estas funciones:

**La tienda física como eje**

* Convertir los objetivos de marketing en planes de trade marketing para España y Portugal, con prioridades, calendario, presupuesto y KPIs: captar nuevas audiencias, aumentar los clientes activos, generar awareness, vender la nueva colección por género, atraer tráfico a tienda y mejorar el lifetime value y el rendimiento del canal retail.
* Llevar esos planes del retail calendar a campañas omnicanal con la tienda como eje, con un mensaje claro para el cliente y conectadas de forma coherente con digital, CRM y PR.
* Liderar de principio a fin las acciones en El Corte Inglés, centros comerciales, outlets y pop-up stores, coordinándote con Brand, Visual y Retail, y con los equipos de marketing de cada canal, para crear planes a medida y medibles.
* Asegurar la coherencia entre marca y acción comercial en todos los puntos de venta, en el resto de canales y en ambos mercados.

**Cada canal, con su estrategia**

* Conocer a fondo cómo funciona cada canal y quién compra en él: tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales.
* Adaptar cada campaña a la realidad y al presupuesto de cada canal: espacios y formatos disponibles, normativas de implantación, calendarios comerciales y acciones conjuntas con centros comerciales y grandes almacenes.
* Seguir los resultados de cada canal y campaña (tráfico, conversión, ticket medio, unidades por ticket, ventas por tienda y captación de clientes), detectar desviaciones y proponer ajustes para la siguiente activación.

**Mano a mano con Visual**

* Trabajar con Visual para que marca y negocio vayan de la mano en tienda: escaparates, PLV, señalética, ratio de atracción, categorización por familias y conversión.
* Definir qué necesita cada canal y cada tienda, para producir materiales eficaces y con el coste justo.
* Medir el impacto de escaparates y materiales en el comportamiento del cliente y en las ventas, y aplicar lo aprendido en las siguientes campañas.
* Preparar kits de campaña y guías de implantación claras para los equipos de tienda, junto a Retail y Operaciones.

**El cliente en el centro**

* Entender qué busca el cliente en cada tienda: por qué compra, cómo se mueve y qué le hace volver. Para ello combinarás datos, el feedback de los equipos de tienda y el análisis del mercado, la competencia y las tendencias.
* Trabajar con el equipo de CRM en la estrategia de cliente (nuevos y fieles) con foco en tienda: captación en el punto de venta, recurrencia y nuestro club Adventure Pass.

**Datos, reporting y presupuesto**

* Medir la rentabilidad de cada inversión por canal y por campaña, y priorizar con datos lo que más impacto tiene.
* Preparar el reporting para dirección y comité: cuadro de mando semanal, informe mensual y recaps de las campañas clave del retail calendar.
* Ser owner del presupuesto y de los objetivos de retail marketing.
* Usar la IA para analizar, decidir y convertir ideas en campañas.
* Impulsar una cultura de medición y mejora continua, y hacer visible el impacto de marketing en el negocio.

**¿Qué te hará triunfar con nosotros?**

* Más de 6 años en marketing en empresas de moda o retail. Valoramos la experiencia en entornos internacionales.
* Al menos 4 años como Retail Marketing Manager, Trade Marketing Manager o Marketing Manager con responsabilidad sobre el punto de venta, con experiencia en:

  + Campañas 360 con foco en tienda física.
  + Tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales, coordinándote con sus equipos de marketing.
  + Visual merchandising: escaparates, PLV y materiales de punto de venta.
  + Análisis de ventas y KPIs de tienda por canal.
  + Cliente, hábitos de compra, CRM y loyalty.
  + Gestión de presupuesto y cumplimiento de objetivos.
* Dominio de Shopify, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint (imprescindible).
* Uso de herramientas de IA para análisis, gestión y reporting.
* Valorable: Smile y Klaviyo.
* Español e inglés, hablado y escrito. El portugués será un plus.

**Lo que te define**

* Te gusta pisar tienda y entiendes cómo se vive una campaña en cada canal.
* Piensas con datos y con estrategia.
* Tienes creatividad, sobre todo a la hora de ejecutar.
* Tienes visión de negocio y vas a por resultados.
* Planificas, priorizas y sigues tus KPIs de cerca.
* Sabes influir y trabajar con muchos equipos: Visual, Retail, tiendas y los equipos de marketing de cada canal.
* Tienes iniciativa, autonomía y mentalidad ganadora.

**¿Te preguntas qué ganas al unirte a nosotrxs? ¡Aquí van nuestros beneficios!**

**️ Estilo X:** Accede a todos nuestros productos con un **50% de descuento** desde el primer día y disfruta de **bonos de regalo por temporada**. ¿Lo mejor? También puedes **compartir un 30%** de descuento con tus personas más cercanas.

**️ Flexibilidad y conciliación:** En blue banana, entendemos que los tiempos cambian. Con un **modelo híbrido del 40% de teletrabajo** semanal y en épocas estivales, **flexibilidad en entrada y salida.** Además, el **día de tu cumpleaños** es para disfrutarlo, ¡aquí lo tendrás libre!

**️ Evoluciona con nosotros:** En blue banana, las personas son el centro. Cada persona vive su propio viaje profesional, con feedback constante, a través de nuestro **Adventure Career Plan** personalizado y formación continua.

**️ Cuidamos de ti:** Priorizamos la salud con nuestro programa de bienestar. **Wellhub** ofrece experiencias únicas para cuidar cuerpo y mente.

**️ Teambuildings épicos**: Inspiramos a nuevas generaciones y a nuestros trabajadores a hacer de su vida una aventura con **eventos únicos** y nuestras **blue banana expert talks**, donde podrás escuchar y sacar inspiración de grandes profesionales alineados con nuestra marca.

**️ Espíritu Z:** Únete a un proyecto con un equipo inconformista y lleno de experiencia donde te sentirás rodeado de compañeros que se apoyan mutuamente. Sé parte de un **proyecto internacional** donde cada día impactas y sumas rompiendo las reglas del juego.

**️ Comunicación y transparencia 360º:** Nos encanta escuchar y debatir, trabajando con pasión y humildad para superarnos cada día. Te sentirás parte integral del proyecto con detalles de nuestro crecimiento compartidos en nuestras **Quarterlies** y resúmenes mensuales.

**️ Oficinas que molan:** Además de **café y fruta siempre disponible**, nuestras oficinas tienen espacios abiertos y zonas de desconexión. En blue banana, te sentirás como en casa.

**️ Sé parte del cambio:** En Blue Banana somos una empresa certificada B Corp. Eso significa que no solo trabajamos por crecer, sino por hacerlo generando un impacto positivo real en las personas y en el planeta.

**¿Quieres conocernos mejor?**

* Pásate por nuestra web o por cualquiera de nuestras tiendas.
* Sigue nuestros viajes desde nuestro canal de Youtube y conoce el lado B de la aventura. No todo es tan bonito como lo pintamos en nuestras fotos.
* Si tienes cualquier duda, escríbenos. Estamos para ayudar.

Gracias por haber leído hasta aquí y bienvenidx, aventurerx.

*Blue Banana manifiesta su compromiso con la igualdad de género y de oportunidades a todos los niveles y para todas las personas trabajadoras, y garantiza la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión en todos sus procesos.*

*Blue Banana promueve un futuro más sostenible, diseñando y produciendo colecciones de una forma más responsable. Trabajamos a todos los niveles para garantizar el mínimo impacto ambiental y social de nuestros productos, cumpliendo los beneficios e incentivos que ofrecemos de sostenibilidad y responsabilidad social.*

title: Head of Partnerships, EMEA
description:
**Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.**

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

* You'll represent the EMEA growth agenda in executive forums, governance committees and strategic partner discussions.

* You'll lead and develop a high-performing partnerships team while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation and collaboration.

* You'll bring European language capability and existing European insurance or partnership networks as an advantage.

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. **Apply today and let’s go to great places together!**

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**This isn’t another growth job**

Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.

We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.

**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE GROWTH MEANS AT PARADOX**
------------------------------------------

Our growth machine has to be able to:

**1. Generate hypotheses.** Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.

**2. Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.

**3. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.

**4. Ship its hypotheses.** Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.

We do that by merging :

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

description:
**Company Description**

**THE WORLD OF UBISOFT**

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

**Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile** brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

 **Job Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Create believable, high-quality animations and directly participating in implementing them in games.
* Define the animation style and workflows for new products under the supervision of the Producer and Lead Artist.
* Be able to rigging/skinning with low to medium polygon counts.
* Take active part in the game creation process by interacting with the design team.
* Contribute effectively to the art pipeline while understanding target platform constraints.
* Have a strong time management skills to reach project deadlines/milestones.
* Collaborate with the rest of the Art Team to obtain a consistent visual style for the game.
* Work with the Programming Team to integrate your animations in the game while respecting technical constraints.

  
**Qualifications**

**PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS**

In order for your application to be considered, you must submit a portfolio or other samples of your work. All portfolios must contain a detailed shot breakdown of the work. It must be very clear what you, the applicant, are responsible for in your reel, screenshots, scanned pictures, web page portfolio, etc.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Examples of basic cycles of a character. Cycle of walk, run, idle, attack, jump, etc.
* Examples of physics of movement. It can be a character doing parkour, moving weight, a skateboarder, etc.
* Examples of combination of cycles. Idle + attack, idle + run + attack, etc.
* It would also be interesting if among all the examples there is some quadrupeds, or characters of more than two feet.

* At least 4 or more years of experience in 3D Studio Max, Maya or Blender.
* Have a clear understanding of character motion, camera movement, physics-based motion and of the fundamental principles of animation.
* Be able to define and execute creative and stylish animations (vehicles, objects, characters).
* Positive attitude with the ability to receive and provide objective feedback
* Be a team player: we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.
* Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
* Good command of English.
* Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus

* Solid background in academic drawing, sketching and/or illustration.
* Working Unity experience.
* Have modelling skills (2D/3D), knowledge and experience of Blender, Unity, particle effects creation programs (e.g. combustion, particle illusion, Fork) and motion graphics programs (eg After Effects).
* Experience working on mobile games.
* Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.
* Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

  
**Additional Information**

**YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)**

* **Ticket Restaurant:** 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
* **Flexible working hours:** 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
* **Reduced schedule** (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
* **Personal Matters Hours:** 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
* **Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day** on yourUbi-Birthday.
* **5 extra holiday days** on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
* **Health insurance** with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
* **Life Insurance** with AXA.
* **Office Gym** open from 7 AM to 8 PM
* **Mobile Device Grant** of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
* **Language training** for English, Spanish, and French.
* **Professional development training & programs**, based upon request.
* **Ubisoft games** are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
* **Locally roasted craft coffee** by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

**At ING we are looking for a Customer Journey Expert – Discretionary Portfolio Management**
============================================================================================

**Your role and work environment:**

ING Bank is entering in the Private Banking segment in Spain, a large market serving more than €600b in household wealth and showing a growth rate of 4% annually. ING Bank is in the process of launching a comprehensive new proposition tailored to Private Banking, digitally savvy customers. Join us in shaping the future of banking for Spain’s Private Banking & Investment.

ING Spain is building a new Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) proposition as a key component of its Private Banking offering. We are looking for a hands-on **Customer Journey Expert** to join the DPM team, help complete delivery and close existing gaps, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the product.

You will contribute across the **end-to-end DPM journey**, from requirements and testing to implementation, banker training and continuous improvement. Working closely with the Product Owner and the wider team, you will connect customer and banker needs with technology, operations and regulatory requirements.

You will work in a **highly international and cross-functional environment**, collaborating with **One Investment Platform** and teams across Investments, Technology, Operations, Data, Finance, Risk, Legal and Compliance.

This is a **hands-on Customer Journey Expert role within the DPM team**, combining product delivery, customer experience and support for bankers. You will take responsibility for agreed activities and contribute to product improvements, while backlog ownership and prioritization remain with the Product Owner.

**Your key responsibilities:**

You will contribute to **DPM delivery, day-to-day product improvements and further evolution** through the following activities:

* **Complete the remaining DPM delivery**: Define and refine business requirements, document user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with technology and operations teams to bring outstanding capabilities into production.

* **Close existing gaps**: Identify and analyse functional, operational and customer journey gaps, help define practical solutions, and follow agreed actions through to resolution.

* **Support testing and implementation**: Prepare and execute end-to-end business and user acceptance tests, follow up on defects, and support release readiness and post-implementation validation.

* **Train and support bankers:** Prepare practical training materials and product guides, deliver DPM training sessions, and gather banker feedback to improve both the service and the assisted journey.

* **Contribute to product evolution:** Help define and implement new DPM capabilities and proposition enhancements, including pDPM, in line with the product roadmap and priorities agreed with the Product Owner.

* **Improve the digital and assisted experience:** Work with UX, design and technology teams on visual improvements, clearer portfolio information and simpler customer journeys, aligned with the Private Banking Digital Experience.

* **Keep the end-to-end service coherent:** Collaborate with Investments, One Investment Platform, retail product tribes and control functions to align processes, customer communications and operational handovers as DPM evolves.

As a **Customer Journey Expert** you are responsible of:

* **Customer Experience:** Provide the **best customer experience** by designing, mapping and constantly improving the customer journey. With an end-to-end process view being able to collect CX and data, translating into UX and IT landscapes

* **Digital Strategy**: As expert in digital experience, be proactive in the identification of new capabilities in our digital platform to **engage our customers** and increase **efficiency** of our assisted channels bringing the best experience in the moments of truth

* **Commercial Support:** Collaborate with marketing, customer interactions teams and bankers to translate the DPM value proposition into clear customer communications and practical supporting materials, incorporating feedback from the assisted channel.

* **Data Fluency:** Comprehend, define, select, and analyze data to gain insights that enhance the **decision-making process**. Use product and journey data, together with customer and banker feedback, to identify gaps, assess improvements and contribute to balanced cost-benefit assessments before and after implementation.

* **Agile Delivery:** Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Work on items prioritized by the Product Owner, contribute to refinement, and deliver agreed activities in short cycles with the team. Identify dependencies, risks and impediments early, support their resolution, and use testing and feedback to improve solutions while reducing complexity.

**What are we looking for?**

Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!

**A pioneer of the agile culture displaying the following behaviors:**

Ability to display flexibility to teams and adapt plans, approach and behavior to the different needs and situations

* Ability to take responsibility for agreed deliverables and contribute to team decisions based on facts, data and customer feedback

Strong resilience: ability to navigate through ambiguity

* Negotiation skills

* Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to follow delivery activities and open issues through to completion

* Passionate about innovation, new market trends and investment products

* Clear communications skills (written and oral)

* Ability to work on an international level

* Excellent oral and written English skills

* Team player

* Loving to collaborate with different people

* Able to work in an autonomous way and to take initiative

* Making things happen thanks to your ‘can do’ attitude

**Proven track record and technical skills**

* University degree, master’s in finance related is also a plus

* 5+ years’ professional experience in banking

* Experience with investment products and/or Private Banking customer journeys; familiarity with DPM is a plus

* Omnichannel experience management

* Research techniques and UX product design is a plus

* Practical experience translating business needs into requirements and supporting user acceptance testing and implementation

* Ability to explain investment products and processes clearly and prepare practical training materials for bankers

* Strong command of written and spoken English
  

  
  

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Balance That Works.**

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

**Restaurant card.**

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!

**Health insurance.**

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

**Life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you.

**Flexible remuneration.**

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…

**Free company shuttle.**

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

**Banking benefits.**

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**More vitality and more belonging**

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

**Get to know Us**

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.

And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 35 countries.**

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.

And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*

**Job Application Safety Reminder**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.

* **Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.

* **No payments or banking details will ever be requested:** If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

**En ING buscamos un/a Customer Journey Expert – Gestión Discrecional de Carteras**
===================================================================================

  
  

**Tu rol y entorno de trabajo:**

  
  

ING Bank está entrando en el segmento de Banca Privada en España, un gran mercado que gestiona más de 600.000 millones de euros de patrimonio de los hogares y que muestra una tasa de crecimiento anual del 4 %. ING Bank está en proceso de lanzar una nueva propuesta integral adaptada a clientes de Banca Privada con una alta afinidad digital. Únete a nosotros para dar forma al futuro de la banca para Banca Privada e Inversiones en España.

  
  

ING España está desarrollando una nueva propuesta de Gestión Discrecional de Carteras (DPM, por sus siglas en inglés) como componente clave de su oferta de Banca Privada. Buscamos un/a **Customer Journey Expert** con un enfoque práctico para incorporarse al equipo de DPM, ayudar a completar la implementación y cerrar las brechas existentes, así como contribuir a la evolución continua del producto.

  
  

Contribuirás a lo largo del **journey end-to-end de DPM**, desde los requisitos y las pruebas hasta la implementación, la formación a bankers y la mejora continua. Trabajando estrechamente con el Product Owner y el resto del equipo, conectarás las necesidades de clientes y bankers con los requisitos tecnológicos, operativos y regulatorios.

  
  

Trabajarás en un **entorno altamente internacional y transversal**, colaborando con **One Investment Platform** y con equipos de Inversiones, Tecnología, Operaciones, Data, Finanzas, Riesgos, Legal y Compliance.

  
  

Este es un **rol de Customer Journey Expert con un enfoque práctico dentro del equipo de DPM**, que combina delivery de producto, experiencia de cliente y soporte a bankers. Asumirás la responsabilidad de las actividades acordadas y contribuirás a las mejoras del producto, mientras que la gestión y priorización del backlog seguirán siendo responsabilidad del Product Owner.

  
  

**Tus principales responsabilidades:**

  
  

Contribuirás al **delivery de DPM, las mejoras del día a día del producto y su evolución futura** mediante las siguientes actividades:

* **Completar el delivery pendiente de DPM:** Definir y refinar requisitos de negocio, documentar user stories y criterios de aceptación, y trabajar con los equipos de tecnología y operaciones para llevar a producción las funcionalidades pendientes.
* **Cerrar las brechas existentes:** Identificar y analizar brechas funcionales, operativas y del customer journey, ayudar a definir soluciones prácticas y realizar el seguimiento de las acciones acordadas hasta su resolución.
* **Dar soporte a las pruebas y la implementación:** Preparar y ejecutar pruebas de negocio end-to-end y pruebas de aceptación de usuario, realizar el seguimiento de defectos y apoyar la preparación de releases y la validación posterior a la implementación.
* **Formar y dar soporte a bankers:** Preparar materiales prácticos de formación y guías de producto, impartir sesiones de formación sobre DPM y recopilar el feedback de bankers para mejorar tanto el servicio como el journey asistido.
* **Contribuir a la evolución del producto:** Ayudar a definir e implementar nuevas funcionalidades de DPM y mejoras de la propuesta, incluyendo pDPM, en línea con el roadmap del producto y las prioridades acordadas con el Product Owner.
* **Mejorar la experiencia digital y asistida:** Trabajar con los equipos de UX, diseño y tecnología en mejoras visuales, información más clara sobre las carteras y customer journeys más sencillos, alineados con la Experiencia Digital de Banca Privada.
* **Mantener la coherencia del servicio end-to-end:** Colaborar con Inversiones, One Investment Platform, las tribus de producto de retail y las funciones de control para alinear procesos, comunicaciones con clientes y transiciones operativas a medida que evoluciona DPM.
  

  

Como **Customer Journey Expert** eres responsable de:

* **Experiencia de Cliente:** Ofrecer la **mejor experiencia de cliente** diseñando, mapeando y mejorando constantemente el customer journey. Con una visión end-to-end del proceso, ser capaz de recopilar datos y aspectos relacionados con CX y traducirlos a entornos de UX e IT.
* **Estrategia Digital:** Como especialista en experiencia digital, ser proactivo/a en la identificación de nuevas funcionalidades en nuestra plataforma digital para **involucrar a nuestros clientes** y aumentar la **eficiencia** de nuestros canales asistidos, ofreciendo la mejor experiencia en los momentos de la verdad.
* **Soporte Comercial:** Colaborar con marketing, los equipos de interacción con clientes y bankers para trasladar la propuesta de valor de DPM a comunicaciones claras para clientes y materiales prácticos de apoyo, incorporando el feedback del canal asistido.
* **Fluidez con Datos:** Comprender, definir, seleccionar y analizar datos para obtener insights que mejoren el **proceso de toma de decisiones**. Utilizar datos de producto y del journey, junto con el feedback de clientes y bankers, para identificar brechas, evaluar mejoras y contribuir a análisis equilibrados de coste-beneficio antes y después de la implementación.
* **Agile Delivery:** Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requisitos claros, user stories y criterios de aceptación. Trabajar en los elementos priorizados por el Product Owner, contribuir al refinamiento y entregar las actividades acordadas en ciclos cortos junto con el equipo. Identificar dependencias, riesgos e impedimentos de manera temprana, apoyar su resolución y utilizar las pruebas y el feedback para mejorar las soluciones reduciendo al mismo tiempo la complejidad.
  

  

**¿Qué buscamos?**

  
  

¿Quieres saber si este puesto está hecho para ti? Estas son algunas de las cualidades que más valoramos para este rol. Y si encajan contigo… ¡no dudes en presentar tu candidatura!

  
  

**Una persona pionera de la cultura agile que demuestre los siguientes comportamientos:**

Capacidad para mostrar flexibilidad hacia los equipos y adaptar los planes, el enfoque y el comportamiento a las diferentes necesidades y situaciones.

title: Global Permitting & Approvals Manager
description:
### **About the company**

**About the company**

**Utopia** is an ultra-luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand creating a global ecosystem of properties and experiences.

We develop private villa retreats in beautiful locations around the world, each with high-end service. **Utopia** also offers a wider ecosystem of leisure experiences and services available both to those staying on property and to external visitors.

**Utopia** designs and builds its properties in-house. Our projects span the full journey: from concept and architecture to construction, interiors, landscape, guest experience, and long-term operation. For architects and designers, this means contributing on properties from the ground up, with the ability to influence how each place is planned, built, and experienced. For hospitality professionals, it means collaborating with a brand where service is personal, attentive, and built around each guest’s stay.

We’re a young, ambitious team with high standards and a hands-on approach. We value strong ideas, practical thinking, attention to detail, and people who are ready to take ownership of their part of each project. If you’re interested in architecture, design, hospitality, or guest experience, we invite you to explore opportunities with **Utopia.**

**About the role**

We are looking for a hands-on Global Permitting & Approvals Manager to lead permitting and regulatory approvals across our international development portfolio.

You will research local requirements, translate them into clear technical tasks for project teams, coordinate AORs and local consultants, and drive approval processes through to completion.

This role requires independent problem-solving, strong execution skills and the ability to establish effective processes in a fast-moving international environment.

Projects span Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE and other locations, each with different regulatory requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Own permitting and regulatory approvals across multiple countries and projects.
* Research local regulations and establish approval strategies and schedules.
* Translate statutory requirements into technical documentation tasks for internal teams.
* Participate in selecting and managing local AORs and permitting consultants.
* Coordinate application submissions, authority comments and final approvals.
* Identify critical risks, resolve blockers and protect construction milestones.
* Implement standardized permitting processes and portfolio-wide reporting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Hands-on construction permitting experience in at least two countries and three project locations.
* Proven record of personally securing development or construction approvals.
* Experience of permitting in at least 2 of selected locations: Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and technical submission documentation.
* Experience managing local AORs, consultants and government authorities.
* Ability to research new jurisdictions and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong ownership, analytical thinking and process-building capabilities.
* Fluent English

**Nice to Have**

* Spanish and/or Portuguese.
* Hands-on permitting experience in Spain, Brazil, Latin America, the UAE, or South Africa.
* Background in luxury residential or hospitality development.

  
**Benefits**  

* **Fully remote with business trips.** You'll collaborate from anywhere within GMT-3 to GMT+3.
* **All the tools you need.** A laptop and access to our project and documentation tools from day one.
* **Properties across three continents.** You'll take projects through approval in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Latin America, so you won't be limited to one market, one regulator, or one type of permit.
* **A team that spans 30+ countries.** Developers, architects, engineers, and legal specialists from every corner of the world, held to the same standards and the same bar for quality.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: Product Expert - Vault Safety
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Safety (Pharmacovigilance) domain to drive customer success with our Veeva Safety Suite products.

As part of the Veeva Safety product team and collaborating with broader global Product Experts, your experience will play a key role in the Product organization. You will:

* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, with internal team education and at industry events – driving increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion

This helps to guide product decisions and design improvements, ultimately delivering better Safety solutions that drive regulatory compliance and operational efficiency
* Develop rich relationships with key product users / influencers
* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices (Good Vault Practice) and Veeva success!

This role is ideal for someone passionate about Pharmacovigilance, eager to collaborate with customers, and excited to drive their success.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist, providing subject matter expertise for the Veeva Safety products and champion for Veeva's key product enhancements
* Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva Safety products
* Stay up to date with the latest features and roadmap direction
* Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate our product roadmaps and vision
* Provide product education to Veeva Safety customers in our online communities (Veeva Connect) and a range of in-person forums; Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Act as the customer advocate by collecting, analyzing and prioritizing their feedback to contribute to future product innovations, helping to inform product roadmaps. Be a customer advocate internally!
* Collaborate with Product teams to create effective release communications and resources.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

* Strong organizational, analytical and communication/ English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations). Ability to understand and engage technical users (safety scientists, data analysts).
* Prior experience leading workshops and product discovery, displaying high levels of curiosity
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features can solve related real-world challenges (including some exposure to AI in driving efficiencies in your existing role and/ or optimizing workflows)
* SQL & PV Data Mastery: Proficiency writing and auditing complex SQL queries (AI-assisted coding experience a plus).
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude and strong sense of ownership.
* Willingness to travel up to 25%.
* Based in Europe with ability to work across time-zones.

### **Nice to Have**

* Veeva Product experience (including Veeva Safety / case processing)
* Statistical Signal Detection: Understanding of the statistical algorithms used in quantitative signal detection, such as Disproportionality Analysis (PRR, ROR, EBGM).
* Experience performing software demonstrations
* Creating engaging videos with familiarity with video recording/ editing software (e.g. Camtasia)

Note: Veeva will consider applicants from European countries where Veeva has representatives.

title: Brand Manager (crafts)| DTC E-commerce | 100% Remote EU
description:
At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us..

**The role**

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. You'll also analyse who we acquire, how the cancellation flow and failed-payment recovery perform, and work closely with customer service and analyze customer feedback. Just as important: you dig into why things happen and check whether each change actually worked. We need your product judgement and your ownership.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Find, test and approve the crafts.** Own the box pipeline for both tracks. Scout craft ideas, order samples, make every kit yourself, and approve or reject it.
* **Own kit quality.** Every kit must be finishable at its stated level: clear instructions, the right tools and materials, nothing missing, packaging that survives shipping. Catch problems before a box ships, not in the reviews.
* **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.
* **Protect acquisition quality.** Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.
* **Keep the subscription running smoothly.** Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.
* **Stay aligned with Customer Service.** Turn recurring ticket themes into fixes, and close the loop with CS when they ship.

**Skills & experience**
-----------------------

**Must have**

* 1+ years in consumer product development, merchandising or brand management, ideally with craft kits, hobby products or subscription boxes.
* A track record of products you chose or developed, and how customers responded: ratings, sell-through, repeat purchases, returns.
* A hands-on maker. You craft yourself, and you can make a kit and judge its difficulty, instructions and quality.
* Supplier experience: sourcing samples, negotiating, and working to cost targets and lead times.
* Taste grounded in customers. You use reviews and feedback to decide, not only your own preferences.
* Ownership across teams. You push work through with marketing, CS, design, inventory and operations without being chased.
* Comfort with numbers. You can read a retention table and question a figure that looks too good, connect reason with outcome based on numbers
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running a subscription box.
* Experience writing craft instructions.
* An active presence in craft communities or social media.
* Experience with Shopify.
* Spreadsheet analysis skills.

**THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.
* Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.
* Test Task
* Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

**FIXED SERVICE FEE**

**Up to € 2300 euros** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience.

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

**ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS**

This role is 100% remote.

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is **UTC+2** and **UTC+3**. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

* **For full-time roles**, we expect hires to be available during **at least 5 hours of typical working hours in the EET time zone** to ensure effective collaboration and communication.

title: Control-M Specialist
description:
When energy markets move fast, every end-of-day process has to run on time and without surprises. The **Control-M Specialist/Workload Automation** role in Spain sits at the intersection of trading, risk and scheduling, where reliable batch automation keeps business-critical flows under control. The company’s IT teams depend on robust scheduling to keep power and gas operations running across ten countries. You shape how time-sensitive workloads are orchestrated and monitored, working directly with application owners and operations teams. The person in this role decides how quickly issues are detected and resolved, making sure the business stays ahead.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with application owners, business users and operations teams to understand batch requirements, dependencies and processing windows
* Design, build and maintain Control-M job flows, calendars, conditions, resources and dependencies for critical end-of-day processing

* Automate recurring tasks and data workflows using Python, shell, PowerShell and the Control-M Automation API
* Integrate Control-M with trading platforms, databases, file transfers, cloud services such as AWS and enterprise monitoring tools
* Monitor job execution, manage failures, reruns and delays to restore service quickly and conduct root-cause analysis
* Maintain the Control-M environment, including agents, folders, user access, security, versioning and promotion between environments
* Define and maintain SLA, alerting and notification rules to detect and escalate late or failed workloads early
* Replace ad-hoc scripts, scheduled tasks and manual runs with orchestrated and auditable workflows
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, testing procedures and jobs-as-code or CI/CD practices

**Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience with BMC Control-M: design, administration and operations in an enterprise environment
* Good understanding of batch processing, job dependencies, SLAs, calendars and end-of-day or intraday processing, ideally in trading, energy or commodity markets
* Solid scripting and automation skills (Python, Shell, PowerShell), including REST APIs and the Control-M Automation API
* Experience integrating Control-M with databases, file transfers, cloud services (e.g. AWS) and enterprise applications
* Working knowledge of source control, CI/CD and automated deployment of job definitions
* Structured troubleshooting and root-cause approach across jobs, applications, infrastructure and data flows
* Responsive, pragmatic and accountable; comfortable working directly with business and application owners with limited direction
* Fluent English, with business hours aligned to CET and extended cover around end-of-day processing and releases as agreed

**We offer**

* Private health insurance
* EPAM Employees Stock Purchase Plan
* 100% paid sick leave
* Referral Program
* Professional certification
* Language courses

EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with 61,700+ EPAMers in 55+ countries and regions. Here you will collaborate with multinational teams, contribute to numerous innovative projects, and have an opportunity to learn and grow continuously.

* **Why Join EPAM**
* **WORK AND LIFE BALANCE.** Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays.
* **CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE.** Craft your personal Career Development Plan to align with your learning objectives. Take advantage of internal training, mentorship, sponsored certifications and LinkedIn courses.

description:
**About Actian**

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

**This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.**

  

### **What You Will Own:**

1. **Platform Engineering & Architecture**

* Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
* Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. **Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
* Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
* Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
* Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. **AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations**

* Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
* Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
* Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
* Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
* Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

* Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
* Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
* Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. **Team Building & Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
* Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
* Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
* Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

### **What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:**

* Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
* Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
* Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
* Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
* Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
* Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

### **What You Bring:**

**Leadership & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
* At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
* Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
* A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
* The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
* Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
* Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
* Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

**AI-First Mindset**

* Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
* Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
* Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
* A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

**Leadership Approach**

* Strong ownership and execution skills.
* Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
* Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
* Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
* Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
* Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
* Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.

### **How You Will Work:**

You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.
