AI & Cybersecurity Conformity Assessment Specialist – Machinery Safety
description:
**Company Description**

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**

Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**

**Main Purpose of Role**

* Act as the One NoBo technical reference for the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (focusing on cyber resilience and AI), owning interpretations, procedures and templates applied consistently across all SGS notifications and executing affiliates.
* Qualify, authorise and monitor certification personnel under the One NoBo competence scheme, enabling EU-bound certification to be delivered locally under EU notifications.
* Lead the adoption of digital and AI tools in the certification process, keeping every conformity-assessment decision under qualified human control.
* Bridge One NoBo with SGS notified capacity in Spain, including the Rail Notified Body.

**Key Accountabilities**

* **AI-enabled machinery –** Build SGS assessment capability for machinery and safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning (Annex I Part A), and for the AI-related health and safety requirements being added to the Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
* **Cybersecurity of machinery –** Build SGS assessment capability for protection against corruption and for the safety and reliability of control systems (Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1), including the interface with the Cyber Resilience Act and the IEC 62443 series.
* **Technical review and decision –** Perform technical file reviews and, once qualified, take certification decisions for machinery files routed under the selected SGS notification, in line with ISO/IEC 17065.
* **Technical advisory –** Develop and deliver technical advisory services on the Machinery Regulation, including AI and cyber requirements, for SGS affiliates and clients, kept strictly separate from the certification of the same clients in line with ISO/IEC 17065 impartiality requirements.
* **SGS NoBos network –** Develop, release and maintain One NoBo procedures, checklists and certificate templates, harmonising practice across SGS Notified Bodies and supporting their international collaboration.
* **Competence and qualification –** Own the One NoBo competence matrix (person × scope × authorisation) in ProCert; define qualification criteria, perform witness assessments and monitor evaluators in executing affiliates, including SGS China.
* **Accreditation and notification –** Support accreditation assessments and notifying-authority applications for machinery scope; represent SGS in the European coordination group of Notified Bodies for machinery (NB-M) and apply its Recommendations for Use.
* **Authorised affiliates –** Plan and perform One NoBo process assessments of authorised affiliates against the One NoBo Policy, follow up findings and report results to the One NoBo Committee.
* **AI in certification –** Act as product owner for AI-assisted certification workflows (AI Bot portfolio, ProCert integrations): define requirements, validate outputs, manage data governance and ensure AI never issues deliverables or takes conformity decisions.
* **Platform and KPIs –** Act as ProCert key user for machinery workflows; monitor turnaround time, certificates issued and resource utilisation through Power BI and drive corrective actions.
* **Collaboration with SGS Spain –** Work with SGS Spain, including the Rail Notified Body, to share experience and qualified resources and to align processes within the One NoBo framework.
* At all times, comply with SGS Code of Integrity and Professional Conduct and with the impartiality requirements of the Notified Body.

  
**Qualifications**

**Core Competencies**

* Sound technical judgement, impartiality and integrity
* Structured, evidence-based and documented decision-making
* Delivery focused, biased to action
* Learning agility with digital and AI tools
* Strong collaboration across cultures in a matrix organisation
* Clear written and verbal communication, including to authorities and accreditation bodies
* Self-motivated and able to work independently

**Skills & Knowledge**

* **NoBo framework –** In-depth knowledge of the New Legislative Framework (Regulation (EC) 765/2008, Decision 768/2008/EC), the Blue Guide, and the role, obligations and impartiality requirements of Notified Bodies.
* **Accreditation –** ISO/IEC 17065 in depth; working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17020, 17021-1 and 17025 and of competence management in conformity assessment bodies.
* **Machinery Regulation –** Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, including the essential health and safety requirements of Annex III and the conformity assessment procedures; Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and the transition between the two.
* **Machinery standards –** EN ISO 12100, EN ISO 13849-1/-2, EN IEC 62061 and relevant type-C standards; functional safety assessment (PL/SIL) of safety-related control systems.
* **Cyber and software –** Protection against corruption and safety and reliability of control systems under the Regulation; IEC 62443 series; interplay with the Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847).
* **AI regulation –** Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), in particular high-risk AI systems as safety components of products, and its integration into the Machinery Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
* **AI technical –** Machine-learning lifecycle, data quality, verification and validation of AI-based safety functions; ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894 and ISO/IEC TR 5469.
* **AI tools –** Practical use of generative AI tools, prompt design, and the ability to specify, test and validate AI-assisted workflows with appropriate data protection.
* **Digital –** Certification management platforms (ProCert or similar), Power BI, SharePoint; Python or low-code automation is an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years in a Notified Body or conformity assessment body for machinery (technical file review, EC/EU type-examination, quality system assessment), with documented qualification as assessor or reviewer.
* Direct experience of accreditation assessments and notifying-authority processes.
* Experience in functional safety assessment of machinery control systems.
* Experience in deploying or validating digital or AI tools in a regulated or technical environment – advantageous.
* Experience working with international affiliates, including APAC, in a matrix organisation – advantageous.
* Exposure to the Rail Interoperability Directive (EU) 2016/797 – advantageous.

**Qualifications**

* Must – Master's degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics or automation engineering, or equivalent.
* Must – business-grade English and fluent Spanish.
* Desirable – functional safety qualification (e.g. FS Engineer, CMSE).
* Desirable – formal AI training or qualification (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, machine-learning coursework).
* Desirable – Auditor/Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 19011) issued by an accredited body; additional language capability.

**Performance Indicators & Deliverables**

* Machinery Regulation procedures and templates released in ProCert and in use within 6 months of onboarding.
* Number of resources qualified and authorised for machinery under One NoBo (including China) versus annual plan.
* Turnaround time of machinery files routed through One NoBo versus annual target.
* Share of machinery projects managed in ProCert (target 100%).
* No major findings on machinery scope in accreditation and notification assessments.
* AI-assisted workflows validated and deployed, with measured time saved and no conformity decisions taken by AI.
* Process assessments of authorised affiliates completed as planned.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a flexible schedule and remote work model with some visits per month to our office in Madrid.
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Conversational AI / Voice UX Designer to help shape the next generation of AI-powered customer experiences.

In this role, you will design natural, intuitive, and effective conversational experiences for autonomous AI agents that interact with customers through voice and digital channels.

Working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, AI specialists, product teams, and customers, you will translate business requirements and customer journeys into conversational experiences that balance usability, efficiency, and business outcomes.

Unlike traditional rule-based chatbots, our AI agents can understand context, reason across multiple steps, and execute actions on behalf of customers. Your challenge will be to make these capabilities accessible through conversations that feel natural, trustworthy, and effortless.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Conversational Experience Design**

* Design end-to-end conversational experiences for AI agents, primarily focused on voice interactions.
* Define conversation flows, dialogue patterns, agent personality, tone of voice, and communication guidelines.
* Design natural interactions that account for interruptions, ambiguity, clarifications, context retention, and unexpected user behavior.
* Create effective fallback strategies, error recovery mechanisms, and seamless escalation to human agents.
* Ensure conversational experiences are accessible, inclusive, and aligned with customer expectations.

**Agentic AI Experience Design**

* Translate complex business processes into intuitive conversational journeys that leverage autonomous AI capabilities.
* Design interactions where AI agents can gather information, make decisions, execute actions, and guide users through multi-step processes.
* Define appropriate conversational boundaries, confirmation mechanisms, and user control over AI-driven actions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize agent instructions, conversational behaviors, and orchestration from a UX perspective.
* Balance conversational flexibility with predictability, reliability, and business requirements.

**UX Research & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze customer journeys, use cases, and user needs to identify opportunities for conversational automation.
* Conduct conversation reviews, usability testing, and iterative design improvements.
* Analyze transcripts and interaction metrics to identify friction, misunderstandings, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering and customer teams to continuously refine conversational experiences based on real-world usage.
* Help define and track conversational quality metrics, including task completion, containment, customer satisfaction, and interaction efficiency.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers to design and implement conversational experiences for enterprise customers.
* Participate in customer workshops to understand business requirements, user expectations, and operational constraints.
* Collaborate with product and AI engineering teams to align conversational design with platform capabilities.
* Produce clear design documentation, conversation flows, sample dialogues, and behavioral guidelines.
* Advocate for human-centered design principles throughout the development lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience in Conversational UX Design, Voice UX Design, Conversation Design, or a closely related discipline.
* Hands-on experience designing conversational interfaces such as voice assistants, virtual agents, or AI-powered chatbots.
* Strong understanding of conversational design principles, dialogue management, and user-centered design methodologies.
* Experience creating conversation flows, dialogue scripts, and conversational prototypes.
* Familiarity with Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI.
* Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, intuitive conversational experiences.
* Experience analyzing user interactions and using qualitative or quantitative insights to improve UX.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and customers.
* Professional proficiency in English.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience designing conversational experiences for contact centers, customer service, or enterprise automation.
* Practical experience with LLM-powered conversational agents and agentic AI systems.
* Familiarity with prompt design, AI behavioral instructions, and conversational guardrails.
* Understanding of voice-specific technologies and challenges, including speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), latency, and turn-taking.
* Experience working with conversational AI platforms such as Talkdesk, Google Dialogflow, Cognigy, or similar solutions.
* Familiarity with conversational analytics, intent classification, and knowledge-base optimization.
* Experience in consulting, customer-facing delivery, or multidisciplinary technology projects.
* Additional languages, particularly Spanish or Portuguese.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* AI agents deliver natural, coherent, and effective conversational experiences.
* Customers can successfully complete complex tasks through intuitive voice interactions.
* Conversational friction, unnecessary repetitions, and failed interactions are progressively reduced.
* Engineering teams receive clear, actionable conversational design specifications.
* Conversational experiences are continuously improved using real customer interactions and measurable outcomes.

**About us**
============

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

**About the role**
==================

We are hiring one Head of Product who is personally accountable for the quality, monetization and retention of a consumer product in the Utility niche, used by millions of people and monetized through a web-to-web subscription trial.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a coordination role. You will use Claude and Claude Code daily to research, prototype, spec, test and sometimes ship product yourself. You will own the roadmap, the standard of what reaches production, and the team that delivers it.

We are resetting how we build. The goal is fewer things shipped properly, not more things shipped fast: every funnel works, every release is tested, and every feature earns its place with data. Quality is the first job; ARPU and retention growth follow from it.

**Key responsibilities**

**Quality and delivery (the first accountability)**

* Own the quality bar for everything in production. If a funnel is broken or a release regresses, it is your problem and you fix the process, not only the bug.
* Run the delivery rhythm: daily stand-ups with engineering and QA, sprint planning, release go/no-go. Limit work in progress. No new feature starts while a critical bug is open.
* Write specs engineers can build from without guessing: user story, edge cases, analytics events, acceptance criteria and test cases. Review what ships against them.
* Work with QA to build regression coverage for the revenue-critical journeys and to monitor them in production.
* Define what “done” means: tested, instrumented, flagged, rolled out in stages and watched after release.

**Hands-on building with AI**

* Use Claude and Claude Code every day to research, analyze data, prototype flows, write specs and reproduce bugs. You can build a working prototype or a small fix yourself instead of waiting for a ticket.
* Judge AI output critically. You know the difference between a demo and something good enough to be number one in the niche, and you hold the team to it.
* Set the AI-first working standards for the product team: shared prompts, Claude Code conventions, review practices and design-to-code workflow.

**Team building**

* Hire and lead the product team around you, for example product managers, QA and design, as the scope requires. Every hire must work fluently with AI tools.
* Define roles, hiring bar and onboarding. Coach people, give direct feedback and remove people-process blockers.

**Product strategy and roadmap**

* Own one prioritized roadmap, built from user research, funnel data and competitor analysis. Say no to things that do not move quality, conversion or retention.
* Keep a living competitor teardown (flows, pricing, paywalls, onboarding, features) and use it to set the quality benchmark.
* Partner with the Managing Director on priorities and trade-offs, and report progress on a fixed cadence.

**Monetization and ARPU**

* Own D7 and D30 ARPU and trial-to-paid conversion. Run pricing, packaging and paywall experiments end to end: hypothesis, design, sample size, rollout, read-out.
* Find untapped revenue (plans, upsells, add-ons, cross-tool usage) and rank by impact.

**Retention and engagement**

* Own retention and churn targets. Use cohort analysis to find drop-off and friction, then fix them with onboarding, engagement loops and a clean cancellation and support experience.

**Research and data**

* Run continuous discovery with real users: interviews, session replays, support tickets, reviews.
* Define product metrics, keep the tracking plan accurate and make decisions from data, not opinion.

**Growth collaboration**

* Work with CRO and marketing so landing pages, messaging and onboarding match what the product delivers, and plan launches together.

**Must-have experience**

* **Product leadership:** 5+ years in product for D2C subscription products (web-to-web, web-to-app), including 2+ years as a senior or lead PM, ideally as the single accountable owner of one product.
* **Quality track record:** You can show a product you took from buggy or unstable to reliable. You can explain the release process, QA setup and metrics you introduced, and what changed.
* **Builder skills:** You build things yourself. Show us a prototype, internal tool or shipped feature made with Claude Code or similar, and explain how you directed the AI and checked its output.
* **Daily AI workflow:** Claude or an equivalent is part of how you research, analyze, spec and prototype every day, not an occasional helper.
* **Technical fluency:** You write precise requirements, join architecture and trade-off discussions, read code well enough to review a pull request and reproduce a bug.
* **Monetization and retention:** Measurable growth in ARPU and retention, including pricing, paywall or packaging experiments you ran end to end.
* **Funnels and UX:** Deep understanding of high-converting consumer journeys (onboarding, paywall, checkout, cancel) and the discipline to test every step.
* **Analytics and experimentation:** Hands-on with Mixpanel (or similar) and SQL or BI tools. You design and read A/B tests and manage feature flags and staged rollouts.
* **Research and competitor analysis:** A repeatable method for user discovery and for benchmarking competitors, with examples of decisions it changed.
* **Team building:** Experience hiring and leading product, QA or design people, ideally in an AI-first way of working.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with utility or productivity consumer products, or with high-traffic SEO-driven products.
* Exposure to paid acquisition (Meta Ads, Google Ads) and how traffic quality affects trial conversion and retention.
* Experience with payments, billing, trials and cancellation flows, including refund and chargeback reduction.
* Hands-on experience with test automation (Playwright, Cypress) or session-replay and error-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Claude Design or similar AI design tools for fast UI iteration.

**Leadership attributes**

* **Radical ownership:** You treat the product as your own. A bug in production or a broken funnel bothers you more than a missed feature date.
* **Quality obsession:** You care about the details of UX, specs and outcomes, and you push back,

including on leadership, when something is not good enough to ship.

* **Disciplined pace:** You know speed without quality is slower. You limit work in progress, say no, and sequence work so it lands finished.
* **Structured and analytical:** You turn ambiguous problems into hypotheses and tests, and your

conclusions rest on data.

* **Builder mindset:** You prefer to prototype, test and show over writing long documents.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex ideas simply to non-technical stakeholders and give engineers precise technical context.
* **Talent magnet:** You attract and grow strong people, and you set a bar others rise to.

**This role is not for you if**

* You prefer to manage a backlog and hand work to others rather than get hands-on with the product and the AI tools.
* You measure yourself by features shipped rather than by funnels that work and revenue retained.
* You need a large team of project managers, researchers and designers around you to function from day one.
* You are not comfortable owning a production problem and its root cause in public.

**Location**
============

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**

=====================

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: PRODUCT MANAGER – REWARDED OFFERS
description:
##### **WHO WE ARE**

At **Macadam**, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over **15 million users worldwide**, we help people turn daily steps into positive habits that improve health and wellbeing.

Our product sits at the intersection of **gamification, lifestyle and wellbeing**, with a colourful, playful, character-driven universe rooted in mobile gaming.

##### **THE ROLE**

Users earn Macadam's coins by walking, and also by doing things our partners pay for: playing games in offerwall, taking surveys, shopping through cashback, completing brand challenges. These rewarded offers are one of our largest revenue streams, and the work is only getting bigger.

We're creating a dedicated Rewarded Offers squad and looking for its first Product Manager. You will sit in a small, autonomous team: you, a senior full-stack developer, and support from a designer and a data analyst. You report to our Head of Product, and will partner closely with the Revenue team in charge of partner negotiation. You own the problem and the outcome: more users earning through offers every day, with a healthy margin. You frame it, decide what matters, ship with the team, then read the numbers and make the call. And where the change is small, you build it yourself.

This is a role for someone with a "product builder" mindset, looking to take strong ownership and to deliver high impact.

***This role is based in Barcelona. We're looking for candidates who are already living in the city or ready to relocate.***

##### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the squad's metrics: the share of daily users who complete an offer, revenue and margin per earning user, for offerwall, survey and affiliation.
* Own the roadmap: frame the problem, prioritise hypotheses, write product specs, run A/B tests, read results, and decide next steps.
* Integrate new providers with your developer, help rank offers by what they actually earn, and keep the rewards economy healthy.
* Work with the Revenue team and our partners (offerwall and survey providers, affiliate networks) to turn market opportunities into product changes, with care for fraud and compliance.
* Build end-to-end with AI: deliver product features, from initial design and prototyping to production, when the technical environment allows.
* Grow with the squad: the scope widens as the team does, with the option of more developers over time.

##### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 2–4 years in product management (or a close role, such as growth, product analyst or product owner with features you shipped end to end), ideally on a consumer mobile app.
* Solid data and problem-solving mindset: you can pull a funnel, define a metric, run an A/B test and tell when a result doesn't hold up. SQL or a BI tool (Metabase, Mixpanel, Amplitude or similar) is a plus.
* Experience working side by side with developers on trade-offs and scope.
* Advanced AI proficiency & technical fluency: a habit of working with AI tools to conduct user research and competitive analysis, and to set up automated workflows that accelerate product discovery and execution.
* Design and user experience sensitivity.
* Autonomy and judgement: you propose the plan and don't wait for one.
* Clear written English. French or Spanish is a strong plus.

##### **NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with offerwalls, surveys, affiliate, cashback, or marketplaces.
* Background in gaming, gamified or rewards products.
* Familiarity with partner integrations (APIs, postbacks, attribution), fraud and reward integrity, and technical understanding.
* Interest in behavioural design.

##### **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Real ownership of a revenue-critical area, reaching 15+ million users.
* Direct work with a senior full-stack developer, and the chance to build your own squad.
* Growth, learning and exposure in an international team.
* Offices in the heart of **Barcelona**.
* Hybrid working culture with international flexibility.
* Meal voucher.
* Wellness allowance (Wellhub).
* Private healthcare (Alan).
* 4 extra Macadam holiday days.
* Friday team lunch.
* Company events and offsites.

##### **WHY MACADAM?**

We don't just talk about change, we walk it. Our principles:

***Make it happen***: take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.

***Build together, win together***: support and challenge each other to go further.

***Trust the data***: decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.

***Build for people***: design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.

***Think bigger***: set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Want to see what we're about? Check out our website, Linkedin, Notion and Instagram page.

*Macadam is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team.*

###### **Come walk with us. Join the movement and become a part of something meaningful!**

title: CS Team Lead
description:
**Who we are**
==============

With a global **mission** to help people live longer, healthier lives, **Docplanner** Group is the world's biggest healthcare platform. We serve patients and healthcare professionals across 13 countries in Europe and LATAM, with a network of more than 2.8 million healthcare professionals and over 20 million bookings every month. Our global team of around 3,000 people works from offices in Warsaw, Istanbul, Rome, Barcelona, Mexico City, Bogotá, Curitiba, Rio, Munich and Berlin.

**About the role**
------------------

Clinic Agenda is growing, and so is the number of clinics that rely on it every day. We are looking for a Team Lead to turn a Customer Success team of around 8 reps into the reason clinics stay and grow with us.

Our Customer Success processes are mature and well established. We expect you to master them quickly and then challenge them: give you feedback on what you think it works, sharpen what doesn't, and move the team from reacting to churn requests to a proactive, commercial and data-driven approach. You will be measured on results, and you will have the autonomy to decide how to get them.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Numbers first.** You open every discussion with data. You know your portfolio's health, churn and expansion figures without having to look them up.
* **Data-driven decisions.** Intuition gives you a hypothesis; data confirms or rejects it. You test, measure and adjust.
* **You escalate always with** **a proposal.** When something needs leadership's attention, you bring the analysis, the options and your recommendation.
* **Ownership and accountability.** You take full ownership of your team's results. When a target is at risk, you are the first to see it, explain it and present the plan to recover it.
* **Outcomes over activity.** You care about results, not about how busy the team looks.
* **You build people.** You set clear expectations, give honest feedback and measure your own success by how much your reps improve. You also take tough decisions if needed.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Build a high-performing team**

* Lead, coach and develop around 8 Customer Success Reps, some of them early in their careers.
* Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s and call reviews, and give direct, actionable feedback.
* Spot skill gaps early, build training plans to close them and track each rep's performance continuously.

description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

We are looking for an **E-Merchandising Specialist** to provide support to the E-Merchandising team across our Ready-to-Wear and Shoes categories, contributing to the day-to-day management and optimisation of our global ecommerce platform.

**Your role will be:**

* Support the team with the preparation and online setup of the Ready-to-Wear and Shoes assortments, across both Menswear and Womenswear.

* Assist with daily operational tasks and ad hoc projects, ensuring deadlines and priorities are followed up.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role (requirements):**

* Previous experience or exposure to Merchandising, ideally within the fashion or luxury industry, with an interest in digital/ecommerce.
* Good analytical and numerical skills, with an interest in reporting and performance analysis.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with different departments.
* A customer-centric mindset and commercial awareness.
* Drive, enthusiasm and passion for the brand.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in both Spanish and English.
* Knowledge of Contentsquare, Google Analytics or other online merchandising solutions would be beneficial.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You are a curious, versatile creative who is developing genuine range across disciplines and creative practices. You take craft seriously and bring energy and rigour to everything you touch. As a Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the intersection of multiple creative practices, working with directors, designers, consultants, and clients to shape work that is both beautiful and effective. Versatility is your superpower.

You are building hands-on creative ability across more than one discipline. You are developing an understanding of how different creative practices connect — and how to flex between them depending on what a project needs. You are growing more comfortable across multiple creative formats and contexts. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are genuinely interested in where culture, business, and design are heading next.

You are developing your cross-disciplinary instincts. You are curious about how different creative practices connect and influence each other, and you are beginning to see how your work fits into a larger creative whole. You know that frameworks are the starting point. The willingness to learn what a project actually needs — and the craft to deliver your part of it with care — is what makes you valuable here.

You work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior creatives. You participate in creative conversations, contribute to translating briefs into compelling work, and are developing a point of view that spans more than one creative practice. You execute across projects end-to-end, bringing your skills to the right moments under the direction of more experienced team members. Your growing breadth is your differentiator. The quality of your craft is your responsibility.

Day to day, you will:

* Contribute to creative projects from first brief to final delivery, executing with care and quality across the disciplines and touchpoints you are responsible for.
* Work with briefs and strategic direction to produce clear, compelling creative across multiple formats — developing your instinct for which approach fits a given moment.
* Participate in client-facing creative work. Attend workshops, support the presentation of ideas, absorb feedback with curiosity, and apply it to your work quickly and thoughtfully.
* Contribute across creative practices with growing confidence, bringing genuine craft wherever the work demands it — and being willing to stretch beyond your primary comfort zone.
* Work with AI as a skilled collaborator. Use it to explore ideas, accelerate production, and pressure-test decisions. Keep human creativity and craft at the centre of everything that goes out the door.
* Contribute to a high creative standard. Share your perspective when it adds value, engage constructively in feedback, and actively learn from the senior creatives and different disciplines around you.
* Stay ahead of where design, culture, and communication are going. Bring fresh perspective into the studio and into client conversations — not just within your own practice, but across the creative landscape.
* Stay curious about the full shape of a project. Begin to connect the dots between what different practitioners are solving and what the work ultimately needs to achieve.

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Reading a brief carefully and asking the right questions when something is unclear.
* Moving between creative disciplines with growing confidence. You are building a clear sense of what good looks like across different formats and contexts.
* Participating in the presentation of creative work, speaking clearly about the decisions behind it and taking feedback constructively.
* Supporting a project across disciplines with reliability and care. You do your piece well and stay attuned to how it fits into the wider whole.
* Using AI to speed up the right parts of a creative process without letting it flatten your thinking.
* Moving between strategic altitude and hands-on craft without losing your footing. Equally effective in a brief-setting conversation and a design review.
* Contributing your point of view with confidence, even early in your career. Good ideas can come from anywhere.
* Staying calm and focused when briefs are open or timelines are tight. You figure out what you can do and do it well.

What You'll Bring

* A degree in design, creative arts, communication, or a related field. Equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth of creative thinking and craft is equally welcome.
* 2 to 4 years working in a creative agency, brand consultancy, in-house studio, or professional services environment, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft, curiosity, and early signs of range across creative disciplines.
* Developing ability across more than one creative practice, and an eagerness to grow that range further over time.
* Some exposure to client or stakeholder-facing work, and a willingness to develop that confidence further in a supported environment.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft and early creative range — showing that you care about quality and are curious enough to work across more than one format or discipline.
* Practical fluency with relevant creative tools across multiple disciplines, and comfort picking up new tools as the work demands.
* An open and curious approach to AI tools, and a growing sense of where they help and where human judgment and craft matter more.
* Excellent English language skills; additional languages are an advantage and may be particularly valued in certain locations.

Who You'll Work With

As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most advanced design solutions.

Additional info

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.

As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Senior Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.

You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.

You contribute to the studio’s creative and technical exploration. You proactively explore, test, and develop working knowledge of emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover with the team around you. You are developing a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.

You also work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior team members. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You contribute to workshops, help shape narratives, and support organisations in understanding not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.

Day to day, you will:

* Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
* Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
* Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
* Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualisation, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
* Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
* Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
* Contribute to building capability across the studio. You participate in workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
* Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
* Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
* Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
* Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call

title: Program Coordinator, IE Impact

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Education & Student Experience** is looking for a **Program Coordinator** to join its team!

**IE IMPACT** is IE University’s undergraduate core studies learning journey, totaling 21 ECTS, and required of all IEU students. IE University’s four core courses consist of one in the **Humanities**, one in **Technology,** the **Entrepreneurial Mindset & Practice** course and the **IE Challenge** course**.** The IE Impact Learning Journey aims to equip students with the knowledge, mindsets and skills needed to be innovative problem-solvers who lead positive change. The entire learning journey centers the value of diversity and a commitment to sustainability (within the broad understanding of the SDGs). The IE Impact program is IE University’s largest academic feat thanks to its scale, transversal composition and mission. The IE Impact team is responsible for its successful operational execution.

The **Program Coordinato**r is a great opportunity for current IEU staff who are assistants and seek a promotion (with the support of their current supervisors). It is also a great opportunity for young professionals who seek to form part of an international team and develop themselves further in an academic institution. It is also a great opportunity for others who perhaps have been out of the workforce for a period and are eager to contribute to our team their maturity and eagerness to work outside of the home.

The **program coordinator** role is highly administrative and requires a lot of time seated at a computer responding to student and faculty email inquiries and occasional in-person drop-ins, which makes up approximately 85-90% of the work.

The **program coordinator** role is also asked to balance administrative tasks with creative work, contributing to “beyond-the-classroom" activities for students that serve to reinforce IE Impact learning objectives, as well as contributing to the organization of training activities for faculty.

The **program coordinator** role engages with many different and transversal stakeholders across the entire university (staff, students, faculty, guests) and such interactions require professionalism, intercultural skills, maturity and empathy.

title: Senior Business Innovation Consultant
description:
Reports to: Lead Business Innovation Strategist / Design Strategy Director/VP

**About Mormedi**

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

**Our Mission: To help businesses navigate change confidently.**

We accomplish our mission by:

* Developing practical, human-centred solutions that drive growth, sustainability, and transformative impact;
* Making strategy and visions of the future tangible as a way to gain and maintain momentum;
* Establishing partnerships across industries for non-traditional approaches and better connected ecosystems;
* Creating strategies that help our clients lead the future with purpose.

**Our Values**

* Long-term thinking: We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* Meaningful experiences: We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* Systemic elegance: We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* Maker mentality: We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

Role overview

As a Senior in our Business Innovation practice, you will work at the intersection of human-centred design, business planning, financial modelling, and venture validation. You will autonomously lead project workstreams—from uncovering customer insights and framing new venture hypotheses to building robust business cases, operating models, and market launch roadmaps—guiding junior team members and collaborating directly with clients to deliver high-impact strategic deliverables on time and on budget.

This role is for you if

You want to take full ownership of business innovation streams that reshape how clients compete, from early exploration to commercially viable go-to-market solutions. You thrive in collaborative studio environments, enjoy building financial models from scratch, facilitating executive co-creation workshops, mentoring emerging consultants, and defending business viability directly with C-suite stakeholders.

What you will own

* Autonomous execution and content leadership over complete strategic workstreams, several smaller projects, or major work packages within large client programs, taking ownership of content excellence, business case viability, and project profitability.
* High-level strategic storytelling, translating abstract user insights, market dynamics, and unit economics into compelling presentation decks and executive arguments.
* Definition of business models, operating models, and financial feasibility frameworks in multidisciplinary projects led by Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI.
* Guiding, supporting, and mentoring Staff, Junior strategists, and Interns on business design methodologies, financial modelling, workshop preparation, and deliverable quality.
* Facilitation of co-creation workshops, client working sessions, and executive presentations.
* Support in commercial opportunities: helping define project scope, estimating effort, and drafting strategic POV materials for pitch proposals.
* Participation in creating thought leadership content (articles, case studies, whitepapers) and industry presentations to strengthen market positioning.
* Contribution to growing the Business Innovation practice, evolving proprietary business design toolkits, and scaling client accounts.
* Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration & Studio Community: Collaborate closely with Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI teams to ensure commercial viability and business models inform physical and digital design execution, actively fostering a cohesive Mormedi studio culture and cross-discipline teamwork.
* Quality & Environmental Leadership (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001): Responsible for upholding Quality and Environmental Management System standards within assigned streams, driving continuous process efficiency, and embedding sustainable business practices and circular economy principles into deliverables.

**How success is measured**

**Project Delivery (~80%):** Delivery quality, project timeline/budget compliance, client satisfaction (CSAT 4-5), financial rigor, and mentoring impact.

**Commercial & Marketing Support (~20%):** Support in proposal preparation, organic account opportunity identification, content creation, and methodology enhancements.

**What you bring**

**Senior Strategic & Business Expertise –** Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Business Innovation, Strategy Consulting, Venture Building, or Strategic Design, with a strong portfolio showcasing complex innovation and business model engagements delivered for diverse industries.

**Financial Modeling & Business Craft –** Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and interpret complex financial models from scratch to support unit economics, revenue forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

**Methodology Mastery –** Deep knowledge of human-centered innovation, business model canvas, operating model design, customer journey mapping, and qualitative research methods.

**Executive Storytelling & Facilitation –** Exceptional ability to structure complex arguments into clear, visually compelling presentations (PowerPoint/Miro) and facilitate board-level working sessions.

**Project Stream Leadership –** Proven ability to organize project streams, prioritize tasks across multiple projects, and keep project profitability and margin targets in mind.

**AI Literacy & Responsible AI –** Fluency in applying Generative AI tools (LLMs, research synthesis engines, automation platforms) to business modeling, market research, and scenario planning while ensuring compliance with the EU AI Act, client IP protection, and data privacy.

**Software & Tools**

**Executive & Financial Suite:** Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel for financial modeling, P&L projections, and planning; PowerPoint for executive storytelling; Word).

**Collaboration & Workshop Platforms:** High proficiency in collaboration platforms such as Miro.

**Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools applied to market scanning, trend analysis, and research synthesis under strict confidentiality rules.

**Visual Suite (Nice to have):** Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop overview).

**Languages:** High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; a third language is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

An appropriate Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field, with a proven interest in design thinking.

Willingness to travel for client meetings, field research, and workshops.

Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

A valid driving license (minimum 2 years of seniority) is appreciated.

title: Director of Human Resources — Arquetipo Studio
description:
### **Build what Europe must own**

Building the companies behind Europe’s strategic sovereignty.

Our mission is to originate, operate and capitalise the European companies and technologies our sovereignty depends on.

We are a venture builder focused on dual-use deep tech. Every company we launch is born inside the studio, with its own team, capital and method, and goes to market ready to compete.

We work across three missions:

* **Spectrum Dominance.** Capabilities to operate in, protect and manage data across contested environments.
* **Sovereign Compute.** Secure, certifiable European silicon, ready for post-quantum cryptography.
* **Trusted Autonomy.** High-integrity mission autonomy for uncrewed systems.

Build with us.

### **The role**

We are looking for Arquetipo’s first Head of Human Resources. You won’t inherit a department: you’ll design from scratch how a venture builder attracts, organises, develops and retains Europe’s scarcest talent.

You will report directly to the COO. Your scope won’t be a single company but a system: the studio and each of the ventures born from it, each at its own stage of maturity.

This role isn’t for everyone. If you’re looking for a position with established processes, a large team and a low profile, this isn’t it. If you want your work to show in a continent’s technological capability, read on.

### **What you’ll do**

#### **Talent for critical missions**

* Design and execute the strategy for attracting technical and executive talent to the studio and its ventures.
* Run the recruitment policy, ensuring our talent is aligned with our goals and values.
* Build our own channels with universities, research centres and the wider tech ecosystem, and turn Arquetipo’s mission into an employer brand that attracts people who want to build, not just work.

#### **Organising a venture builder**

* Define the HR management model, tools and ways of working.
* Prepare each venture for independence: its own structure, policies and people team at the moment of spin-out.
* Coordinate employment management across a multi-entity, multi-site environment spanning Madrid, Málaga, Bilbao and our ventures’ locations.

#### **Culture and accountability**

* Translate our values into observable behaviours and real criteria for hiring, evaluation, promotion and exit.
* Design a performance system with clear objectives, identified owners, continuous feedback and consistent consequences.
* Establish a development programme for studio and venture leaders so they lead by example.

#### **Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment law and with the specific requirements of the sectors we operate in.
* Drive and oversee the company’s ethics and compliance programme as it relates to people.

#### **What we expect at 90 days**

* Hiring for critical positions under way.
* HR management procedures up and running.
* A standard hiring process, with explicit values assessment, operating across all open positions.
* A proposed compensation & benefits framework.

#### **What we expect at 12 months**

* Critical positions in the hiring plan filled on time.
* An accountability-based performance system in place across the studio and the ventures.
* An HR management model and people playbook that let us launch a new venture in weeks, not months.
* People metrics (turnover, time-to-hire, quality of hire, engagement) presented and defended quarterly before the leadership team.

### **What you need: technical skills**

#### **Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Human Resources.
* Experience building an HR function from scratch or leading rapid growth in a technology, industrial or engineering company.
* Proven experience hiring scarce technical profiles: hardware, embedded software, critical systems or R&D.
* Strong command of Spanish employment law.
* Experience designing compensation & benefits policies.
* Analytical judgement: you make decisions based on data.
* Professional English (C1 or above).
* Availability to work on-site in Madrid and to travel.
* Eligibility to obtain a personal security clearance.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience in defence, aerospace, semiconductors, space or other regulated sectors.
* Experience in venture builders, startup studios, groups with multiple portfolio companies or corporate innovation units.
* Postgraduate studies in People Management, Industrial Relations, Organisational Psychology or a related field.

### **What you need: values and ways of working**

Technical skills get you through the door. These decide whether you stay.

* **Accountability.** When something fails in your area, you don’t look for explanations elsewhere. And you build systems so the rest of the team can do the same.
* **You lead by example.** You never ask anyone to do what you wouldn’t do yourself. If you demand transparency or rigour, you’re the first to show it.
* **The mission guides your decisions.** You understand why technological sovereignty matters and turn it into concrete people decisions, even uncomfortable ones.
* **You’re part of the business, not a support function.** You understand the mission, the product, the cash plan and the technical challenges of each venture.
* **You combine closeness with high standards.** You care for people without lowering the bar. You have difficult conversations respectfully, on time and without beating around the bush.
* **Your decisions are guided by our values.** They are the criteria you act on.
* **You do first, then delegate.** At this stage you’ll write policies, run interviews and review contracts yourself. The team will come when the system and growth justify it.
* **Confidentiality.** You’ll handle sensitive information about programmes, partners and people. Discretion is part of the job, not an extra.

### **What we offer**

* The opportunity to design, from the ground up, the organisation of a venture builder that is building strategic capabilities for Europe.
* A seat on the leadership team, with direct influence over which companies we launch and with whom.
* Competitive compensation.
* Working alongside top-tier engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs in semiconductors, autonomy and artificial intelligence.

### **Our process**

* **Interview with the hiring manager** on mission, purpose and leadership style.
* **Interviews with studio and venture leaders**, including people who will work with you every day.
* **References and offer.** We’ll ask for references from people who have seen you lead, not only from those who have supervised you.

We’re not looking for the perfect CV. We’re looking for the person who best understands why we do what we do and who is willing to answer for how we do it.

title: Head Chef - Lucia Marbella Beach Club
description:
**Join the Nikki Beach Hospitality Group!**

**Position:** Head Chef – Lucia Marbella Beach Club  
**Location:** Marbella, Spain  
**Contract:** Full-time, permanent, year-round  
**Start Date:** Ideally January 2027, with earlier availability welcomed

 **Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, creative, and passionate Head Chef to lead the culinary operations at Lucia Marbella Beach Club.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key leadership role in shaping the culinary identity of Lucia, delivering exceptional dining experiences that reflect the concept's vibrant Mediterranean spirit and commitment to luxury hospitality.

Working closely with the Regional and Corporate Executive Chef, the Head Chef will oversee all aspects of kitchen operations, from menu development and culinary innovation to team leadership, financial performance, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional culinary expertise with strong leadership and business acumen, thriving in a dynamic, high-volume luxury hospitality environment.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute innovative menus aligned with the Lucia culinary concept, in collaboration with the Regional and Corporate Chef.
* Ensure exceptional standards of food quality, presentation, consistency, and guest satisfaction.
* Incorporate fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced ingredients while maintaining the concept's culinary identity.
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance the dining experience through creativity and innovation.
* Maintain consistency in culinary execution across all services, including peak operational periods and special events.

* Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring efficiency, organization, and seamless service delivery.
* Manage food costs, inventory, purchasing, stock control, and waste reduction to achieve financial targets.
* Monitor kitchen budgets and operational performance, implementing improvements where necessary.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure product quality, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, HACCP, hygiene, and health and safety regulations.

* Recruit, train, mentor, and develop a high-performing culinary team.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and professional working environment that encourages creativity, accountability, and excellence.
* Manage team scheduling, staffing levels, and productivity according to operational requirements.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and identify opportunities for professional development.
* Lead by example, maintaining high standards of professionalism, discipline, and teamwork.

* Work closely with the Regional and Corporate Chef to ensure alignment with the group's culinary standards and strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with the General Manager, F&B leadership, and service teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience.
* Support special events, private functions, and culinary activations.
* Respond proactively to guest feedback and continuously improve culinary offerings.

 **What we offer**  

* Full company benefits package, including service charge and other applicable benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development within an internationally renowned luxury hospitality group.

  
**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive culinary experience, including at least 2–3 years in a senior kitchen leadership position such as Head Chef or Executive Sous Chef.
* Proven experience in luxury hospitality, premium beach clubs, upscale restaurants, or internationally recognized dining concepts.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, seasonal ingredients, and contemporary culinary trends.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate multicultural culinary teams in high-volume environments.
* Excellent knowledge of food cost management, budgeting, inventory control, and kitchen profitability.
* Strong understanding of HACCP, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Creative, proactive, and hands-on leadership style with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to remain composed and deliver consistent results under pressure.
* Fluency in Spanish and professional working proficiency in English are highly desirable.
* Flexibility to work according to operational requirements, including weekends and holidays.

 **Why Join Nikki Beach?**

Established by Jack and Lucia Penrod, Nikki Beach Hospitality Group epitomizes barefoot luxury hospitality, curating transformative lifestyle experiences through its global collection of iconic beach clubs, hotels, resorts, residences, dining concepts, and pop-ups. Recognized among the world's best beach clubs and resorts, the brand continues to expand into new destinations and concepts, including Lucia, a restaurant and beach concept introduced in 2024.

For our team members, this means the chance to be part of a hospitality group with a celebrated 25-year legacy and an exciting future. Joining Nikki Beach Hospitality Group offers opportunities for growth and international exposure, with the ability to build a career across some of the world's most sought-after destinations. As part of the Nikki Beach family, you will help shape unforgettable moments and contribute to the future of luxury hospitality.

**Ready to bring your culinary vision to Lucia Marbella Beach Club? We would love to hear from you!**
