* Creatividad e interés por las nuevas tendencias gastronómicas, de restauración y mixología.
* Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y gestionar equipos en entornos de alta actividad y estacionalidad.

**Requesitos:**

* Experiencia mínima de 5 años en posiciones de responsabilidad dentro del departamento de Food & Beverage.
* Experiencia previa como Director/a de F&B o en una posición de liderazgo equivalente.
* Experiencia demostrable en gestión de múltiples outlets y equipos multidisciplinares.
* Formación superior en Dirección Hotelera, Turismo, Restauración o similar.
* Sólidos conocimientos de gestión presupuestaria, control de costes, análisis de KPIs y revenue.
* Conocimiento de herramientas de gestión y sistemas de F&B.
* Conocimientos de normativa de seguridad alimentaria, APPCC y prevención de riesgos laborales.
* Nivel alto de español e inglés. Se valorarán otros idiomas.
* Disponibilidad para trabajar en un entorno operativo dinámico y estacional como Ibiza.
* Permiso de trabajo válido en la Unión Europea.

**El reporte directo será al Director General.**

***Por qué unirte a nosotros?***

En Nômade, la hospitalidad no es solo una cuestión de operaciones: es conexión, emoción y experiencias.

Tendrás la oportunidad de liderar un departamento clave dentro de un concepto de hospitality único, contribuir a su evolución y dejar tu huella en una propuesta gastronómica que combina creatividad, excelencia y autenticidad.

Buscamos líderes que quieran ir más allá de gestionar operaciones: personas capaces de inspirar equipos, impulsar nuevas ideas y convertir cada experiencia en algo memorable.

***Compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades***

*En Nômade Temple estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno justo, inclusivo y respetuoso para todas las personas. Ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades en nuestros procesos de selección y garantizamos un trato equitativo, independientemente del género, raza, etnia, nacionalidad, religión, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación vigente. Todas nuestras decisiones de contratación se basan en el mérito, las cualificaciones profesionales y la afinidad con nuestros valores.*

**M̲i̲s̲s̲i̲o̲n̲ ̲o̲f̲ ̲t̲h̲e̲ ̲R̲o̲l̲e̲**

As **Director of Food & Beverage**, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing the overall strategy and operations of all Food & Beverage areas at Nômade Temple Ibiza, ensuring an exceptional gastronomic experience that is fully aligned with the brand's identity.

Your mission will be to drive operational excellence, develop high-performing teams and maximise the department's profitability, combining a strategic vision with a strong hands-on presence in daily operations.

You will work closely with the General Manager, Executive Chef, Outlet Managers and other departments to develop a distinctive food and beverage offering, ensuring that every detail of the guest experience is carefully considered.

**R̲e̲s̲p̲o̲n̲s̲i̲b̲i̲l̲i̲t̲i̲e̲s̲**

**L̲e̲a̲d̲e̲r̲s̲h̲i̲p̲ ̲&̲ ̲S̲t̲r̲a̲t̲e̲g̲y̲**

* Define and implement the overall Food & Beverage strategy, aligned with the hotel's objectives and the identity of Nômade Temple.
* Lead, supervise and develop the managers of the different outlets and Food & Beverage teams.
* Establish operational, commercial and financial objectives for each outlet.
* Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, creativity and guest orientation.
* Identify opportunities for improvement and drive new initiatives that enhance the gastronomic experience.
* Promote a people-focused leadership culture based on open communication, collaboration and talent recognition.
* Ensure a solid organisational structure, defining clear responsibilities, objectives and expectations for each position.
* Encourage collaboration between kitchen, restaurant service, bars and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.
* Identify opportunities for improvement and introduce initiatives that enhance both the gastronomic experience and the day-to-day working environment of the teams.

**O̲p̲e̲r̲a̲t̲i̲o̲n̲s̲ ̲&̲ ̲G̲u̲e̲s̲t̲ ̲E̲x̲p̲e̲r̲i̲e̲n̲c̲e̲**

* Oversee the daily operations of all Food & Beverage outlets, ensuring a smooth, consistent and high-quality service.
* Ensure that quality, presentation, service and hospitality standards are consistently met.
* Work closely with the Executive Chef on the development and continuous evolution of the gastronomic offering.
* Oversee staff scheduling, team allocation and operational requirements across all outlets.
* Ensure effective communication between kitchen, restaurant service, bars and other departments.
* Handle operational incidents, special requests and guest feedback, ensuring prompt and professional resolution.
* Maintain a strong presence on the floor, particularly during peak operating periods, leading by example.
* Oversee and coordinate Food & Beverage operations during special events, celebrations, private experiences and brand activations, ensuring flawless execution.
* Design and develop Food & Beverage concepts and offerings for events and special experiences, ensuring consistency with the concept and standards of Nômade Temple.

**F̲i̲n̲a̲n̲c̲i̲a̲l̲ ̲&̲ ̲C̲o̲m̲m̲e̲r̲c̲i̲a̲l̲ ̲M̲a̲n̲a̲g̲e̲m̲e̲n̲t̲**

* Prepare and manage the department's annual budget, continuously monitoring financial performance.
* Control food, beverage and labour costs, identifying opportunities for optimisation.
* Analyse key performance indicators (KPIs), sales performance, productivity and profitability across all outlets.
* Implement strategies to maximise revenue, average spend and overall profitability.
* Oversee purchasing, inventory management, storage and waste control processes.
* Analyse financial results and prepare regular performance reports for Management.
* Contribute to pricing strategies, promotions and commercial initiatives in collaboration with the relevant teams.

**T̲e̲a̲m̲ ̲M̲a̲n̲a̲g̲e̲m̲e̲n̲t̲ ̲&̲ ̲D̲e̲v̲e̲l̲o̲p̲m̲e̲n̲t̲**

* Lead, motivate and develop Food & Beverage teams, promoting internal talent and continuous learning.
* Participate in the recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Identify training needs and ensure all teams understand and consistently apply service standards.
* Foster a positive, inclusive and collaborative working environment.
* Conduct performance reviews and establish development plans for managers and their teams.
* Ensure efficient workforce planning and resource allocation according to business levels and hotel occupancy.

**Q̲u̲a̲l̲i̲t̲y̲,̲ ̲S̲a̲f̲e̲t̲y̲ ̲&̲ ̲C̲o̲m̲p̲l̲i̲a̲n̲c̲e̲**

* Ensure compliance with food hygiene regulations, health and safety standards and occupational risk prevention requirements.
* Oversee the correct implementation of HACCP procedures and quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with internal procedures and company policies.
* Coordinate internal and external audits, as well as the implementation of the corresponding action plans.
* Ensure the maintenance, cleanliness and overall presentation of all Food & Beverage areas.

**W̲h̲a̲t̲ ̲W̲e̲ ̲A̲r̲e̲ ̲L̲o̲o̲k̲i̲n̲g̲ ̲F̲o̲r̲**

* A professional with a strong track record in Food & Beverage leadership within luxury hotels, lifestyle hospitality concepts or fine dining establishments.
* Proven experience managing complex operations involving multiple outlets, restaurants and bars.
* A strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the ability to lead from the floor.
* Inspirational leadership, excellent communication skills and a strong ability to develop teams.
* A clear guest-oriented mindset and a genuine passion for creating memorable gastronomic experiences.
* Strong commercial awareness and financial analytical skills.
* A dynamic, proactive, organised and solution-oriented profile, with excellent adaptability.
* Creativity and a genuine interest in emerging trends in gastronomy, restaurant concepts and mixology.
* The ability to perform under pressure and manage teams in high-volume, seasonal environments.

**R̲e̲q̲u̲i̲r̲e̲m̲e̲n̲t̲s̲**

* Minimum of 5 years' experience in positions of responsibility within Food & Beverage.
* Previous experience as a Director of Food & Beverage or in an equivalent senior leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple outlets and multidisciplinary teams.
* Higher education degree in Hospitality Management, Tourism, Restaurant Management or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, cost control, KPI analysis and revenue management.
* Familiarity with Food & Beverage management tools and operational systems.
* Knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP procedures and occupational health and safety requirements.
* Fluent in Spanish and English. Additional languages will be considered an advantage.
* Availability to work in a dynamic and seasonal operational environment such as Ibiza.
* Valid EU work authorisation.

**R̲e̲p̲o̲r̲t̲i̲n̲g̲ ̲L̲i̲n̲e̲:** **The Director of Food & Beverage will report directly to the General Manager.**

***Why join us?***

At Nômade, hospitality is more than just operations — it is about connection, emotion, and creating meaningful experiences. You will have the opportunity to lead a key department within a unique hospitality concept, contribute to its evolution, and leave your mark on a gastronomic offering that combines creativity, excellence, and authenticity. We are looking for leaders who want to go beyond managing operations: people who can inspire teams, drive new ideas, and turn every experience into something truly memorable.

***Equal Opportunity Commitment***

*At Nômade Temple, we are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and respectful environment for everyone.We provide equal opportunities throughout our recruitment process and ensure fair treatment regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.All our hiring decisions are based on merit, professional qualifications, and alignment with our values.*

title: Director of Engineering – Intelligence
description:
**About PayCargo:**

Millions of shipments with goods and materials move around the world daily, by land, sea, or air.

PayCargo is the world's leading online payment solution that is revolutionizing the shipping and cargo world. With a fast and efficient way to reduce costs associated with payment processing, we help improve the speed and profitability of our customers' businesses.

PayCargo's platform connects payers and vendors across the cargo and logistics ecosystem, supporting payments, remittance data, integrations, vendor release workflows, customer-facing digital experiences, and intelligent workflow automation.

**About the Role:**

The Director of Engineering – Intelligence is a senior engineering leadership role responsible for leading PayCargo's Intelligence engineering organization, including Engineering and Quality Assurance, with primary responsibility for the technology team supporting the Rippey platform and PayCargo's broader intelligent workflow and automation capabilities.

This role bridges hands-on technical judgment with people leadership, cross-functional partnership, and strategic execution. The Director is accountable for team health, delivery outcomes, engineering standards, software quality, and the continued development of technical talent across the Intelligence engineering organization.

The Director partners closely with Product leadership to translate product priorities into sound technical plans and ensure the engineering organization executes against them predictably and with high quality.

The Director also partners closely with PayCargo Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, Delivery, and senior business leadership to ensure Intelligence capabilities evolve as an integrated part of the broader PayCargo technology platform. Infrastructure, DevOps, and Security remain separately managed functions; this role is expected to collaborate closely with those teams to support effective development, deployment, reliability, and operation of the Intelligence platform.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

The Director directly manages and leads the Intelligence Engineering and QA organization, including technical leads, engineers, QA professionals, and other technical contributors within those functions.

This role is responsible for performance management, career development, workload management, organizational design, and building a high-performing technology organization across Madrid and other locations supporting the Intelligence platform.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead and develop the Intelligence Engineering and QA teams.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across engineering disciplines.
* Set clear expectations for performance, delivery, quality, and professional growth.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations.
* Build and sustain a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Engineering leadership and HR on hiring, workforce planning, and organizational structure.
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering managers within the team.
* Reduce organizational bottlenecks and single points of failure through knowledge sharing, documentation, and cross-training.
* Build strong working relationships across Madrid, the United States, and other distributed technology teams.

**Delivery & Program Execution**

* Own engineering delivery accountability for the Intelligence platform and associated initiatives.
* Partner with Product and Delivery leadership to align on priorities, roadmap sequencing, capacity, scope, and risk.
* Translate agreed product requirements and priorities into actionable engineering plans.
* Ensure Engineering and QA operate as an integrated delivery organization with clear ownership throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Ensure teams operate with appropriate agile discipline, sprint cadence, testing standards, and release readiness.
* Proactively identify and resolve delivery risks, scope conflicts, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies.
* Maintain visibility into program health and communicate status clearly to the VP of Engineering and business stakeholders.
* Drive consistent engineering execution across teams, reducing variability in quality and improving delivery predictability.

**Technical Strategy & Architecture**

* Provide technical direction for the Intelligence platform, ensuring engineering decisions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with PayCargo's broader architecture.
* Partner with PayCargo architecture and engineering leadership to progressively integrate Intelligence capabilities into the broader PayCargo technology ecosystem.
* Participate in architecture reviews and guide teams toward reusable, platform-aligned solutions.
* Drive modernization of the Rippey application and technology stack where appropriate.
* Support the evolution of Intelligence capabilities toward AI-native document processing, workflow automation, integrations, and intelligent decisioning.
* Balance short-term delivery urgency with long-term platform health and technical debt reduction.
* Ensure technical decisions are documented, reviewed, and traceable.
* Identify opportunities to simplify application architecture, reduce unnecessary complexity, and improve engineering efficiency.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, DevOps, and Security teams on architecture, environments, deployment requirements, security standards, scalability, and production readiness.

**Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Serve as the primary engineering leader for the Intelligence organization.
* Partner closely with Intelligence Product leadership while maintaining clear accountability between Product and Engineering.
* Translate business goals and product strategy into engineering plans, capacity requirements, and delivery roadmaps.
* Communicate engineering risks, trade-offs, dependencies, and options clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Work closely with PayCargo Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, Delivery, Support, and other technology teams.
* Partner with Infrastructure and DevOps leadership on environment, deployment, performance, scalability, and operational requirements without assuming management responsibility for those functions.
* Support customer- or partner-facing technical discussions, escalations, implementations, and integration initiatives when needed.
* Represent the Intelligence engineering organization in cross-functional planning, prioritization, and strategic discussions.
* Help drive increasing alignment between the Intelligence engineering organization and the broader PayCargo technology organization.

**Quality, Security & Operational Excellence**

* Own software engineering quality and QA performance for the Intelligence platform.
* Ensure engineering teams consistently follow established secure coding, access control, and data handling standards.
* Establish QA and automated testing as integral parts of the engineering lifecycle rather than downstream activities.
* Drive improvements in code quality, test coverage, release readiness, and application observability.
* Partner with Infrastructure, DevOps, and Security teams on production reliability, deployment processes, incident response, monitoring, and security requirements.
* Participate in major incident response and post-incident reviews when Intelligence applications are involved, ensuring engineering actions are identified and completed.
* Establish and monitor engineering metrics for delivery predictability, software quality, team health, and application performance.
* Promote documentation and knowledge management practices across Engineering and QA.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Proven experience leading and developing multiple software engineering teams.
* Strong technical background in modern web application development, APIs, databases, and production systems.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, software quality, and engineering best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to drive delivery accountability and improve team execution at scale.
* Experience managing distributed engineering teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Strong stakeholder communication, cross-functional partnership, and executive-level reporting skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, protect team focus, and make sound trade-off decisions.
* Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining engineering talent.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment where Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, and Security are separate but closely partnered functions.

**Preferred Skills/Abilities:**

* Experience in fintech, payments, SaaS, logistics, cargo, workflow automation, or high-volume transactional systems.
* Experience building workflow, document processing, automation, or AI-enabled applications.
* Experience managing Engineering and QA teams.
* Experience successfully partnering with Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, and other shared technology functions.
* Experience leading application modernization, API standardization, or architectural transformation programs.
* Experience integrating acquired or independently developed technology platforms into a broader enterprise architecture.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Agile/Scrum, CI/CD practices, and engineering delivery metrics.
* Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams.

**You Will Likely Succeed If You:**

* Have a winning attitude and lead with energy and purpose.
* Are naturally curious and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Love solving complex organizational and technical problems.
* Are comfortable inheriting an existing technology organization and improving it without unnecessarily disrupting what already works.
* Are competitive and collaborative, and bring out the best in the people around you.
* Are assertive and confident, but humble enough to listen and adapt.
* Speak with clarity, write with precision, and listen with intention.
* Hold a high bar for engineering quality without creating unnecessary friction.
* Prioritize effectively across competing demands and help your teams do the same.
* Understand the difference between Product ownership and Engineering ownership and know how to build an effective partnership between the two.
* Work effectively across organizational boundaries and understand when to own an outcome versus when to partner with another technology function.
* Take ownership of outcomes — not just activity.

**Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of technical experience within software engineering, including at least 3 years in an engineering leadership role managing teams.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery accountability for complex, production-grade platforms or programs.
* Experience managing and developing Senior Engineers, technical leads, engineering managers, and QA professionals.
* Experience working with geographically distributed technology organizations.
* Financial services, payments, SaaS, logistics, workflow automation, or AI experience is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* The Intelligence Engineering and QA organization operates as a cohesive team with clear accountability and strong leadership.
* The Intelligence team delivers predictable, high-quality work with clear ownership and strong coordination with Product.
* Product and Engineering responsibilities are clearly defined, with Product owning the **what and why** and Engineering owning the **technical how and execution**.
* Engineers and QA professionals understand expectations, receive regular feedback, and grow in their careers.
* Product and business stakeholders receive realistic plans, transparent trade-offs, and consistent delivery.
* Engineering standards, automated testing, documentation, and software quality improve measurably.
* The Rippey platform becomes more scalable, maintainable, reliable, and increasingly aligned with PayCargo's broader technology architecture.
* The Intelligence engineering organization develops strong, effective partnerships with PayCargo's Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, and other shared technology teams.
* Intelligence engineering is increasingly integrated with the broader PayCargo technology organization while maintaining the focus and expertise necessary to deliver intelligent workflow and automation capabilities.
* The Director is a trusted technology leader who elevates both team capability and engineering culture.

**What We Offer:**

Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and bonus plan.

We care about your wellbeing and personal life. We offer vacation, sick and personal time off policies, and strong employee benefits appropriate to the local market.

Your success at PayCargo is determined by the impact that you are making, and how well you collaborate with the various teams that you interact with. Everyone at PayCargo is empowered to take ownership to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on efficiency, collaboration, and purpose.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce
description:
**Location:** Spain (preferred), MEA (Lebanon subject to local employment requirements)

**Publication Date:** 19/11/2026

If you apply, please include your CV.

  

We are looking for an **R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce** to join the Cargo Business Unit leadership team.

Together with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce, this role builds, runs and scales the businesses that surround Cargospot, connect it and monetise it. Product defines what we build and why; this role owns how it is built, run and scaled.
  
  
It is also CHAMP’s lead role for AI-native engineering: making MCP and agentic access a core capability of our products, and making AI a standard part of how every CHAMP team designs, builds, tests and ships software.

**Mission**

Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation and own the technology end to end, from architecture and cloud to delivery and operations, for four lines of business:

* **Joint Business & Interline Middleware —** the leading and largest interline and joint-business system for air cargo;
* **Cargospot Pay —** a new line of business with the ambition to become the number one payment provider in air cargo;
* **MCP & Agentic Layer —** the AI-native access layer that lets customers, partners and their AI agents use Cargospot products;
* **Booking Portals & APIs —** the digital channels and APIs through which the market quotes, books, tracks and pays with Cargospot airlines.
  

In parallel, lead the adoption of AI across CHAMP’s software development lifecycle.

**Why This Role**

* **Build, not inherit —** Build a new R&D organisation and platform around four growth businesses, with the mandate to set its architecture, standards and culture.
* **Global scale from day one —** Work from an installed base of over 200 airlines and GSAs and some 5,600 forwarders and GHAs, with real data and real transaction volumes from day one.
* **Shape AI at CHAMP —** Lead MCP, agentic products and AI-assisted engineering for the whole company, not just one team.
* **Stability and visibility —** A profitable company within the SITA Group, a seat on the Cargo Business Unit leadership team and direct exposure to EXCO.

##### **Responsibilities :**

*R&D Organisation and Leadership*

* Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation: engineering managers, tech leads, architects, developers, QA and SRE/cloud engineers, across locations and time zones.
* Define team topology, roles, career paths for leadership and senior IC tracks, and a strong hiring bar; lead senior engineering hiring and talent development.
* Build an ownership-driven, high-velocity engineering culture with strict quality standards; define and support the staff retention plan aligned with CHAMP objectives.
  

*Delivery of the Ecosystem & Commerce Portfolio*

* Own engineering delivery for joint-business and interline middleware, Cargospot Pay, the MCP and agentic layer, and booking portals and APIs, against the roadmap set with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce.
* Plan capacity, sequence releases and keep committed dates credible; make trade-offs, risks and dependencies visible early.
* Productise integration: standard connectors, reusable patterns and API standards that reduce the time and cost of every new airline, partner and integration.
* Support the COO’s delivery organisation with technical leadership on implementations, and pre-sales and RFP/RFI responses with architecture and technical answers.
  

*Architecture, Cloud and Technology Ownership*

* Own the overall architecture and technology roadmap for the Ecosystem & Commerce portfolio: integration layer, event-driven and API-first design, data model and platform services, aligned with Neo and the Director of Engineering & Platform.
* Own the cloud estate for this area: infrastructure, environments, cost management (FinOps), scalability and multi-region deployment.
* Own production reliability and operations: SRE practices, observability, incident management, availability and performance targets, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure security and compliance by design, including identity and access, data protection and, for Cargospot Pay, payment-industry requirements such as PCI DSS.
* Lead build, partner or buy assessments and the technical side of strategic partnerships, including payment providers and integration partners.
  

  

*MCP and Agentic Layer*

* Architect and build the MCP and agentic layer around Cargospot products, so customers’, partners’ and CHAMP’s own AI agents can securely discover, consume and transact through our APIs.
* Define the standards for agent access: authentication and authorisation, guardrails, auditability, rate limiting and usage metering.
* Build shared AI services that other CHAMP product lines can reuse.
  

*AI in the SDLC across CHAMP*

* Lead and promote AI-assisted engineering across CHAMP: tools, skills and plugins for coding, code review, testing, triage and documentation.
* Define the governance that keeps AI-assisted delivery fast and safe: automated quality guardrails, test coverage, review policies and secure use of AI tools.
* Measure the impact with clear engineering metrics such as DORA, release reliability and capacity, and share practices and results with all R&D teams.
  

*Engineering Excellence*

* Own CI/CD, test automation, release management and engineering standards for the portfolio.
* Make R&D measurable: capacity, flow, quality and delivery metrics visible to product, BU leadership and EXCO.
  

*Working with Other Departments*

* Work as one team with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce: product defines, R&D builds and runs.
* Work closely with the Director of Engineering & Platform on shared platform services, architecture and cloud.
* Work closely with the COO’s delivery and support organisation on implementation, hypercare and support.
* Work closely with Security, Infrastructure and the CCO organisation on compliance, partnerships and customer commitments.
  

  
  
  

##### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :**

* Proven leadership of distributed R&D organisations of 20+ engineers across several teams, countries and time zones, including managers and tech leads.
* Deep experience with integration platforms and APIs: microservices, event-driven architecture, API standards and high-volume B2B integrations.
* Strong cloud-native engineering background: public cloud, containers, CI/CD, observability, SRE and cost management.
* Hands-on leadership of AI-assisted engineering and agentic architecture, including MCP server integration and AI tooling in the SDLC.
* Experience with payments or fintech platforms, digital booking or e-commerce channels is a strong plus.
* Air cargo, freight or logistics domain knowledge is a strong plus.
* Data-driven management of engineering performance; disciplined, with high standards of quality and delivery.
  

##### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience
  

*Employment is subject to satisfactory reference and background checks, where applicable and permitted by local law.*

### **Our culture and values**

We believe happy employees create thriving work environments. With over 500 team members from 32 countries, speaking over 30 languages, CHAMP is a uniquely diverse and welcoming place to work. Our globally minded staff collaborates with clients and vendors worldwide from our offices in London, Frankfurt, Manila, and our Headquarters in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

**Security: the successful candidate will have to comply with CHAMP Security Requirements (including but not limited to CHAMP’s IT Security Policies, especially the ISMS Policy and the Acceptable Use Policy, mandatory courses, confidentiality and data protection, use of company assets, and incident reporting).**

  

CHAMP Cargosystems is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, ethnic background, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

Please note that any personal data that you submit along with your application will be processed by CHAMP and may be processed by any of its global entities as necessary. These data will be treated in strict compliance with the applicable data protection legislation (i.e. the Law of 2 August 2002 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, as amended, and Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016, - the GDPR -, which entered into force on 25 May 2018, as well as any other subsequent regulation).Please follow the link to the CHAMP Candidates Privacy Notice for further information.

**ABOUT THE WELLA COMPANY**
===========================

Together, **WE** enable individuals to look, feel, and be their true selves.

We are looking for a Director, eCommerce to lead the digital commerce agenda across the Southern Europe cluster. Based in Madrid and reporting directly to the General Manager, Southern Europe, this role will shape and accelerate profitable growth across Amazon, retailer.com, pure-play marketplaces, direct-to-consumer and emerging social commerce channels.

This is a cluster leadership role with end-to-end commercial accountability for the eCommerce agenda. The Director will combine business ownership, transformation and execution, partnering closely with local market teams and global eCommerce capabilities to translate strategy into scalable, consumer-led growth across Southern Europe.

The successful candidate will be a change agent and hands-on operator with strong expertise in Amazon and digital retail, a sharp commercial mindset, a genuine consumer lens and a proven ability to scale businesses through data-led execution, cross-functional influence and high-performing teams.

* Lead the strategic and operational delivery of the eCommerce business across Southern Europe, covering Amazon, retailer.com, pure-play marketplaces, direct-to-consumer and emerging social commerce channels.
* Own the eCommerce P&L and performance agenda, including net revenue, margin, investment effectiveness and return on investment, while setting clear priorities and standards across the cluster.
* Act as the digital commerce voice within the Southern Europe leadership agenda, shaping channel strategy, investment choices and activation plans together with the General Manager, Marketing, Sales and Finance.

* Develop a first-party data and CRM roadmap that expands data capture, improves audience activation and supports retention and repeat purchase.

* Shape the cluster approach to TikTok Shop and social commerce, assessing scalable opportunities and translating emerging consumer behavior into profitable growth models.

* Coordinate effectively across countries and functions, including in matrix environments without direct authority, deploying common playbooks and raising standards in data, content, digital shelf and operational excellence.

==================

* 10+ years of relevant eCommerce experience, with deep expertise in Amazon and other digital retail platforms.
* Proven commercial acumen, including ownership of a meaningful P&L and a track record of delivering profitable revenue growth.
* Strong leadership experience, including the management and development of teams across multiple digital disciplines.
* Deep knowledge of pure-play marketplaces and retailer.com models, ideally within a multi-market European environment.
* Direct-to-consumer experience and strong understanding of customer acquisition and retention levers, including LTV, CRM, repeat purchase and CAC.

===========

* A builder and growth hunter who sees white space, creates momentum and moves with urgency.
* Consumer-first and commercially sharp, operating as a full business owner rather than solely as a channel specialist.
* Collaborative and influential, able to align local, cluster and global stakeholders behind a common agenda.
* Comfortable balancing strategic direction with hands-on execution in a dynamic, evolving environment.

**SPECIALIZED SKILLS**
======================

* Strategic: business strategy, creativity, problem solving and decision making.
* Commercial: P&L management, revenue growth, investment prioritization and performance management.
* Digital and analytical: eCommerce platforms, digital shelf, CRM, retail media, attribution, forecasting and measurement.

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Operational excellence, reporting accuracy, and stakeholder collaboration

title: Growth Associate
description:
**About Mormedi**

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

**Our Mission:** To help businesses navigate change confidently.

We accomplish our mission by:

* Developing practical, human-centred solutions that drive growth, sustainability, and transformative impact;
* Making strategy and visions of the future tangible as a way to gain and maintain momentum;
* Establishing partnerships across industries for non-traditional approaches and better connected ecosystems;
* Creating strategies that help our clients lead the future with purpose.

**Our Values**

* **Long-term thinking:** We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* **Meaningful experiences:** We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* **Systemic elegance:** We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* **Maker mentality:** We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

**Role overview**  
As Growth Associate, you will help Mormedi reach the companies and executives it should be working with. Reporting directly to the Director of Clients, New Business and Institutional Relations, you will design and run the campaigns, events and market intelligence that open new conversations across aviation, rail, banking, energy, retail and industry.

**This role is for you if**  
You are curious about how large companies work and why they change. You enjoy turning an idea into a campaign, a list into a conversation and an event into a relationship. You want ownership and like seeing the direct result of your work.

**What you will own**

* **Target accounts:** mapping and prioritising companies in Spain and internationally, and building account cards with challenges, decision makers and entry points.
* **Campaigns:** designing, launching and optimising outbound and account-based campaigns aimed at senior executives, from messaging to follow-up.
* **Events:** organising Mormedi's own executive events, such as breakfasts and round tables, and preparing our presence at international trade fairs, including target lists, agendas and post-event follow-up.
* **Market intelligence:** tracking news, investments, leadership changes and transformation programmes that signal an opportunity for Mormedi.
* **Campaign content:** working with Brand and Communications on the materials behind each campaign and event.
* **Pipeline reporting:** tracking results and sharing a clear weekly view of what is working.
* **Quality and Environmental standards (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001):** following Mormedi's Quality and Environmental Management System procedures, including sustainable practices in events.

**How success is measured**

* **Pipeline generation (~70%):** meetings and qualified opportunities generated through campaigns and events.
* **Market presence (~30%):** quality of events, attendance of target executives and quality of market intelligence.

**What you bring**

* **Business curiosity:** Genuine interest in strategy, innovation and how companies compete.
* **Research and synthesis:** Ability to turn scattered information into clear, actionable insights.
* **Execution:** Ability to run campaigns and events end to end, with care for detail.
* **Persuasive writing:** Clear, concise messages in English and Spanish that make senior people want to reply.
* **AI literacy:** Comfortable using Generative AI tools for research, personalisation and analysis.

**Software & Tools**

* **Office Suite:** Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* **Commercial Tools:** Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM (Copper or similar).
* **Nice to have:** Email marketing or event platforms, Canva or Adobe.

**Languages**  
High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; a third language, such as Italian, German or French, is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

* Final-year student or recent graduate in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, International Relations or a related field.
* Eligibility for an internship agreement (convenio de prácticas).
* Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

**What we offer**

* A six-month paid internship at our Madrid office, with a real possibility of joining the team afterwards.
* Direct work with the New Business leadership from the first week, without layers in between.
* Exposure to international clients and projects across aviation, rail, banking, energy and retail.
* A way of understanding business through design and innovation that very few places can teach.

title: Expert Senior Manager, Process Excellence – Source to Pay (S2P)
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  
You will join the Process Excellence team within Bain’s Applied Technology & AI practice. The team helps clients rethink how they operate, combining deep process expertise with SAP and AI to deliver measurable business results. You will be embedded in multidisciplinary teams with Bain consultants and other experts in architecture, technology delivery, data science, engineering and design, serving leading companies across industries in large SAP S/4HANA and AI-enabled transformations.
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
  
Mission
  
  

* Lead end-to-end Source to Pay transformations, from spend analysis, sourcing and contracting to supplier management, purchasing, invoicing and payment.
* Redesign S2P processes with AI built in, deciding where AI agents, machine learning and automation should run a task, support a person or stay out, with the goal of simple, touchless and well-controlled processes.
* Act as business architect and trusted advisor in SAP- and AI-enabled programs, making sure technology choices serve business outcomes rather than drive them.
* Shape the value case, operating model, governance and controls of S2P transformations, from early diagnostic through implementation and scale-up.
* Deliver measurable impact across procurement and accounts payable: savings, spend under management, compliance, productivity, user experience and working capital.

Essential functions
  
  

* Lead current-state diagnostics, fact base development and future-state blueprinting across the S2P process: spend analytics, category and sourcing strategy for direct and indirect spend, contract management, supplier onboarding and management, requisition to order, goods and service receipt, and invoice to pay.
* Define target-state process design and key design principles, including where to standardize globally and where local, statutory or control requirements call for variation.
* Identify, size and prioritize AI use cases along the S2P process, such as spend classification, sourcing and negotiation assistants, contract analysis, supplier risk monitoring, supplier collaboration on direct materials forecasts and orders, guided buying and AI-based request intake, invoice capture and matching, and agents that resolve exceptions or answer supplier queries.
* Advise clients on how AI is changing what they expect from procurement and accounts payable, and turn it into end-to-end S2P process redesign rather than isolated use cases.
* Design how people and AI agents will work together, including roles, approval and decision rights, controls, audit trail, and the supplier, material and contract data that AI needs to work at scale.
* Identify gaps between business needs and the standard capabilities of SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms, and recommend standardization versus customization trade-offs.
* Shape value cases, KPIs and benefits tracking, so that transformations and AI investments are anchored in measurable outcomes.
* Design target operating models for procurement and accounts payable, including shared services, centers of excellence and the split of responsibilities between global, regional and local teams.
* Drive integration with adjacent domains such as Finance (R2R), Plan to Fulfil (including direct materials planning, supplier scheduling and inbound), Master Data and Tax.
* Lead client workshops and decision-making sessions, challenging legacy ways of working and aligning stakeholders on leading-practice choices.
* Act as process design authority through implementation, including end-to-end test scenarios for system integration and user acceptance testing, keeping the system integrator, technical and AI teams aligned with the intended outcomes.
* Support proposal development and commercial shaping for major SAP, AI and procurement transformation programs.
* International travel is required up to 50% of working time.

ABOUT YOU
  
  
Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in business administration, economics, engineering, information technology, business informatics or related fields.
* Preferred: Additional training in procurement or supply management (for example CIPS), finance, analytics or AI.

Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of professional experience, including significant experience in S2P process transformation within large SAP-enabled programs, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
* Extensive experience in process design and transformation across procurement, accounts payable and shared services organizations.
* Deep expertise in indirect spend and the purchase-to-pay backbone; strong preference for hands-on experience in direct procurement (for example raw materials and packaging sourcing, contracting and supplier management) and how it connects with planning and manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with AI or advanced automation in S2P processes within the last 1-2 years (for example shaping, designing, delivering or advising on a use case), with a clear view of the value delivered, the process changes it required and the lessons learned.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement and leading S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, GEP or equivalent, including their AI capabilities. Deep technical SAP architecture expertise is not required; the focus is functional process depth with a solid grasp of what the platforms can do.
* Able to describe what best-in-class S2P processes look like, what SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms support as standard, and where companies typically customize.
* Proven success engaging senior stakeholders such as CPOs, CFOs and heads of shared services, and acting as a trusted advisor in complex transformations.
* Experience in one or more relevant industries such as consumer products, retail, industrials, life sciences or manufacturing.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Knowledge, skills and abilities
  
  

* Deep end-to-end S2P expertise, connecting sourcing, contracts and supplier management with purchasing, receipt, invoicing and payment into one coherent process design.
* Ability to define and articulate the main value drivers in S2P transformations, such as savings and savings leakage, spend under management, contract compliance, maverick spend, touchless PO and invoice rates, cycle times, cost per invoice, payment accuracy, payment terms and working capital, direct material cost and supply continuity, and supplier risk.
* Solid understanding of AI and how to apply it in procurement and finance operations: the main types (generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, process mining and automation), what each does well, its limits and the data it needs.
* Working knowledge of SAP Business AI (including Joule), SAP Business Network and the AI roadmaps of leading S2P platforms, and how they fit with the SAP S/4HANA core.
* Good judgment on when AI is the right answer and when process simplification, standardization or classic automation is enough.
* Strong understanding of internal controls, compliance and audit requirements in S2P, and how they need to change when AI agents take over tasks.
* Ability to lead both executive-level discussions and detailed L3/L4 process conversations, adapting the level of detail to the audience and project phase.
* Ability to use spend data, process mining and performance metrics to find bottlenecks, quantify opportunities and track benefits.
* Familiarity with change management and adoption approaches for requesters, buyers and accounts payable teams, including building trust in AI-supported decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a hands-on ability to create clear, ready-to-use client materials.
* Leadership skills to guide and develop small teams of junior consultants or experts.

Nice to have
  
  

* Has built simple AI prototypes or agents, for example with low-code tools such as SAP Build or Microsoft Copilot Studio, or has basic Python or SQL skills.
* Experience with process mining tools such as SAP Signavio or Celonis in S2P.
* Experience with AI-native procurement or accounts payable automation tools, including autonomous negotiation for tail spend.
* Professional certifications, such as CIPS or SAP certifications in SAP Ariba or S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement.

title: Associate Director of Digital Strategy
description:
### **Who We Are**

Teal Media is a full-service creative and design agency with a conscience. We believe purposeful design can transform organizations, inspire action, and enable progress. Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change—and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

We offer a variety of strategic, creative, and technical services, including brand strategy, web design and development, and creative support.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**
=================

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

Base salary of $120,000–$140,000. Where you land depends on your experience and skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage begin the first of the month after you join.

**Health coverage that puts you first**
---------------------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our high-deductible health plan, plus an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account. Your HSA is yours to keep and use for eligible health expenses now or later.
* A generous contribution toward family coverage, plus a choice of medical plans, including $1,000-deductible and $0-deductible options. We contribute toward premiums on every plan.
* Free counseling sessions, virtual therapy, and 24/7 virtual care.

**Dental and vision covered**
-----------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our base dental and vision plans, with buy-up options that include orthodontia and larger allowances for glasses and contacts.

**Additional support at no cost to you**
----------------------------------------

* Basic life and AD&D insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage, all 100% employer-paid.

**Time to recharge**
--------------------

* 10+ paid company holidays each year, starting on day one, plus a few bonus days off when we can.
* Flexible Time Off after three months. We encourage new teammates to take three weeks of vacation in their first year.

**Investing in your future**
----------------------------

* After three months, contribute 5% of your pay to your 401(k), and we’ll add 4%. The employer match is fully vested immediately.

**Support for growing families**
--------------------------------

* After three months, new parents receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave at full pay, up to $3,500 per week, to bond with their new addition.

**Location**
============

We are a fully remote team! So any US-based location works for us.

**Let’s make something happen**
===============================

Bring us your experience, your perspective, and your curiosity. We’d love to hear how you’ve helped an organization turn a digital strategy into results.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

If your experience doesn’t exactly match the qualifications listed, but you believe you’d thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply and tell us why you’re the right person for the job.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized communities to apply—including Black and Indigenous people, people of color, immigrants, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, neurodiverse individuals, and those who have been system-impacted.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer that values a diverse workforce and inclusive culture. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, disability, and veteran status. We are not offering US visa sponsorship at this time.

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
Marketing Director (ABM & Brand)
description:
**About MVF**  
MVF connects people who are ready to buy with the brands that want them as customers. Founded in London in 2009, with a US hub in Austin, we run 20+ marketing channels, 4m first-party data records and our own technology and AI to create demand, capture it and turn it into sales.  
  
Our clients sit in 200+ verticals, from enterprise names like Salesforce and Ford to fast-growing challengers, and the business generates more than £140m a year. We work as a full-funnel go-to-market partner: we build awareness, capture intent and lift conversion through customer-facing brands such as Expert Market.  
  
**Our Team**  
Every other marketing team at MVF markets our clients' brands. This team markets MVF itself, to the companies we want as clients, and it sits inside the sales organisation so that everything it does ends in a sales conversation.  
  
We're partway into a three-year sales and commercial transformation, aiming for net revenue retention of 100% and approx 6% of revenue from new logos. Over the next six months that includes a refreshed client value proposition, an MVF rebrand launching by March 2027, and account-based marketing into the 200 accounts we most want. You'll work closely with our sales teams in London and Austin, and with the brand and design team who own the MVF identity.

**What we're offering you:**

* Summer Fridays
* Competitive holiday benefits - 25 days a year paid holiday, plus 8 bank holidays (increases 1 day a year up to 30 days)
* Hybrid working - 3 days a week in the office
* Closed for Christmas holidays - Extra days not taken from your annual holiday allowance.
* Work from anywhere for 2 weeks a year
* Life Assurance and Income Protection to protect your loved ones
* Benefits allowance for health, dental, and vision coverage
* Six months paid maternity leave, and one month paid paternity leave (subject to qualifying conditions) inclusive of same-sex and adoptive parents
* Defined Contribution Pension and Salary Sacrifice Scheme
* Be Well: Our award-winning wellbeing and mental health programme to support all MVFers and their families
* Family Forward support for our MVF parents and their mini-mes
* 2 charity days a year

**The Role**  
  
Our addressable market is small enough to name company by company. Around 200 businesses make up the accounts we most want, and you'll own the plan that gets MVF known by, and in the room with, every one of them. You'll tier the list, build a marketing plan for each top account and each cluster, and run it across LinkedIn, events, podcasts, content and gifting alongside the salespeople who own those relationships.  
  
You'll be measured on first meetings, pipeline and return on spend. Every programme you run will have a meeting target, a budget and trial period so we scale what works quickly and stop what doesn't.  
  
There's no inherited team or playbook here. You'll set the function up from scratch, do most of the work yourself at the start, and add people once the numbers justify it. The role suits someone who wants to build something with their own hands, and has the know how to execute effectively  
  
**In short: get MVF in front of every account we want to win, and show the result in pipeline.**  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**The role has four areas of accountability.**  
  
**1. Build the plan for every account we want**

* Agree the target account list with sales leadership, mapped to our zones and hubs, and tier it
* Map the buying committee in every top-tier account, so we know who we're talking to, what they care about and what would get them to take a meeting.
* Write a marketing plan for each top-tier account and each cluster, agreed with the salesperson who owns it.
* Set up the data and tools the programme needs, including intent signals, LinkedIn account targeting and source tracking in Pipedrive, using what we already have before buying more.
* Own our agency relationship with our organic linkedin Agency and set out parameters for success and ways of working with them
* Create content suites and libraries for sales people for their outbound outreach  
    
  **2. Run the programmes**

* LinkedIn, organic and paid: grow MVF's and our leaders' presence with the people on the list, and run paid campaigns aimed at named accounts.
* Events and conferences: pick the industry events our target accounts attend in the UK and US, and get MVF on stage, on the stand and hosting the dinners around them. Run our own small, invite-only events for target accounts and our largest clients.
* Podcasts and content: get our leaders onto the podcasts and panels our buyers follow, and turn MVF's research, starting with our $1bn report, into content written for specific accounts and clusters.
* Gifting and direct mail: design personal gifting for target accounts and key clients, with a sales follow-up planned for every send.
* Online: own account-specific landing pages, retargeting and the outreach sequences sales use, working with our web and brand teams.
* Manage the agencies and partners we use, holding them to the same meeting and pipeline targets you're held to.  
    
  **3. Prove the return**

* Agree a meeting target, budget and kill date for every programme before it starts, then scale what works and stop what doesn't.
* Trace every first meeting to its source in Pipedrive, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately so the numbers stand up with finance.
* Report monthly to the Group Sales Director on accounts engaged, first meetings, pipeline, win rate and cost per opportunity.
* Build the business case for any further investment needed  
    
  **4. Work as part of the sales team**

* Sit with the sales team, join account planning, and make sure every reply or hand-raise from a target account reaches the right salesperson the same day.
* Give sales the collateral, talk tracks and social content to pitch MVF as a full-funnel go-to-market partner once the new proposition and brand launch.
* Train salespeople in social selling and account-based selling

**Our ideal MVFer**

* 8+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 3 running account-based marketing into enterprise or mid-market accounts.
* Has built an ABM or field marketing function from scratch, and can show the meetings, pipeline and revenue it produced.
* Has done the work personally: written the campaigns, run the LinkedIn ads, booked the stands and briefed the agencies. May have led a sizeable team, and is happy to work without one while the function proves itself.
* Hands-on experience across organic and paid LinkedIn, events and conferences, podcasts and thought leadership, client gifting and online campaigns.
* Has marketed to marketing and sales leaders, ideally from a marketing services, media, lead generation or B2B software business.
* Measures success in meetings and pipeline, is fluent in a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot or Salesforce, and understands the difference between sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Enjoys working with salespeople, wants a seat in account planning, and is comfortable being held to a number.
* A self-starter who writes well, spends a budget as if it were their own, and makes calls without waiting to be told.
* Comfortable working across London and Austin time zones, and travelling to events in the UK and US.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
*Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are the foundation for MVF to build, promote and sustain a culture of trust, safety, growth and belonging where everyone can thrive. Our DEI guiding principles underpin how we build our teams, develop our talent, provide a fair working environment and create an ambitious company that reflects the diversity of our employees, customers, clients and partners, globally.*  
  
*As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage all MVFers to respect, value and celebrate our differences, and commit to actions that ensure that we can belong and be authentic at MVF, without limitations or barriers.*  
  
*We’re committed to providing support and/or adjustments to those who may need them during employment. If you consider yourself someone who may need support or adjustments, please speak with your Line Manager, Department DEI Ambassador or People Partner.*  
  
*We are diverse by nature, but inclusive by choice.*
