title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 1 million visits a month.

**About the Role**
------------------

As **Director of AI Experience Design** at OpenLoop Health, you'll lead design across everything we build: patient and client-facing experiences, our White-Label platform and Launchpad, AI agents and copilots, and the operational platforms our teams use every day.

You'll set a multi-year design vision, grow and lead the team, and own the system our products are built on. That system won't only guide human designers. It becomes the contract AI follows, precise enough that AI tools can build UI that meets our bar. You'll also help designers, engineers, and PMs use AI effectively and at scale, so the team can do more without lowering the bar on quality.

You'll treat design like a business: own the outcomes, make focused bets, and iterate based on customer truth and data. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of strategy and execution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the design vision and strategy across patient, client, and internal products, and turn bold ideas into outcomes patients, clients, and the business can measure.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of designers. Establish clear career paths, strong critique, and a culture with a high bar for craft.
* Own the design system as the source of truth, not a side artifact. That covers tokens, components, information hierarchy, and interaction principles, with theming across the many client brands our White-Label platform supports.
* Make the system AI-ready. Ship standards as code (tokens, patterns, and components wired into the engineering pipeline) so the correct, accessible, compliant pattern is the default for people and AI coding agents alike.
* Measure the system like a product, using adoption in code, pattern reuse, override rates, and first-pass quality, and retire patterns the data shows are failing.
* Help the Product & Tech org use AI effectively and at scale, with the workflows, tools, and standards that let the team ship more without sacrificing quality.
* Set the standard for how AI shows up in our products, across voice, chat, and autonomous agents. That covers trust patterns like transparency, citations, confidence, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff in a regulated healthcare setting.
* Ground decisions in research. Run discovery and usability testing with patients, clinicians, and clients, and prototype in code with real data to validate ideas before they scale.
* Audit existing and acquired surfaces, such as Hey Revia and Season Health, and drive convergence toward a single coherent experience.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on problem definition, roadmap, and scoping.
* Own design KPIs and instrument the experience to quantify impact. Represent Design in executive forums with clear narratives, tradeoffs, and results.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading teams directly. B2B or B2B2C SaaS experience preferred.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile.
* A track record of designing and shipping AI-powered or agentic experiences in production, and of changing how teams and AI tools actually build.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain great design talent.
* Inspired by products where systematic design creates clarity, and you know what separates great product experiences from good ones.
* Meticulous and opinionated, able to hold the line on standards while moving fast.
* Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs, prototyping in code with tools like Claude Code) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-team alignment).
* A strong command of accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and of designing for trust in high-stakes settings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to align executives around crisp narratives and metrics.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) + Company Match
* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

**Our Company**
---------------

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of up 2.1 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
* Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
* Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
* Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
* Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
* Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

CleanSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Head of Growth
description:
**About Lendable**
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
  
  

* One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
* Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
* Profitable since 2017
* Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
* Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch:
**loans, credit cards and car finance**
. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.
  
  
We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks
**with dated systems and painful processes.**
**Join us if you want to**

* Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
* Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions
* Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

**Growth Lead**
We’re looking for a senior Growth Lead with deep expertise in brand and trade marketing to shape how Mexican consumers see our brand and to build our in-store acquisition channel. Your mission is not just to grow volume, but to grow the right customers: attracting higher-quality, lower-risk and more profitable cardholders for our Mexico Credit Card.
  
  
A big part of the opportunity is a channel few card issuers in Mexico are present in: in-store acquisition through our merchant partners. Physical retailers already distribute our cards at the point of sale, and the channel is largely untapped. We want someone who can turn it into a growth engine through trade marketing, in-store promotions, POP and co-marketing with our merchants.
  
  
You’ll also own our brand in Mexico: positioning, messaging and creative direction across socials, digital and in-store. You’ll work closely with our UK growth and analytics team, who lead performance marketing, tracking and attribution, and with our Credit team to make sure every campaign brings in customers who are good for the business.
  
  
This role is central to scaling our Mexico Credit Card, a mobile-app–first product designed for credit builders in Mexico.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build Trade & Retail Marketing at the Point of Sale
* Own the growth strategy for our in-store acquisition channel with physical merchant partners.
* Build and run a trade marketing calendar with each merchant: promotions such as a free card with the purchase of selected products or above a spend threshold, in-store activations and brand ambassadors.
* Develop POP and in-store advertising, from concept to production and rollout across store networks, that drives awareness and sign-ups at the shelf and at checkout.
* Launch co-marketing campaigns with merchants through their own channels (apps, loyalty programs, catalogues, socials) and joint offers.
* Work with merchant partners, Operations and Engineering on execution: store staff incentives and training, systems integration and reconciliation of promotion costs.
* Build a repeatable playbook so we can launch new merchant partners quickly.
* Own & Build Our Brand in Mexico
* Own brand positioning, messaging and identity, shaping how Mexican consumers perceive us so we attract the customers we want to serve.
* Define creative direction and lead brand campaigns across socials, digital, out-of-home and in-store.
* Build a creative engine (in-house, agencies, creators) that produces high-quality assets at speed.
* Grow our organic social presence, content and community.
* Track brand health (awareness, consideration, perception) and connect brand work to acquisition results.
* Connect Brand, Retail & Digital
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants that drive customers into stores to get their card (e.g. geo-targeted social, merchant channels).
* Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint, and provide messaging and creative for our performance campaigns.
* Partner with the UK growth and analytics team, who own performance marketing execution, tracking and attribution, so brand and trade campaigns are properly measured and learnings flow both ways.
* Measure What Matters
* Own the brand and trade marketing budget, and the return on it.
* Define clear KPIs for every campaign and merchant: cost per account, approval and activation rates, and customer quality.
* Work with Credit and the UK analytics team to understand which campaigns, merchants and promotions bring in profitable customers, and how CAC compares to LTV.
* Use results to reallocate spend across merchants, promotions and campaigns.

**Required Experience**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years in brand, trade, retail or shopper marketing, with senior ownership of meaningful budgets and targets, ideally at consumer brands, retailers or financial services in Mexico.
* A proven track record of launching trade marketing and in-store campaigns with retailers: promotions, POP, activations and co-marketing.
* Experience building or repositioning a consumer brand: positioning, messaging, creative direction and campaigns.
* Strong experience working with and negotiating with Mexican retailers and their store teams.
* Experience managing creative, BTL and production agencies and vendors.
* Commercially minded and data-literate: comfortable setting KPIs, reading campaign results and tying spend to outcomes.
* Strong execution across many stakeholders (merchants, Operations, Finance, Credit).
* Proficiency in English and Spanish (you’ll work closely with our UK team).
* Deep understanding of Mexican consumers.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in performance marketing across Meta, Google, TikTok or app marketing.
* Familiarity with tracking and data integrations, such as Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google offline conversions, MMPs and attribution.
* Analytical skills such as SQL, cohort analysis or unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback).
* Experience in credit cards, lending or other financial services, ideally with an understanding of credit risk.
* Previous start-up or scale-up experience, ideally building a channel from zero.
* Experience leading a team.

**The Type of Work You’ll Be Doing**

* Plan and launch trade marketing promotions with merchant partners.
* Create POP and in-store materials, and roll them out across store networks.
* Negotiate co-marketing plans with merchants and onboard new partners.
* Define our brand positioning and lead brand campaigns.
* Brief and manage creative work, agencies and creators.
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants.
* Review campaign and merchant performance with Credit and the UK analytics team, and reallocate budget.
* Report on growth performance to leadership and keep the team focused on what moves the needle.
* Help hire and build out the growth team as we scale.

**How You’ll Contribute To Lendable**

* Ownership: You own brand and in-store acquisition end to end, from strategy and budget to results.
* Brand Building: You create a brand that Mexican consumers trust and want to be part of.
* Retail Savvy: You know how to win at the point of sale and how to work with retailers.
* Quality Over Volume: You optimize for good, profitable customers, not vanity metrics.
* Data-Informed: You measure everything and let results guide where spend goes.
* Creativity: You find new ways to reach customers, in store and online.
* Prioritization: You focus ruthlessly on high-impact bets.
* Speed: You thrive in an environment where shipping fast and iterating is the norm.
* Collaboration: You work smoothly with merchants, agencies, Credit and our UK team.

**Interview Process**

* CV Screening
* Intro Call with Talent
* Hiring Manager Call
* Case Study + Presentation (e.g. a brand positioning and in-store campaign plan with a merchant partner, and how you’d measure it)
* Final Round:

+ Cultural interview with wider team leads
+ Mexico MD interview
+ Credit leadership
+ Executive leadership

**Location**

* In-office in Mexico City.
* In exceptional cases, remote may be considered, but frequent presence in the Mexico City office is required.

**Compensation**

* $150,000 - $200,000 Mexican pesos, per month, before taxes
* Potential stock option plan
* All legal benefits
* Private Health Insurance

**Life at Lendable**

* **Winning team:**
  the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
* **Flexible working:**
  flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
* **Socials & connection:**
  opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
* **Health coverage:**
  support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover
* **Retirement & savings:**
  long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
* **Employee referral programme:**
  earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
* **Office meals & snacks:**
  enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
* **Sustainable commuting:**
  cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

***Please note:**
The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.*

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager**
=====================

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on, strategic Marketing Manager to join the AltoVita team, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. This is a broad role for a well-rounded marketer who is comfortable switching between strategy and execution: writing an award submission in the morning, running an event logistics call in the afternoon, and challenging the marketing plan when something isn't working. We want someone who brings ideas, questions assumptions and helps shape where AltoVita's marketing goes next, as well as delivering it.

**What you will achieve in your first 6 months**
------------------------------------------------

* **Win industry recognition.** Own AltoVita's awards programme end-to-end, with a focus on our priority awards (the EMMAs and Business Travel Awards). You will select the right categories, build the evidence and write winning submissions.
* **Deliver flawless events.** Take full ownership of event execution from A to Z, including our annual Smart, Safe & Sustainable Summit, industry conferences such as GBTA, ProcureCon and the AltoLive webinar series. This covers planning, budgets, suppliers, speakers, promotion, on-the-day delivery, follow-up and ROI reporting.
* **Raise our online presence.** Sharpen AltoVita's brand awareness and thought leadership, especially on LinkedIn, by shifting toward fewer, more strategic and higher-impact posts. Grow engagement and net new followers along the way.
* **Own the quarterly Corporate Accommodation Trends Report.** Lead the research, writing, production and promotion of each edition, and turn it into a recurring thought-leadership engine across webinars, PR, social and sales.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and own the marketing content strategy, with content themes that resonate with our target audiences and align with company objectives and AltoVita's unique selling propositions.
* Shape and master the AltoVita voice on social platforms, building strong relationships with our audience, especially on LinkedIn.
* Craft compelling online and offline content, from SEO-driven and long-form pieces to thought leadership and product content.
* Identify the leading industry awards for AltoVita and write submissions ranging from 200 to 2,000 words. Manage deadlines, evidence gathering and stakeholder input.
* Research industry trends to produce whitepapers, benchmarking reports and industry reports, in collaboration with the demand and supply sectors AltoVita serves.
* Plan and run AltoLive webinars, including topics, speakers, moderation, promotion and repurposing content afterwards.
* Lead AltoVita's online and in-person event marketing, managing budgets and measuring each event's contribution to pipeline.
* Produce case studies and sales materials in collaboration with the Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Contribute engaging content to email marketing, including the AltoVita newsletter and account-based marketing campaigns, in collaboration with the Director of Marketing.
* Contribute to PR initiatives by gathering data and stories for press releases and interviewing leadership and team members for news stories.
* Work closely with our in-house designer on all creative and graphic needs.

* Bring strategic input to the marketing plan. Challenge priorities, propose new channels and ideas, and use data to recommend where to invest.
* Measure marketing performance regularly across leads, pipeline influence, engagement and reach, and report insights and recommendations.
* Maintain brand standards and tone of voice across all communication channels.
* Keep learning about trends in corporate housing, serviced apartments, global mobility, business travel and hospitality.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3+ years of B2B marketing experience across content, events and brand. Experience in hospitality, travel, global mobility or technology is strongly preferred.
* A proven track record of writing award submissions, ideally including wins.
* End-to-end ownership of events, both in person and virtual, including budgets, suppliers and ROI measurement.
* Exceptional written English with flawless grammar. Please be prepared to share writing samples.
* Experience producing research-led content such as reports, whitepapers or benchmarking studies.
* Experience growing a B2B brand on LinkedIn, with a strong grasp of thought-leadership content.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform.
* Strategic thinking combined with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, and the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Strong project management skills, consistency and attention to detail. You can juggle multiple deadlines without dropping the ball.
* A self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, remote environment with high autonomy.
* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, including comfort moderating webinars and representing AltoVita at events.

title: Sr. Director, Creative

title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description:
### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.

The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.

This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
* Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
* Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
* Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
* Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
* Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
* Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
* Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
* Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
* Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
* Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
* Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
* Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
* Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

### **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES**

Primary qualifications include demonstrated abilities to work collaboratively within a team, work collaboratively in cross team formats with other team leads, creatively solve quantitative problems, prioritize and manage a mix of short- and long-term deadlines, and professionally represent Pivot Energy externally. Experience in renewables and/or energy storage is required. The Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design must be able to think critically and work with experienced renewables professionals to decipher the needs of a project/portfolio and find the best solutions in each scenario.

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferably Electrical Engineering with a focus on power system and energy system)
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy storage industry and storage project development
* Experience in the solar industry and solar project development
* Quantitative & qualitative problem-solving skills and strong communication skills
* Knowledge of renewable energy and project finance concepts
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple critical deadlines
* Passion for learning new things through self-directed study and structured settings
* High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
* Willingness to work in databases such as Salesforce

### **PREFERRED COMPETENCIES**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field
* At least 10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry
* Experience in energy trading, wholesale energy markets, or other energy economics disciplines
* Experience with Ascend Analytics, Fractal or similar energy modeling software
* Ability to create and modify energy models and finance models using MATLAB or a similar tool.

$160,000 - $190,000 a year

### **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this position is $160,000-$190,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

  

Pivot Energy is dedicated to providing a great work experience for all employees, placing an emphasis on company culture and a focus on our people. To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes:

* Excellent health/dental/vision insurance benefits with up to 100% of premiums covered by the company
* Four weeks of vacation in year 1, with increasing vacation accrual rates based on work anniversary date
* Company paid life insurance and short- & long-term disability coverage
* Generous parental leave
* 401(k) matching (after vesting period)
* Work from home stipend for new employees
* Public transit reimbursement
* PTO for volunteering in the community

A complete list of all the benefits Pivot offers may be provided upon request.

**ABOUT PIVOT**

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and

families.

We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.

As a Certified B Corporation and one of **Denver’s “Best Places to Work”****,** we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.

At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION and JUSTICE STATEMENT**

At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. title: Sr. Director, Sourcing & Procurement – General Contractors, Design Consultants, Substation EPC & Commissioning
description:
**Job Type:** Full-time **| Location:** San Francisco **| Department:** Procurement **| Reporting to:** VP, Data Center Procurement **|****Work Location Type:** #hybrid

The Senior Director, Sourcing & Procurement will own the end-to-end sourcing, contracting, and commercial
  
management strategy for General Contractor (GC), Architecture/Engineering (AE) design consultant, Substation EPC, and Commissioning (Cx) agent services supporting the company's U.S. hyperscale and AI-infrastructure data center construction program. This role is the primary procurement authority across the pre-construction, GC selection, sub trade selection, substation EPC, and commissioning phases of new-build and expansion projects, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Development, Legal, and Finance to secure capacity, control cost and schedule risk, and drive consistent, defensible contracting outcomes across a fast-growing portfolio of data center campuses.

  
  

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy

* Develop and execute global sourcing strategy for General Contractor, sub trades, Design-Build, and CMAR partners across shell/core, fit-out, and EPC substation scopes for U.S. data center builds.
* Lead procurement of AE/design consultant services (civil, structural, MEP, electrical distribution, low-voltage) and third-party Commissioning (Cx) agents across all project phases (Cx, IST, and turnover).
* Structure and negotiate contracts under GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build models, tailoring commercial structure to project risk profile, schedule urgency, and market capacity.
* Build and maintain a qualified bench of regional and national GC, MEP, AE, and Cx partners to secure capacity ahead of an aggressive, multi-site construction pipeline.

Substation EPC

* Lead sourcing and contracting of Substation EPC scope (utility-interconnect and on-site substations), including transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, and interconnection-related civil/electrical works.
* Coordinate substation EPC procurement timelines with utility interconnection studies, HV transformer lead times, and GC construction sequencing to protect energization milestones.
* Negotiate substation EPC contracts and manage EPC contractor performance across design, procurement, and construction phases, including interface management with the GC and utility.

Cost, Risk & Schedule Management

* Own construction cost negotiations and benchmarking across GC/EPC scopes, including GMP validation, change order governance, and open-book cost reconciliation.
* Partner with Legal and Risk on contract terms covering liquidated damages, bonding/insurance, indemnification, OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope delineation, and warranty obligations.
* Monitor project schedules jointly with Construction Management to identify sourcing risk (labor, equipment, long-lead materials) and proactively mitigate GC/Cx-driven schedule slippage.
* Track and report portfolio-level spend, savings, and contract compliance to procurement and executive leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Serve as the primary procurement business partner to Construction, Engineering, and Development leadership from site selection through project turnover.
* Represent Procurement in GC/AE/Cx/Substation EPC bid evaluations, contract award recommendations, and executive steering committee reviews.
* Build and mentor a team of category managers and buyers supporting the GC, design consultant, substation EPC, and commissioning categories as the portfolio scales.
* Establish standardized RFP templates, evaluation scorecards, and contract playbooks to drive consistency and speed across a growing project portfolio.

  

* 10+ years of progressive procurement, construction management, or supply chain leadership experience in hyperscale or mission-critical data center construction; prior experience at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or major GC/EPC firm strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated command of GC/EPC sourcing, AE/design consultant procurement, Substation EPC contracting, and third-party commissioning agent engagement for large-scale data center or industrial facility builds. Deep working knowledge of GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build contracting models, and of OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope structuring.
* Strong grounding in construction cost negotiations, project scheduling interdependencies, and Substation EPC and shell/core/fit-out delivery.
* Proven track record negotiating complex, high-value construction and professional services contracts, with sound judgment on risk allocation and commercial structuring.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
* Willingness and ability to travel to active construction sites across the U.S. as needed

title: Director of Brand Design
description:
**About Cardiff**

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

**Location:** San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Product and Design/Marketing

**Reports to:** CMO

**Why This Role Matters**

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Director of Brand Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

**What You'll Own**

  

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
* Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
* **Research and Data:** Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
* **Conversion Design:** A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
* **Brand Leadership:** Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
* **Content Design:** Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
* **Organizational Scale:** Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You**

* Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
* Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
* Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
* Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
* Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary range: $195,000+
* Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Flexible PTO and observed holidays
* Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
* Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Cardiff, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Production Manager
description:
We staff a seasoned team and extensive network of niche specialists that seek to produce great things in a trust-forward environment where transparency and equity are of the utmost importance. Yes, we work hard to produce great work, but we believe the best way to produce great work is to work hard for one another and show up for our communities and the planet we all share. TLDR; we only hire *really* nice folks.

Responsible resourcing and fearless transparency are what make Johnnie a great team to work *for*. Trust and empathy are what make Johnnie a great team to work *with*.

Johnnie teammates are provided stellar equipment, flexible work environments, growth opportunities, and industry-leading benefits.

We can’t wait to meet you.

  

### **Production Manager**

Johnnie Studio is hiring a Production Manager to help run the production engine behind our work for one of the world’s largest technology companies. If you love turning final design and copy into flawless, spec-perfect deliverables and live pages, and you’re the person who catches the broken link, the mismatched headline, and the missing alt text before anyone else does, we’d like to meet you.

  

**About the role**

Our Production team turns approved design and copy into client-ready production packages and live content for web pages, emails, newsletters, blog articles, and training content. As Production Manager, you’ll handle the day-to-day execution of that work in partnership with our Production Director, who sets the processes and standards, while you keep deliverables moving, accurate, and on time. That includes our client’s blog program: you’ll need to be ready to cover blog production at any stage, from draft setup through the hands-on work of staging, publishing, and localizing articles in the CMS.

You’ll work alongside our design, strategy, editorial, and project management teams, and you’ll be a go-to contact for the client’s production, engineering, and blog teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, detail-obsessed, comfortable in a CMS, and able to juggle many active projects at once.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare production handoff packages for web pages, emails and newsletters, OFTs, and training content, working from Figma designs, Word copy documents, and client specs.

* QA deliverables before handoff for copy accuracy, design-to-copy alignment, links and metadata, and adherence to client checklists and brand standards.

* Check accessibility as part of every QA pass, including alt text, heading structure, reading order, and contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA), and support accessible PowerPoint and PDF production.

* Cover blog production as needed, from draft setup (ghost links and URLs, files, photography, and trafficking drafts through review) to staging, publishing, and localizing articles in the CMS on the client’s publish schedule.

* QA blog posts before and after they go live, and help keep featured articles current across the blog’s multiple sites.

* Manage handoffs and status in agency and client-side management tools, and provide time estimates and early risk flags to project managers and the Production Director.

* Serve as backup point of contact for the client’s production, engineering, and training teams.

* Help document and improve our production processes, including templates, checklists, and AI-assisted workflows.

* Make light copy edits and design fixes as needed.
  

**What you bring**

* 5–8 years of experience in digital production, web production, production management, or content operations at an agency or in-house team.

* Experience producing email and web deliverables, and an understanding of how they’re built and handed off to developers or CMS teams.

* Hands-on experience staging and publishing content in an enterprise CMS.

* Working knowledge of HTML for cleaning up and formatting content in a CMS editor.

* Strong working knowledge of Figma and Microsoft 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint, OneDrive).

* Working knowledge of digital accessibility standards (WCAG) and how to check for them.

* Experience with ticketing and work management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or ClickUp.

* Exceptional attention to detail. You’re often the final set of eyes before work goes live.

* Clear, proactive communication and the ability to work well with a remote, cross-functional team.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and publishing schedules at once while tracking your time.

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  

**Nice to have**

* Experience working on a large enterprise or B2B technology account.

* Experience publishing multi-locale or localized content.

* Experience sourcing licensed photography and preparing images for web.

* Adobe Creative Cloud, especially InDesign and Acrobat (accessible PDFs).

* Experience using AI tools (such as Claude or Copilot) to speed up QA and documentation.

* Confluence or similar documentation experience.
  

**We offer**

* A flexible remote work structure – with opportunities to work from an office environment if that’s how you prefer to work

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits

* 401(k) retirement plan

* HSA program

* Basic life coverage

* Uncapped vacation policy – *With structures in place to ensure people deliver a full-time work product and take ample time away!*
  

**About Johnnie Studio**

At Johnnie Studio, we’re focused on a core founding principle: leveraging our innovative model to create unique and impactful content, all without the overhead and complexity in how most agencies operate. We’re small by design to best serve some of the largest organizations in the world, producing high-performing creative that resonates with modern audiences.

We staff a seasoned team and extensive network of niche specialists that seek to produce innovative work, investing heavily in ability, benefits, and remote-working solutions for the modern workforce—we are a fully remote creative studio with a flexible vacation policy and team members in every major U.S. time zone. There’s no marble-tiled lobby on Main Street here: Responsible resourcing and fearless transparency are what make Johnnie a great team to work for, and trust and empathy are what make Johnnie a great team to work with.

  

**Sound like a fit?**

**Drop us a line at** **design@johnniestudio.com** along with your resume or portfolio and a few relevant work samples. We’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Staff Partnerships Lead, Gaming
description:
**Why Mozilla?**

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

**What is a Senior Staff Partnerships Lead at Mozilla?**

Senior Staff is a senior individual contributor level at Mozilla. People at this level are recognized leaders in their field. They take on complex, ambiguous work that spans several disciplines and organizations with little supervision, lead strategic external relationships, and are comfortable working with executives inside and outside Mozilla.

**About this team and role:**

Mozilla’s New Products organization is an internal incubator for high-potential ventures. We’re building a new Firefox product for PC gamers, and partnerships across the games industry are central to how it reaches players and grows.

As the partnerships lead, you’ll be responsible for identifying, initiating, and closing the gaming partnerships that bring the product to more players. You will report to the Director of Product and build new gaming partnerships that advance the product roadmap.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own the product’s partnerships strategy and pipeline across cloud gaming services, storefronts and launchers, publishers and studios, community platforms, and hardware makers.
* Originate, structure and close deals that bring players, product capabilities and new revenue, such as distribution, co-marketing, in-game rewards and revenue-share agreements.
* Plan and deliver partner launch moments with Firefox marketing that reach players where they already play.
* Identify and propose new product features in support of partnerships, and evangelize new product features with partners.
* Lead each deal across Mozilla: shape terms with Legal and Finance, scope partner integrations with product and engineering, and hold every partnership to Mozilla’s standards for privacy, trust and responsible design.
* Represent Mozilla with senior leaders across the games industry, and bring what you learn from partners and the market back into product strategy.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 10+ years in business development, product marketing, or strategic partnerships, including 5+ years in the games industry.
* A track record of originating and closing multi-party commercial partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including revenue-share and co-marketing deals.
* Established relationships with decision-makers across the PC gaming ecosystem, and the standing to get meetings with senior leaders at platform holders and publishers.
* Strong commercial judgment: you can model deal economics, structure terms that work for both sides, and negotiate with senior counterparts.
* Experience taking deals through legal, finance, product and marketing teams to launch, without an established playbook.
* Clear, persuasive communication with executives inside and outside the company, and willingness to travel for partner meetings and industry events.
* Commitment to our values:
* + Welcoming differences
  + Being relationship-minded
  + Practicing responsible participation
  + Having grit

**Bonus points for:** partnerships experience at a browser, operating system or consumer software company; distribution deals such as device pre-installs or app store placements; and a passion for PC gaming and its communities.

**What you’ll get:**

* Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
* Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

**About Mozilla**

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Senior Manager, Label Services Order to Cash
description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

* **Curiosity**: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
* **Collaboration**: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
* **Commitment**: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

**A little bit about our team:**

Warner Music's Center of Excellence for Shared Services is the home to the financial, legal and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our US Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The Finance Department is responsible for managing all of the center's accounting and cash management functions.

As a critical component of Finance, the Order to Cash (OTC) team is responsible for measuring and monitoring financial risk related to the extension of credit terms, and for the timely recovery and efficient application of incoming cash (receivables). This role is fully remote.

**Your role:**

Lead Label Services Order to Cash end to end for merch, licensing, label and related receivables in the Americas: cash application, credit for venues and other third parties, collections for tour settlements, disputes and deductions. You will lead a hybrid team of onshore and offshore resources as the day-to-day owner of priorities, SLAs and quality, and you will represent OTC with WMG label management and label finance teams (for example, Atlantic), tour venues and their merch vendors, and internal audit. You will own the key controls and audit readiness for Label Services. You will identify where processes rely on manual workarounds, quantify their labor and control impact, and work with the Global Process Owners and Finance to redesign them in SAP S/4HANA rather than adding new workarounds. You will work closely with the Director, OTC and report to the Senior Director, OTC.

**Here you’ll get to:**

* Lead the Label Services OTC operation: set weekly priorities, SLAs and KPIs for the onshore analysts and the offshore team, and run a regular performance cadence.
* Direct the offshore team on the recording, coding, depositing, researching and application of checks and transactions for US and Canada D2C and Tour Merch in SAP S/4HANA.
* Lead calls and working sessions with label, finance, legal and tax partners, and make sure the team arrives prepared with accurate information.
* Assess team capacity and skills. Coach, develop and hire onshore talent, and recommend the right onshore and offshore mix as volume grows.
* Onboard mergers and acquisitions, including newly acquired labels, entities and affiliates, into OTC processes.
* Own collections for the assigned customer portfolio, including large retail customers, third-party distributors and sellers, and tour venues and their merch vendors. Reconcile AtVenu tour settlements (gross sales, venue cuts, fees and tax) to cash received, and follow up against settlement payment terms. Manage aging, escalation and referral of uncollectible debt for write-off.
* Ensure unallocated and unidentified cash receipts, including tour settlement payments, are researched and applied to the correct show and artist on time.
* Manage D2C chargebacks and return authorizations for Tour Merch, and customer deductions and disputes against agreements and invoices, with clear owners and response deadlines. Quantify and report exposure and recovery.
* Oversee Revenue processes including Managed Tour, Tour Supply, and Merch. Follow artist tour schedules and work with Tour Managers to oversee and reconcile cash receipts.
* Liaise between the outsource provider and Labels and Artist management companies, including reviewing and approving touch-points and correspondence.
* Run customer credit reviews and limits, including trade credit insurance submissions, and provide input to the bad debt provision. Apply the global credit policy and delegation of authority.
* Own the Label Services key controls, including label approval and customer correspondence controls. Make sure evidence is complete and on time, and respond to internal audit and external auditor requests.
* Reconcile accounts to support period-end close and year-end adjustments.
* Partner with the Global Process Owners and Finance to log, force rank and retire manual workarounds. Define requirements, testing and sign-off for SAP S/4HANA changes.
* Support worldwide merch licensing billing and collections.
* Build reporting for aging, DSO, unapplied cash, chargebacks and SLA performance for Tour Supply, Managed Tour and VIP collections, and give regular progress updates to senior management.
* Monitor the outsource provider's contract-level deliverables and escalate concerns to the Senior Director, OTC as needed.
* Partner with Participations and Label Finance to ensure accurate tour and merch related artist statements are reconciled.
* Maintain any VIP or Tour schedules, accruals, or other supporting analytics necessary to record revenue and expenses with the GBS RTR team.

**About you:**

* 5+ years of progressive OTC experience in a Shared Services environment.
* 3+ years of OTC people leader experience, including management of an outsourced BPO service provider.
* Strong, hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience in Receivables, including invoicing, cash application and deduction or dispute handling.
* Strong interpersonal skills and 2+ years of experience working with front-line Record Labels in supporting merch, managed tour, tour supply, and VIP structures for off and on roster artists.
* Proven ownership of key controls and audit support (SOX or equivalent).
* Experience with high-volume retail or wholesale customer accounts, including deductions, chargebacks and reconciliations.
* Excellent internal and external oral and written communication skills. Able to negotiate successfully and build lasting relationships that facilitate the collection process.
* Analytical, detail oriented, highly organized and highly accurate. Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to manipulate data in a heavy-volume spreadsheet environment.
* Ability to see the big picture, prioritize multiple projects simultaneously, make collection decisions quickly and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience writing procedure manuals and preparing departmental goals and objectives.

**We’d love it if you also had:**

* Knowledge of the music industry, including labels, artist management, touring and merch.
* Experience with AR, credit and customer service software such as AtVenu or CashPro, and with Workiva or similar control evidence tools.
* Experience with process improvement, automation or AI-enabled workflows in finance operations.
* Experience onboarding acquired entities.
* BA/BS degree in accounting, business, finance, computer science, systems or a related field highly preferred.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are **Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.**

**Love this job and want to apply?**

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

title: Director, VA Accounts (National VA Accounts)
description:
**SAVARIA PATIENT CARE**

Built from a heritage of brands including Span, Handicare and Silvalea, Savaria Patient Care provides products designed for safe patient handling and positive outcomes. Our research and clinically based product portfolio include therapeutic surfaces for pressure management and positioning, a complete range of innovative ceiling and floor lifts and slings. Savaria Patient Care is a division of Savaria Corporation, a global leader in accessibility.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:** The Director, VA Accounts will lead Savaria Patient Care’s national VA strategy to establish the company as a primary enterprise partner for Safe Patient Handling & Mobility (SPHM) and Pressure-Management solutions across the Veterans Health Administration Primary goal is to drive clinical adoption, standardization, strategic relationships, contracting access and sustainable market-share growth. The role is accountable for securing contracts from an assigned portfolio of VA sites and for creating the conditions under which VA facilities view Savaria as an enterprise platform and long-term clinical partner.

**NATURE & SCOPE:** Develop strategies and objectives for the VA segment by delivering on all annual sales quota.

**LEADING JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop and execute the national VA strategy. Build a 3 - 5 year strategy to position Savaria Patient Care as a primary VA partner for SPHM, pressure management and related patient-care solutions. Establish national priorities by VISN, facility, CLC, acute care, rehabilitation and home care

* Build relationships with national and VISN leadership. Develop executive-level relationships with VA national SPHM leadership, Occupational Health, Prosthetics, Biomedical Engineering, Logistics, Procurement and clinical stakeholders, as well as VISN Directors, VISN SPHM leadership and key facility decision makers. Position Savaria as a clinical and strategic resource rather than simply an equipment vendor, consistent with the VA SPHM program’s emphasis on appropriate technology, clinical assessment, mobility, training and injury prevention.
* Drive enterprise standardization. Identify opportunities to standardize Savaria solutions across facilities, VISNs or national programs; develop conversion strategies from incumbent suppliers; and create system-wide value propositions for ceiling lifts, floor lifts, slings, pressure-management surfaces and complementary technologies, promoting interoperability and lifecycle solutions that reduce the need for multiple platforms.

* Own the VA stakeholder map. Maintain a national database of decision makers across all VISNs and major VA medical centers, mapping influencers such as SPHM Program Managers, Nursing, Ergonomics, PT/OT, Prosthetics, Biomed, Facilities, Contracting, Logistics and executive leadership. Establish account-development plans for the highest-value VA systems.

* Lead federal contracting and procurement strategy. Ensure products are positioned through appropriate VA purchasing vehicles, including relevant Federal Supply Schedule, national contract and BPA opportunities (VA’s National Acquisition Center manages national contracts and schedules for medical equipment and patient-mobility products). Work with contracting, government affairs and operations to remove barriers to purchase, and monitor national solicitations and large VISN/facility opportunities.

* Drive the Savaria integrated portfolio. Position Savaria as more than a ceiling-lift company by integrating M-Series ceiling lifts, Silvalea slings, BEKA floor/mobile lifting solutions, Span-America therapeutic surfaces and beds, and future connected technologies. Develop bundled clinical solutions rather than individual-product proposals.

* Own competitive conversion strategy. Maintain intelligence on incumbent competitors including Guldmann, Arjo, Liko and other VA suppliers; identify expiring equipment fleets, service issues and capital replacement cycles.

* Coordinate Savaria’s field organization. Serve as the central VA leader for regional sales managers, account directors, clinical specialists, service teams and distributors. Establish clear rules of engagement, conduct regular VA pipeline and strategy reviews, and provide account plans, clinical tools, contracting guidance and executive support.

* Own national forecasting and performance. Maintain a VA opportunity pipeline by VISN, facility, product category and project stage; forecast capital replacement cycles and large projects; and track KPIs including VA revenue.

**PERFORMANCE KPIs** **for Evaluating Success**

* IDN revenue and profitability versus plan
* Pipeline coverage and quality of strategic opportunities
* VA preferred supplier status secured
* Contract conversion: facility evaluations converted to VA-wide adoption
* Account penetration across acute and post-acute VA sites
* Competitive displacement wins and market share growth
* Forecast accuracy for opportunities and capital purchasing timelines
* VA Leadership Engagement: business reviews held and clinical champions developed

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:** Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Finance or related field (*preferred*). Significant B2B USVA and other government healthcare sales experience (10+ years). Must have 7+ years of experience in healthcare, preferable in mobility & wound care management. Valid US driver’s license.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Ability to grow company revenues faster than the market.
* Demonstrated experience in planning, forecasting and sales deployment of the geographical region
* Strong business & financial acumen - ability to effectively structure the financial aspects of a sales package.
* Demonstrated ability to define the economic benefits of the products to the care providers and admin personnel.
* Demonstrates attention to detail.
* Demonstrates excellent group presentation skills.
* Writes clearly and informatively and varies writing style to meet needs.
* Displays orientation to profitability, while demonstrating knowledge of market and competition.
* Understands organization’s strengths & weaknesses.
* Develops workable implementation plans.
* Inspires respect and trust.
* Understands business implications of decisions.
* Follows policies and procedures

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, is required. Experience with ERP / CRM systems such as SalesForce.com, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP is desired.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The employee may occasionally stand, walk, stoop, kneel or crouch during shift. Employee will be required to regularly sit, use hand to finger, handle, feel and reach with hands and arms. Employee must be able to occasionally lift, push, pull and or move up to 50 lbs & work in an environment with moderate noise levels.

**COMPENSATION:** Base Salary of $110,000 - 130,000 - Based upon Professional Background, Experience and Regional Location and On Target Earnings of $175,000 - 250,000 per year.

**TRAVEL:**

This position may travel up to 50% of the time.

title: Lead Advanced Analyst, Paid Social
description:
### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Lead Advanced Analyst to run measurement and analytics for a large-scale paid social program covering brand, mid-funnel consideration and performance campaigns. You'll own analytics for a new mid-funnel strategy that connects brand awareness to conversion. You'll run lift studies and work with Data Science on geo-randomized tests to show whether paid social spend drives incremental results. Your insights will shape investment, creative and audience decisions for senior marketing leaders.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Run platform-level Conversion Lift Studies (and Brand Lift Studies where needed) to measure the incremental impact of mid-funnel campaigns on qualified traffic, intent and bookings.
* Separate attributed bookings from incremental bookings, and explain what the difference means for the paid social strategy.
* Work with Data Science to set up and analyze geo-randomized tests that isolate mid-funnel contribution from organic and other paid channels.
* Slice results by funnel stage (upper, mid, lower), ad frequency, demographics and buyer propensity cohorts to explain why a strategy is or isn't working.
* Build and maintain dashboards that track intent and preference lift, qualified traffic, incremental bookings, cost per booking and creative performance.
* Analyze creative, message, format and audience performance to find what drives consideration and downstream conversion most efficiently.
* Turn findings into hypotheses and test-and-learn plans for the next campaigns, such as budget shifts across funnel stages.
* Share proactive insights on budget allocation, audience saturation, creative fatigue and cross-funnel lift for bi-weekly optimization cycles.
* Work with paid social, integrated marketing, creative and agency partners.

### **Qualifications**

*Required*

* 7+ years in analytics or data science with a marketing focus, such as media measurement, paid social or growth analytics.
* Hands-on experience running and interpreting Conversion Lift Studies and making recommendations from them.
* Paid social experience, with Meta preferred (TikTok or similar platforms considered).
* A strong grasp of how the full marketing funnel works, including how upper-, mid- and lower-funnel campaigns are set up and how they interact.
* Advanced SQL, plus Python or R.
* Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement and causal inference.
* Ability to turn complex measurement results into clear recommendations for Director- and VP-level stakeholders.

*Preferred*

* Experience with Meta Advanced Analytics (the data clean room) or similar privacy-safe measurement environments.
* Experience designing lift studies or geo-randomized tests.
