title: Director, Global Logistics & Trade
description:
At Collectivus Holdings, we bring together some of the most recognized and loved brands across the collecting, trading card game, and hobby industries. Backed by a century of collective experience, we’re building what’s next through innovative products, exceptional quality, and unforgettable customer experiences.

Our teams and brands serve passionate communities around the world—and we’re looking for equally passionate people to help us grow.

  

**Website:** collectivusholdings.com  
**Global Locations:** Aarhus - Dallas - Delhi - Lisbon - Nashville - Remote Worldwide

**Job Title:** Director, Global Logistics & Trade

**Reporting Line:** VP, Fulfillment  
**Job Location:** Remote (U.S.)  
**Travel:** Domestic and international travel as needed

  

The Director, Global Logistics & Trade owns freight strategy and execution across Collectivus and its businesses. This leader is accountable for the movement of goods across suppliers, distribution centers, business partners, customers, and events worldwide, ensuring reliable service, competitive costs, and compliant cross-border operations.

The role brings companywide ownership and visibility to transportation spend, carrier relationships, shipment performance, and trade processes. Partnering closely with business leaders, Fulfillment, Product, Buying, Supply, Finance, Technology, and Legal, this leader builds a coordinated logistics operation that supports growth while remaining responsive to each business’s needs.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strategic judgment, strong analytical skills, and direct involvement in resolving operational issues.

### 

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Global Freight Strategy & Execution**

* Own all freight across Collectivus businesses, including inbound, outbound, intercompany, and event shipments across ocean, air, parcel, truckload, and less-than-truckload transportation.
* Establish a companywide freight strategy that balances cost, delivery speed, reliability, inventory availability, and business priorities.
* Define shipping standards, routing guides, booking procedures, approval requirements, and escalation processes.
* Coordinate with suppliers, buying teams, and distribution centers to align shipment schedules with production, receiving capacity, product launches, and customer commitments.
* Lead resolution of shipment delays, capacity constraints, customs holds, freight damage, and other transportation disruptions.
* Develop contingency plans for critical lanes, peak periods, and service interruptions.

**Carrier & Logistics Partner Management**

* Lead selection, negotiation, contracting, and performance management for carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and other logistics providers.
* Consolidate freight purchasing across businesses to improve rates, capacity, service, and commercial terms.
* Establish service expectations and scorecards; conduct regular business reviews and address underperformance.
* Manage freight claims, accessorial charges, detention, demurrage, and other avoidable costs.
* Partner with Legal and Finance on transportation agreements, cargo insurance, liability terms, and claims recovery.

**Global Trade & Customs**

* Own global import and export processes, working with qualified brokers, advisers, and Legal to support compliance with applicable requirements.
* Establish consistent controls for product classification, customs valuation, country of origin, shipping documentation, and recordkeeping.
* Coordinate trade screening, restricted-party reviews, and escalation of potential compliance issues.
* Monitor changes in tariffs, duties, and trade requirements; communicate implications for sourcing, shipping routes, and landed costs.
* Clarify importer and exporter responsibilities across entities and ensure accountability for customs filings and broker instructions.
* Maintain documented procedures and support audits, corrective actions, and employee training.

**Freight Spend & Performance**

* Own consolidated freight budgets, forecasts, and reporting in partnership with Finance and business leaders.
* Build visibility into freight spend by business, mode, carrier, lane, and shipment type.
* Identify and execute opportunities to improve shipment consolidation, mode selection, routing, packaging, and delivery planning.
* Establish processes for freight invoice review, cost allocation, and validation against contracted rates.
* Track savings and service improvements against clear baselines, including the effect on total landed cost.

**Systems, Processes & Leadership**

* Partner with Technology to improve shipment visibility, transportation data, system integrations, and reporting.
* Establish clear decision rights between the central logistics function and business teams, including approval of expedited freight.
* Build and lead the logistics function as business needs evolve, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Use operational data and root-cause analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide concise updates to leadership on performance, risks, costs, and decisions requiring action.

### **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in transportation, global logistics, freight management, or international trade, including leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated ownership of freight operations and spend across multiple businesses, locations, or international markets.
* Experience managing ocean, air, parcel, and domestic ground transportation.
* Strong knowledge of import/export operations, customs brokerage, Incoterms, and landed-cost analysis.
* Proven success negotiating transportation agreements and improving freight costs while maintaining service.
* Experience establishing freight reporting, provider scorecards, and consistent operating processes.
* Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to influence across functions, manage competing priorities, and remain effective in a changing environment.
* Experience with ERP, warehouse, and transportation management systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant supply chain or trade credentials preferred.

### **Measures of Success**

* Reliable pickup and delivery performance across businesses.
* Improved freight cost per shipment, unit, or weight, supported by measurable savings.
* Reduced premium freight, accessorial charges, detention, and demurrage.
* Clear visibility into shipment status, freight spend, and landed costs.
* Consistent adoption of companywide freight processes and carrier agreements.
* Accurate trade documentation and timely resolution of customs issues.
* Improved claims recovery and carrier accountability.

title: Director, Organic Social
description:
**About Siege Media**

On day one, that means running authentic, sustained brand presence on Reddit and other communities where buyers ask for recommendations, and where LLMs increasingly pull their answers from.

Over time, you’ll extend the practice into full organic social strategy across LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram for high-growth startups and enterprise brands. As the service books revenue, you’ll hire and lead a team underneath you.

This is a senior, client-facing, hands-on role. You’ll pitch on sales calls, set strategy, work in the communities yourself early on, and write the reports clients read. If you want to build a practice from scratch with the runway and brand of an established agency behind you, this role is for you.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

**Community management**

* **Reddit programs for clients:** Strategy, subreddit research, account and voice setup, engagement, moderation relationships and reporting. You know how to add value in a community without getting flagged as marketing.
* **Other communities:** Extending programs to Quora, Discord, Slack groups, niche forums, review sites and UGC platforms where a client’s buyers gather.

* **GEO impact:** Connecting community presence to how brands show up in AI answers, working with Siege’s GEO, affiliate and digital PR teams.

**Organic social strategy**

* **Channel strategy across LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram:** Positioning, content pillars, cadence, executive and employee advocacy, and measurement for high-growth startups and enterprise brands.
* **Siege’s own organic social:** Shaping how Siege shows up on LinkedIn and in communities, in partnership with leadership, both through owned accounts and executive content.

**Building the practice**

* **Sales support:** Joining prospect calls to scope and sell community and organic social engagements alongside the growth team.
* **Service infrastructure:** Playbooks, community guidelines and disclosure standards, QA, pricing scaffolds and reporting that turn this into a repeatable, sellable service line.
* **Team building:** Hiring your first community manager when revenue supports it, then training and managing to Siege’s senior-led standard. Owning and executing until then.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 7+ years in social media or community roles, with 3+ years leading community management programs for brands, in-house or at an agency
* Deep, hands-on Reddit experience: you’ve built brand presence in real subreddits, navigated moderator relationships and community rules, and can show what worked and what didn’t
* A track record setting organic social strategy across LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram for high-growth startups or enterprise brands
* B2B and B2C experience, ideally SaaS, fintech and ecommerce. You know the difference between engagement metrics and business outcomes
* Sound judgment on authenticity, disclosure and platform rules. You know when not to post
* Client-facing comfort. You can walk a VP of Marketing through a quarterly review and handle a tough conversation
* Strong written communication. Clients see your work directly; no account managers translate between you and them
* Builder energy. You’re excited to build and scale a service line, and you can execute yourself to keep it profitable early on

**Bonus points**
----------------

* A point of view on how Reddit and community content shapes LLM answers, and how to measure it
* Experience with review and UGC platforms (G2, Trustpilot, Capterra) and reputation management
* Built or scaled a social or community practice inside an agency before
* Experience with social listening tools such as Brandwatch, Sprout Social, Syften or GummySearch
* An active Reddit history with real karma and credibility in communities relevant to our clients
* Executive and employee advocacy programs on LinkedIn

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**First 90 days**

* A documented community management playbook: research process, engagement rules, disclosure standards, escalation paths and reporting template
* Community programs live for the first client accounts, with baseline metrics set
* Pricing and scoping for community management agreed with the growth team, and active participation in sales calls

**First year**

* Community management is a profitable, repeatable service line with retained clients
* Organic social strategy offered across LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram
* First hire made and ramped
* Clear reporting that ties community work to share of voice, sentiment and AI visibility

**Compensation & logistics**
----------------------------

Siege Media values diversity. We encourage people of color, LGBTQ+ folks, veterans, parents and those with disabilities to apply. If you require reasonable accommodation during our application or interview process, please let us know.

------------

Send your resume and a short note to [email]. In the note, link two or three community threads or programs you’ve run (Reddit preferred), and explain how you’d approach Reddit for a B2B SaaS brand that has no presence there today.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

As Director of Product Design, you will lead the design organization responsible for how customers and administrators experience Menlo Security's Enterprise Secure Browser platform, from the first-run configuration dashboard experience to the policies that keep global enterprises safe. You will set the design philosophy, user and administrator dashboards quality bar, and research and accessibility standards for the entire product organization, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythms that make excellent work the default. Partnering closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market, you will make design a strategic driver of product direction and competitive differentiation in enterprise security, where clarity and trust matter as much as capability. You will also lead how the design team utilizes AI,how we leverage AI to continue to improve our user interfaces, and build shared workflows that speed up research synthesis, exploration, and quality review while keeping human judgment at the center.

**Outcomes & KPIs**
-------------------

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* A consistently high-quality, accessible, and cohesive product experience across all Menlo surfaces that measurably improves customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* A high-performing, well-led design organization with the systems, standards, and talent to scale with the business.

**Success Metrics / KPIs:** *(suggested; hiring manager to confirm)*

* Improvement in product usability and customer satisfaction measures (e.g., task success rates, SUS/CSAT, or NPS for key workflows) year over year.
* Accessibility conformance (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA) across core product surfaces, tracked through defined quality gates.
* Design system adoption and consistency across product teams, along with fewer design-related defects reaching production.
* Measurable time saved or quality improved through AI-enabled design workflows adopted across the team.
* Team health and growth indicators, including engagement scores, retention of top talent, and internal promotion readiness.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, grow, and coach a team of product designers and design managers, investing meaningful time in talent development, setting clear performance expectations, and making timely talent decisions.
* Define the craft philosophy, quality standards, and review processes that govern interaction design, visual design, and accessibility across the full product organization, and build the design systems and frameworks that sustain them at scale.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market leaders to shape multi-quarter and multi-year product vision, influence roadmap and investment decisions, and protect design intent through implementation.
* Establish the organization's research and accessibility practice, embedding evidence-based decision-making and company-wide accessibility standards into roadmap planning and product quality gates.
* Demonstrate design's business impact through outcome tracking and clear business cases, and represent design strategy and results at the VP and executive level.
* Design and scale AI-enabled workflows for the team, such as using AI to synthesize research and customer feedback, generate and explore early concepts, and support accessibility and consistency checks, and evaluate AI tools for fit, risk, and ROI.
* Build cross-functional forums and operating rhythms that bring the customer's perspective into how Menlo plans, prioritizes, and makes decisions.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 12+ years of product design experience, including 5+ years leading design teams with managers reporting to you, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
* A portfolio showing advanced craft in UX, interaction, and visual design for complex products, and how you have raised quality standards across multiple teams.
* Experience building or scaling a design system and establishing design review and quality processes across a product organization.
* Depth in user research methods and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG), with a track record of embedding both into product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence executive and C-suite stakeholders, connect design work to business outcomes, and shape product strategy and roadmaps.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools in design and research workflows, with experience guiding a team's adoption of them responsibly.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience designing for cybersecurity, networking, or IT/security administrator audiences.
* Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences.
* Experience leading content design or UX writing alongside product design.
* External presence in the design community, such as speaking, writing, or mentoring.
* Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Menlo Mindsets**
------------------

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

* **Proactive Leadership** — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.
* **Straight Talk** — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.
* **United Impact** — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You align with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders on shared priorities and build the forums that make design quality a company-wide responsibility, not just the design team's.
* **Elevated Talent** — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You spend real time developing designers and design managers, set a clear bar for craft and leadership, and know and actively grow the top talent across your organization.
* **Customer-Compelled** — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You bring research and customer insight into strategic planning, and work across teams to find and remove root-cause friction in the product before customers feel it.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability**.

Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.***

description:

**Description**

The Associate Editorial Director with GSW is responsible for managing editorial workflow within assigned teams and serving as an editorial point of contact for client management, medical, creative, and other cross-functional partners. This person can manage editors and helps facilitate cross-office staffing as needs arise. In addition, the Associate Editorial Director maintains assigned brand responsibilities, editing, and fact-checking print and digital materials across clients' various disease areas of focus. The Associate Editorial Director is proficient in editorial processes and the pharmaceutical advertising communications industry and independently handles a wide range of client projects.

Reporting to the VP, Editorial Director, the Associate Editorial Director supports the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of editorial processes and standards that ensure high-quality output for our clients. This role can include direct people-management responsibilities but ensuring editors have the support, resources, and guidance needed to succeed.

The Associate Editorial Director understands the broader goals of the department and organization, supports leadership objectives, contributes to a positive department culture, and takes a solutions-oriented approach to challenges. In this leadership position, the Associate Editorial Director serves as a role model and mentor, helping team members achieve department goals while supporting their professional growth.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
  
Duties may include, but are not limited to, all or some of the following:

Leadership and People Management

* Support the day-to-day management of the Editorial department and serve as a primary editorial leadership contact for assigned teams or offices.
* Provide day-to-day leadership and management for assigned direct reports (if people managing), including resource management, conflict resolution, communication of processes and expectations, performance evaluations, professional development plans, and MBO plans.
* Work to ensure editorial systems, processes, and standards are followed and issues are escalated appropriately.
* Train and onboard new Editorial hires and familiarize them with department processes, standards, tools, and ways of working.
* Train and foster the development of newer editors while coaching experienced staff and providing ongoing feedback and guidance.
* Plan and lead editorial team meetings as appropriate.
* Foster a positive, collaborative department culture and serve as a role model for editorial standards and professional expectations.

Workflow, Resourcing, and Operations

* Proactively assess workload, capacity, deadlines, and potential bottlenecks among editors they support.
* Develop coverage solutions and coordinate cross-office support as needed, escalating broader staffing and resource needs to the Editorial Director.
* Help manage editorial workflow and priorities to support appropriate coverage and timely delivery of work.
* Resolve day-to-day editorial staffing, workflow, and process issues within assigned areas, identifying solutions and escalating issues requiring broader department direction or support.
* Provide regular updates to the Editorial Director regarding workload, staffing needs, project risks, process concerns, and other issues requiring broader departmental oversight.
* Maintain and enforce established editorial best practices and process standards within assigned teams and accounts, escalating broader process issues and opportunities to the Editorial Director.
* Identify opportunities to improve editorial workflows and processes and partner with Editorial leadership on solutions and implementation.

Editorial and Brand Responsibilities

* Maintain assigned brand-editor responsibilities while balancing people-management (if managing), operational, and department leadership responsibilities.
* Supervise the editorial process across assigned accounts and teams, ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* Perform various levels of editing, proofreading, and fact-checking on print and digital materials.
* Edit with a demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical and medical content, including recognition of drug trade and generic names and identification of potential reference or claims issues.
* Edit to enhance clarity, readability, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand and editorial standards without significantly altering intended meaning.
* Check the accuracy and consistency of information and supporting references.
* Produce accurate, high-quality work while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines.
* Stay current on relevant medical communications and editorial best practices.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Problem-Solving

* Work closely with account managers, medical, writers, designers, creative teams, project managers, and other partners to support cohesive and efficient development and review of client work.
* Serve as an editorial resource to cross-functional teams, helping clarify editorial processes, requirements, and expectations.
* Anticipate and identify roadblocks that may affect quality, timing, resources, or deadlines and develop practical solutions.
* Independently address routine brand- and team-level challenges while recognizing when issues require escalation or broader leadership involvement.

**Job Qualifications**

Skills

* High level of familiarity and comfort with AMA style and knowledge of FDA requirements relevant to pharmaceutical advertising and promotional communications.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong people-management and coaching skills, including the ability to guide editors with varying levels of experience.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and people simultaneously with a high degree of organization, initiative, and efficiency.
* Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize competing demands and identify when an issue should be resolved independently versus escalated.
* Ability to motivate and support people through change and evolving roles or processes.
* Solutions-oriented approach to challenges involving quality, timing, resources, workflow, and deadlines.
* Self-starter who can identify unmet needs, raise issues proactively, and recommend practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with minimal direction and adapt to shifting priorities, assignments, and business needs.
* Strong commitment to editorial quality, consistency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

* Candidates must be able to work PST hours
* Bachelor's degree in Journalism, English, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7 years of editorial experience, including experience in healthcare communications.
* Firm grasp of AMA style and FDA guidelines applicable to pharmaceutical communications, including fair balance and claims referencing.
* Proven track record of producing high-quality editorial work and managing editorial processes.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and staff-development skills.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and fact-checking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and project-management abilities.
* Proficiency with relevant editorial tools and content-management systems.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage tight or competing deadlines.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**

Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
